     1	// HeavyModelAdmission.swift — single-heavy-model residency accounting.
     2	//
     3	// The engine can only afford ONE heavy generative model resident in unified
     4	// memory at a time. A resident image model (krea2 alone footprints ~75GB in
     5	// practice, far above the pool's 22GB estimate) plus LTX-2 video (~60-70GB)
     6	// exceeds a 128GB machine's physical RAM and trips OS_REASON_JETSAM.
     7	//
     8	// The ModelPool's VRAM budget is BLIND to LTX-2 (it loads entirely outside the
     9	// pool), so image + video could co-reside and OOM. This type owns the pure
    10	// accounting decision — "evict the other class, and can this load proceed?" —
    11	// so it is unit-testable with injected byte figures, independent of live
    12	// machine state. WarmServer wires it to MemoryProbe for the live numbers.
    13	//
    14	// Issue: #218
    15

    33	  }

    50	  /// weights restores the conservative gate with no rebuild (FDD §4.3).

    58	  public struct Decision: Sendable, Equatable {
    59	    /// Release the currently-resident models of the *other* class first.
    60	    public let evictOther: Bool
    61	    /// Whether the load may proceed at all.
    62	    public let admit: Bool
    63	    /// Whether headroom will be satisfied (false ⇒ admitted but tight).
    64	    public let hasHeadroom: Bool
    65	    public let reason: String
    66	  }
    67	
    68	  /// Projected free memory once the other heavy class is released.
    69	  /// `availableBytes` already excludes the other class's wired arrays, so
    70	  /// releasing it adds `otherResidentBytes` back to the free pool.
    71	  public func projectedFreeAfterEvict(availableBytes: UInt64, otherResidentBytes: UInt64) -> UInt64 {
    72	    availableBytes &+ otherResidentBytes
    73	  }
    74	
    75	  /// Decide whether a heavy load of `needBytes` may proceed.
    76	  ///
    77	  /// - Parameters:
    78	  ///   - needBytes: estimated footprint of the model we are about to load.
    79	  ///   - availableBytes: reclaimable/free system memory now
    80	  ///     (`MemoryProbe.systemAvailableMemoryBytes()`).
    81	  ///   - otherResidentBytes: estimated footprint of the OTHER heavy class
    82	  ///     currently resident (0 if none). Always evicted first.
    83	  public func decide(needBytes: UInt64, availableBytes: UInt64, otherResidentBytes: UInt64) -> Decision {
    84	    let evict = otherResidentBytes > 0
    85	    let projectedFree = projectedFreeAfterEvict(availableBytes: availableBytes, otherResidentBytes: otherResidentBytes)
    86	
    87	    if projectedFree >= needBytes &+ headroomBytes {
    88	      return Decision(
    89	        evictOther: evict, admit: true, hasHeadroom: true,
    90	        reason: "ok: projected \(projectedFree >> 20)MB free ≥ need \(needBytes >> 20)MB + headroom \(headroomBytes >> 20)MB")
    91	    }
    92	    if projectedFree >= needBytes {
    93	      return Decision(
    94	        evictOther: evict, admit: true, hasHeadroom: false,
    95	        reason: "tight: projected \(projectedFree >> 20)MB free ≥ need \(needBytes >> 20)MB but below headroom target")
    96	    }
    97	    return Decision(
    98	      evictOther: evict, admit: false, hasHeadroom: false,
    99	      reason: "refuse: projected \(projectedFree >> 20)MB free < need \(needBytes >> 20)MB — would OOM")
   100	  }
   101	
   102	  /// Post-eviction gate: after the other class has actually been released and
   103	  /// memory re-probed, is there room for `needBytes`? Admits when free memory
   104	  /// covers the need (headroom preferred but not mandatory once we are already
   105	  /// single-resident — refusing here would strand the only heavy model).
   106	  public func admitsAfterEvict(needBytes: UInt64, freeBytes: UInt64) -> Bool {
   107	    freeBytes >= needBytes
   108	  }
   109	}

  1252	  // MARK: - Internal: Position Grid
  1253	
  1254	  /// Create a 3D position grid for RoPE in pixel space.
  1255	  ///
  1256	  /// Matches the Python `create_position_grid` function with causal fix
  1257	  /// and bfloat16 precision quantization.
  1258	  /// Adaptive VAE decode. Plain single-pass decode is clean (no spatial-tile
  1259	  /// mosaic, no temporal-window jitter) but memory-heavy; tiled decode is
  1260	  /// OOM-safe for long/large clips. Decide by latent frame count: plain for
  1261	  /// normal clips, exact streamed decode above the safety gate. Mode switch:
  1262	  /// LTX2_DECODE_MODE=auto|stream|tile|plain. Threshold tunable
  1263	  /// via LTX2_PLAIN_DECODE_MAX_LATF (latent frames; ~8x fewer than output frames).
  1264	  private func decodeAdaptive(_ latents: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
  1265	    let latF = latents.dim(2)
  1266	    let latH = latents.dim(3)
  1267	    let latW = latents.dim(4)
  1268	    // Gate on TOTAL latent volume, not frame count alone: a 768x1280 clip at
  1269	    // latF 13 (24x40 spatial) is 3x the volume of 448x704 and plain decode at
  1270	    // that size drove 40GB+ of swap with critical memory pressure mid-decode,
  1271	    // corrupting the output (blank/gray frames). Budget = the proven-safe
  1272	    // 448x704x97f working point (13*14*22 = 4004) with ~2x headroom.
  1273	    let volume = latF * latH * latW
  1274	    // Default budget derived from the Metal max-buffer ceiling, measured
  1275	    // empirically (2026-07-24): plain-decoding 49f @ 768x1280 (volume 6720,
  1276	    // ~25GB peak intermediate) SILENTLY CORRUPTS the last ~60% of frames —
  1277	    // no error, just garbage — while tiled decode of the same tensor is clean.
  1278	    // 4004 (97f @ 448x704) is proven-safe; 4500 keeps margin below the cliff.
  1279	    let plainMaxVolume = resolvedConfig.plainDecodeMaxVol
  1280	    // LTX2_DUMP_LATENT=<path>: save the pre-decode latent for offline decode
  1281	    // debugging (real-values reproduction harness, #36).
  1282	    if let dumpPath = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_DUMP_LATENT"] {
  1283	      try? MLX.save(arrays: ["latent": latents.asType(.float32)], url: URL(fileURLWithPath: dumpPath))
  1284	      logger.info("VAE decode: dumped pre-decode latent to \(dumpPath)")
  1285	    }
  1286	    // LTX2_DECODE_F32=1: decode in float32 instead of bf16 (debug probe).
  1287	    let decodeF32 = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_DECODE_F32"] == "1"
  1288	    let bf = latents.asType(decodeF32 ? .float32 : .bfloat16)
  1289	
  1290	    // Decode mode — ONE switch (LTX2_DECODE_MODE): auto | stream | tile | plain.
  1291	    //   auto (default): plain under the corruption-safe volume gate, exact
  1292	    //     streamed chunked-io above it (bit-identical to plain, zero seams).
  1293	    //   stream: streamed always. tile: legacy spatial tiling (LTX2_DECODE_TILE).
  1294	    //   plain: force single-pass — EXPERT/DEBUG ONLY: above the gate, MLX Metal
  1295	    //     silently corrupts boundary frames (int32 offset overflow, mlx #3836;
  1296	    //     unfixed in any mlx-swift release as of 0.31.6).
  1297	    // Legacy alias honored: LTX2_DECODE_STREAM=0 -> tile. config.tiledDecode
  1298	    // no longer disables the safety path (Codex review 2026-07-26: a default-
  1299	    // constructed config could force a corrupting plain decode).
  1300	    let env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
  1301	    let mode = (env["LTX2_DECODE_MODE"] ?? (env["LTX2_DECODE_STREAM"] == "0" ? "tile" : "auto")).lowercased()
  1302	    switch mode {
  1303	    case "plain":
  1304	      if volume > plainMaxVolume {
  1305	        logger.warning("VAE decode: FORCED plain above the safety gate (volume \(volume) > \(plainMaxVolume)) — output may be silently corrupt (mlx #3836).")
  1306	      }
  1307	      logger.info("VAE decode: plain single-pass (forced; volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]).")
  1308	      return vae.decode(bf)
  1309	    case "tile":
  1310	      let tile = Int(env["LTX2_DECODE_TILE"] ?? "") ?? 16
  1311	      logger.info("VAE decode: tiled (mode=tile; volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]) — tile \(tile).")
  1312	      return vae.decodeTiled(bf, tileSize: tile, tileStride: tile - 2)
  1313	    case "stream":
  1314	      logger.info("VAE decode: streamed exact chunked-io (mode=stream; volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]) — zero seams.")
  1315	      return vae.decodeStreamed(bf)
  1316	    default:  // auto
  1317	      if volume > plainMaxVolume {
  1318	        logger.info("VAE decode: streamed exact chunked-io (volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)] > \(plainMaxVolume)) — zero seams.")
  1319	        return vae.decodeStreamed(bf)
  1320	      }
  1321	      logger.info("VAE decode: plain single-pass (volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]) — under the safety gate.")
  1322	      return vae.decode(bf)
  1323	    }
  1324	  }

  1326	  /// Shared two-stage refine (Phase 3): latent upsample x2 -> re-noise ->
  1327	  /// short refine denoise at high res, with the refine-volume OOM gate and
  1328	  /// optional native-res frame-0 re-anchor. Used by generateI2V AND
  1329	  /// generateMultiKeyframe (continuation chunks) so every chunk of a
  1330	  /// multi-chunk render gets identical refine treatment — previously chunks
  1331	  /// 2+ skipped refine entirely, dropping to base resolution mid-video.
  1332	  /// Returns the refined (or gated/upsampled) latents; caller decodes.
  1333	  private func applyTwoStageRefine(
  1334	    _ latents: MLXArray,
  1335	    latF: Int, latH: Int, latW: Int,
  1336	    textEmbeddings: MLXArray,
  1337	    negativeEmbeddings: MLXArray?,
  1338	    cfgScale: Float,
  1339	    seed: UInt64?,
  1340	    refineAnchorImage: MLXArray?,
  1341	    progressCallback: ((Int, Int) -> Void)?
  1342	  ) -> MLXArray {
  1343	    guard let ups = self.upsampler,
  1344	          resolvedConfig.twoStage else {
  1345	      return latents
  1346	    }
  1347	    logger.info("Two-stage refine: upsampling latents 2x...")
  1348	    // The latent upsampler is trained on UN-normalized (VAE-scale) latents.
  1349	    let stats = vae.decoder.perChannelStatistics
  1350	    let denorm = stats.unNormalize(latents.asType(.float32))
  1351	    let upDenorm = ups(denorm)
  1352	    let upLatent = stats.normalize(upDenorm).asType(.float32)
  1353	    eval(upLatent)
  1354	    // --- Refine bisection instrumentation (env-gated, 2026-08-01 band bug) ---
  1355	    // LTX2_REFINE_ROWSTATS=1 logs per-latent-row energy at each refine boundary
  1356	    // so the vertical-truncation fault can be localized (upsample vs re-noise
  1357	    // vs denoise vs decode) from a single short render.
  1358	    // LTX2_REFINE_DUMP_DIR=<dir> additionally saves the boundary latents as
  1359	    // .npy for offline decode/parity tests.
  1360	    let rowStatsOn = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_ROWSTATS"] == "1"
  1361	    let dumpDir = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DUMP_DIR"]
  1362	    func rowStats(_ name: String, _ x: MLXArray) {
  1363	      guard rowStatsOn else { return }
  1364	      let f32 = x.asType(.float32)
  1365	      let energy = MLX.mean(f32 * f32, axes: [0, 1, 2, 4])  // (H,)
  1366	      eval(energy)
  1367	      let rows = energy.asArray(Float.self).map { String(format: "%.4f", $0) }
  1368	      logger.info("REFINE ROWSTATS \(name) [\(x.dim(3)) rows]: \(rows.joined(separator: " "))")
  1369	      if let dir = dumpDir {
  1370	        try? MLX.save(array: f32, url: URL(fileURLWithPath: dir).appendingPathComponent("\(name).npy"))
  1371	      }
  1372	    }
  1373	    rowStats("base", latents)
  1374	    rowStats("upsampled", upLatent)
  1375	    // Refine-volume OOM gate (2026-07-25 23:24 crash): above it, decode the
  1376	    // upsampled latent directly — upscaled-but-unrefined beats a dead server.
  1377	    let refineVolume = upLatent.dim(2) * (latH * 2) * (latW * 2)
  1378	    let refineMaxVolume = resolvedConfig.refineMaxVol
  1379	    if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DECODE_ONLY"] == "1" {
  1380	      logger.info("Two-stage refine: DECODE_ONLY (skipped denoise) — decoding upsampled latent directly.")
  1381	      return upLatent
  1382	    }
  1383	    if refineVolume > refineMaxVolume {
  1384	      logger.info("Two-stage refine: SKIPPED denoise (refine latent volume \(refineVolume) > \(refineMaxVolume)) — decoding upsampled latent directly (OOM guard).")
  1385	      return upLatent
  1386	    }
  1387	    MLX.GPU.clearCache()
  1388	    let rLatH = latH * 2, rLatW = latW * 2
  1389	    let refineSigmas: [Float] = resolvedConfig.refineSigmasEffective
  1390	    if let seed = seed { MLXRandom.seed(seed &+ 1000) }
  1391	    // Flow-matching re-noise: x_σ = (1-σ)·x0 + σ·ε (ComfyUI CONST noise_scaling).
  1392	    let refNoise = MLXRandom.normal(upLatent.shape).asType(.float32)
  1393	    let sigma0 = refineSigmas[0]
  1394	    let mixed = MLXArray(1 - sigma0) * upLatent + refNoise * MLXArray(sigma0)
  1395	    // Frame-0 re-anchor: raw source re-encoded at refine res when available
  1396	    // (workflow nodes 19/20); else the upsampled latent's own frame 0.
  1397	    let rF = upLatent.dim(2)
  1398	    var anchorFrame = upLatent[0..., 0..., 0..<1, 0..., 0...]
  1399	    if var refImg = refineAnchorImage {
  1400	      if refImg.ndim == 4 { refImg = refImg.expandedDimensions(axis: 2) }
  1401	      anchorFrame = vae.encode(refImg).asType(.float32)
  1402	      eval(anchorFrame)
  1403	      logger.info("Two-stage refine: frame 0 re-anchored to source re-encoded at \(rLatW * spatialCompression)x\(rLatH * spatialCompression).")
  1404	    }
  1405	    rowStats("mixed", mixed)
  1406	    let refineInit = MLX.concatenated(
  1407	      [anchorFrame, mixed[0..., 0..., 1..<rF, 0..., 0...]], axis: 2)
  1408	    let refClean = MLX.concatenated(
  1409	      [anchorFrame, upLatent[0..., 0..., 1..<rF, 0..., 0...]], axis: 2)
  1410	    let refMask = MLX.concatenated(
  1411	      [MLXArray.zeros([1, 1, 1, 1, 1]), MLXArray.ones([1, 1, rF - 1, 1, 1])],
  1412	      axis: 2).asType(.float32)
  1413	    let refState = LTX2LatentState(
  1414	      latent: refineInit, cleanLatent: refClean, denoiseMask: refMask)
  1415	    let refinePos = createPositionGrid(batchSize: 1, latF: latF, latH: rLatH, latW: rLatW)
  1416	    let refinePE = ltx2PrecomputeFreqsCIS(
  1417	      indicesGrid: refinePos, dim: innerDim,
  1418	      theta: transformer.positionalEmbeddingTheta,
  1419	      maxPos: transformer.positionalEmbeddingMaxPos,
  1420	      useMiddleIndicesGrid: transformer.useMiddleIndicesGrid,
  1421	      numAttentionHeads: transformer.numHeads,
  1422	      ropeMode: transformer.ropeMode,
  1423	      doublePrecision: transformer.doublePrecisionRoPE)
  1424	    eval(refinePE.cos, refinePE.sin)
  1425	    logger.info("Two-stage refine: denoising at \(rLatW * spatialCompression)x\(rLatH * spatialCompression), \(refineSigmas.count - 1) steps...")
  1426	    // base=euler_ancestral_cfg_pp -> refine=euler_cfg_pp (the author's pairing).
  1427	    var refined = denoisingLoop(
  1428	      latents: refineInit, positions: refinePos, precomputedPE: refinePE,
  1429	      textEmbeddings: textEmbeddings, negativeEmbeddings: negativeEmbeddings,
  1430	      sigmas: refineSigmas, cfgScale: cfgScale, state: refState,
  1431	      forceDeterministic: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DETERMINISTIC"] != "0",
  1432	      progressCallback: progressCallback)
  1433	    eval(refined)
  1434	    rowStats("refined", refined)
  1435	    MLX.GPU.clearCache()
  1436	    logger.info("Two-stage refine complete.")
  1437	    return refined
  1438	  }

  1447	  ) -> MLXArray {

  1449	    let spatialScale = Float(spatialCompression) * spatialScaleMul
  1450	    // Conditioning frame_rate drives the temporal RoPE spacing, which is the
   550	        loadedLoraKey = nil

   553	    // MARK: - Generate
   554	
   555	    public func generate(
   556	        _ request: LTX2VideoRequest,
   557	        progress: ((Int, Int, Int, Int) -> Void)? = nil   // (chunk, totalChunks, step, totalSteps)
   558	    ) throws -> LTX2VideoResult {
   559	        #if canImport(CoreGraphics) && canImport(ImageIO)
   560	        // Memory-leak fix (2026-07-18): the video render path never freed MLX
   561	        // activation buffers, so idle mem climbed ~20GB -> 110GB+ across renders
   562	        // until every render hit `Memory pressure` mid-flight and the shedding
   563	        // corrupted the output into rainbow noise. Clear the MLX cache before
   564	        // (drop leftover image-gen buffers, freeing headroom) and after (this
   565	        // render's activations, via defer) EVERY render.
   566	        GPU.clearCache()
   567	        defer { GPU.clearCache() }
   568	        try validate(request)
   569	        try load(loras: request.effectiveLoRAs)
   570	        guard let pipeline, let tokenizer else { throw LTX2VideoError.weightsMissing(config.weightsDir) }
   571	
   572	        // One greppable line per render: every Tier A/B param + provenance
   573	        // (task #9 Phase 1). Invalid resolutions log separately and LOUDLY.
   574	        // Phase 2: the TYPED resolution is authoritative — refresh it onto
   575	        // the pipeline so render code reads it instead of raw env (Codex
   576	        // finding #14). Request/preset tuning joins in the wire-format
   577	        // increment; until then this resolves configFile > env > builtin.
   578	        let typedConfig = LTX2ConfigResolver.resolveTyped(request: request.tuning, preset: request.presetTuning)
   579	        pipeline.resolvedConfig = typedConfig
   580	        let resolved = typedConfig.params
   581	        // Finding #18: two_stage was load-time only — a request could not turn
   582	        // it on without a server restart. Lazy-load the upsampler on the first
   583	        // request that resolves twoStage=true.
   584	        if typedConfig.twoStage, pipeline.upsampler == nil,
   585	           !typedConfig.upsamplerPath.isEmpty,
   586	           FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: typedConfig.upsamplerPath) {
   587	            pipeline.upsampler = Self.loadUpsampler(path: typedConfig.upsamplerPath, logger: logger)
   588	        }
   589	        let summary = resolved.map { "\($0.name)=\($0.value)(\($0.source.rawValue))" }.joined(separator: " ")
   590	        logger.info("[LTX2] effective-config: \(summary)")
   591	        for p in resolved where !p.valid {
   592	            logger.error("[LTX2] CONFIG REJECTED: \(p.name) — \(p.note ?? "invalid") — using \(p.value) (\(p.source.rawValue))")
   593	        }
   594	
   595	        let plan = Self.chunkPlan(
   596	            framesPerChunk: request.framesPerChunk,
   597	            extendToSeconds: request.extendToSeconds, fps: request.fps)
   598	
   599	        let batch = tokenizer.encode(prompt: request.prompt, maxLength: 128)
   600	        MLX.eval(batch.inputIds, batch.attentionMask)
   601	
   602	        // Negative prompt: tokenize when provided, or default to the PinkCherry
   603	        // workflow negative when a CFG++ sampler is active (CFG++ requires a
   604	        // negative pass every step even at cfg=1).
   605	        let negText: String? = {
   606	            if let n = request.negativePrompt, !n.isEmpty { return n }
   607	            return pipeline.resolvedConfig.samplerIsCfgPP
   608	                ? "subtitle, caption, text, text on screen, watermark, logo, timestamp"
   609	                : nil
   610	        }()
   611	        let negBatch = negText.map { tokenizer.encode(prompt: $0, maxLength: 128) }
   612	        if let negBatch { MLX.eval(negBatch.inputIds, negBatch.attentionMask) }
   613	
   614	        let start = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
   615	        var allFrames: [CGImage] = []
   616	
   617	        // Center-crop a CGImage to the target aspect ratio, matching ComfyUI's
   618	        // ImageScale crop="center" (workflow nodes 7 and 19). Our plain resize
   619	        // STRETCHES on aspect mismatch — seed stills are often 9:16 (0.5625)
   620	        // against 384x640 (0.6), a ~7% vertical squash that distorts the
   621	        // conditioning content vs the workflow's crop.
   622	        func centerCropped(_ cg: CGImage, targetW: Int, targetH: Int) -> CGImage {
   623	            let srcW = Double(cg.width), srcH = Double(cg.height)
   624	            let targetAspect = Double(targetW) / Double(targetH)
   625	            let srcAspect = srcW / srcH
   626	            var cropW = srcW, cropH = srcH
   627	            if srcAspect > targetAspect {
   628	                cropW = srcH * targetAspect
   629	            } else {
   630	                cropH = srcW / targetAspect
   631	            }
   632	            let rect = CGRect(
   633	                x: ((srcW - cropW) / 2).rounded(.down),
   634	                y: ((srcH - cropH) / 2).rounded(.down),
   635	                width: cropW.rounded(), height: cropH.rounded())
   636	            return cg.cropping(to: rect) ?? cg
   637	        }
   638	
   639	        // Conditioning compression (libx264 CRF), function-scoped so BOTH the
   640	        // initial seed AND the chained continuation-chunk seeds get it. Chained
   641	        // seeds that skip it condition on a PRISTINE generated frame = the
   642	        // frozen-image regime → motion collapses across chunks (2026-07-26:
   643	        // comp30 chunk1 action-zone 6.11, chunks 2-3 crash to 2.2 because the
   644	        // chained frame was uncompressed). Higher = more motion.
   645	        let conditioningCompression = request.imgCompression
   646	            ?? pipeline.resolvedConfig.imgCompression
   647	
   648	        // Seed image: the init image for I2V, else nil (T2V first chunk).
   649	        var currentImage: MLXArray? = try request.initImagePath.map { path in
   650	            let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
   651	            guard let source = CGImageSourceCreateWithURL(url as CFURL, nil),
   652	                  let rawImage = CGImageSourceCreateImageAtIndex(source, 0, nil) else {
   653	                throw LTX2VideoError.imageLoadFailed(path)
   654	            }
   655	            // Workflow order (nodes 7 -> 8): center-crop + scale to the render
   656	            // size FIRST, then compression-preprocess at that size. Compressing
   657	            // at native resolution and downscaling after (the old order)
   658	            // changes the artifact character and stretches on aspect mismatch.
   659	            var cgImage = try QwenImageIO.resizedCGImage(
   660	                from: centerCropped(rawImage, targetW: request.width, targetH: request.height),
   661	                width: request.width, height: request.height)
   662	            // LTX conditioning preprocess (ComfyUI LTXVPreprocess, img_compression
   663	            // = libx264 CRF): round-trip the still through lossy compression so
   664	            // it carries codec-like artifacts. LTX is trained on VIDEO frames — a
   665	            // pristine still is out-of-distribution and the model freezes it

The repository’s real dual-stream code lives in `LTX2TransformerBlock.callDualStream`, is also parity-deferred, and the top-level transformer never calls it. I’m now tracing the reference’s exact latent preparation, conditioning, position, and scheduler contracts so the missing-work list reflects the actual graph.

    21	class CompressedTimestep:
    22	    """Store video timestep embeddings in compressed form using per-frame indexing."""
    23	    __slots__ = ('data', 'batch_size', 'num_frames', 'patches_per_frame', 'feature_dim')
    24	
    25	    def __init__(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, patches_per_frame: int):
    26	        """
    27	        tensor: [batch_size, num_tokens, feature_dim] tensor where num_tokens = num_frames * patches_per_frame
    28	        patches_per_frame: Number of spatial patches per frame (height * width in latent space), or None to disable compression
    29	        """
    30	        self.batch_size, num_tokens, self.feature_dim = tensor.shape
    31	
    32	        # Check if compression is valid (num_tokens must be divisible by patches_per_frame)
    33	        if patches_per_frame is not None and num_tokens % patches_per_frame == 0 and num_tokens >= patches_per_frame:
    34	            self.patches_per_frame = patches_per_frame
    35	            self.num_frames = num_tokens // patches_per_frame
    36	
    37	            # Reshape to [batch, frames, patches_per_frame, feature_dim] and store one value per frame
    38	            # All patches in a frame are identical, so we only keep the first one
    39	            reshaped = tensor.view(self.batch_size, self.num_frames, patches_per_frame, self.feature_dim)
    40	            self.data = reshaped[:, :, 0, :].contiguous()  # [batch, frames, feature_dim]
    41	        else:
    42	            # Not divisible or too small - store directly without compression
    43	            self.patches_per_frame = 1
    44	            self.num_frames = num_tokens
    45	            self.data = tensor
    46	
    47	    def expand(self):
    48	        """Expand back to original tensor."""
    49	        if self.patches_per_frame == 1:
    50	            return self.data
    51	
    52	        # [batch, frames, feature_dim] -> [batch, frames, patches_per_frame, feature_dim] -> [batch, tokens, feature_dim]
    53	        expanded = self.data.unsqueeze(2).expand(self.batch_size, self.num_frames, self.patches_per_frame, self.feature_dim)
    54	        return expanded.reshape(self.batch_size, -1, self.feature_dim)
    55	
    56	    def expand_for_computation(self, scale_shift_table: torch.Tensor, batch_size: int, indices: slice = slice(None, None)):
    57	        """Compute ada values on compressed per-frame data, then expand spatially."""
    58	        num_ada_params = scale_shift_table.shape[0]
    59	
    60	        # No compression - compute directly
    61	        if self.patches_per_frame == 1:
    62	            num_tokens = self.data.shape[1]
    63	            dim_per_param = self.feature_dim // num_ada_params
    64	            reshaped = self.data.reshape(batch_size, num_tokens, num_ada_params, dim_per_param)[:, :, indices, :]
    65	            table_values = scale_shift_table[indices].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device=self.data.device, dtype=self.data.dtype)
    66	            ada_values = (table_values + reshaped).unbind(dim=2)
    67	            return ada_values
    68	
    69	        # Compressed: compute on per-frame data then expand spatially
    70	        # Reshape: [batch, frames, feature_dim] -> [batch, frames, num_ada_params, dim_per_param]
    71	        frame_reshaped = self.data.reshape(batch_size, self.num_frames, num_ada_params, -1)[:, :, indices, :]
    72	        table_values = scale_shift_table[indices].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(
    73	            device=self.data.device, dtype=self.data.dtype
    74	        )
    75	        frame_ada = (table_values + frame_reshaped).unbind(dim=2)
    76	
    77	        # Expand each ada parameter spatially: [batch, frames, dim] -> [batch, frames, patches, dim] -> [batch, tokens, dim]
    78	        return tuple(
    79	            frame_val.unsqueeze(2).expand(batch_size, self.num_frames, self.patches_per_frame, -1)
    80	            .reshape(batch_size, -1, frame_val.shape[-1])
    81	            for frame_val in frame_ada
    82	        )

   203	    def get_ada_values(
   204	        self, scale_shift_table: torch.Tensor, batch_size: int, timestep: torch.Tensor, indices: slice = slice(None, None)
   205	    ):
   206	        if isinstance(timestep, CompressedTimestep):
   207	            return timestep.expand_for_computation(scale_shift_table, batch_size, indices)
   208	
   209	        num_ada_params = scale_shift_table.shape[0]
   210	
   211	        ada_values = (
   212	            scale_shift_table[indices].unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device=timestep.device, dtype=timestep.dtype)
   213	            + timestep.reshape(batch_size, timestep.shape[1], num_ada_params, -1)[:, :, indices, :]
   214	        ).unbind(dim=2)
   215	        return ada_values

   217	    def get_av_ca_ada_values(

   220	        batch_size: int,

   222	        gate_timestep: torch.Tensor,

   234	        )

   238	    def _apply_text_cross_attention(

   257	    def forward(
   258	        self, x: Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor], v_context=None, a_context=None, attention_mask=None, v_timestep=None, a_timestep=None,
   259	        v_pe=None, a_pe=None, v_cross_pe=None, a_cross_pe=None, v_cross_scale_shift_timestep=None, a_cross_scale_shift_timestep=None,
   260	        v_cross_gate_timestep=None, a_cross_gate_timestep=None, transformer_options=None, self_attention_mask=None,
   261	        v_prompt_timestep=None, a_prompt_timestep=None,
   262	    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
   263	        run_vx = transformer_options.get("run_vx", True)
   264	        run_ax = transformer_options.get("run_ax", True)
   265	
   266	        vx, ax = x
   267	        run_ax = run_ax and ax.numel() > 0
   268	        run_a2v = run_vx and transformer_options.get("a2v_cross_attn", True) and ax.numel() > 0
   269	        run_v2a = run_ax and transformer_options.get("v2a_cross_attn", True)
   270	
   271	        # video
   272	        if run_vx:
   273	            # video self-attention
   274	            vshift_msa, vscale_msa = (self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table, vx.shape[0], v_timestep, slice(0, 2)))
   275	            norm_vx = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(vx) * (1 + vscale_msa) + vshift_msa
   276	            del vshift_msa, vscale_msa
   277	            attn1_out = self.attn1(norm_vx, pe=v_pe, mask=self_attention_mask, transformer_options=transformer_options)
   278	            del norm_vx
   279	            # video cross-attention
   280	            vgate_msa = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table, vx.shape[0], v_timestep, slice(2, 3))[0]
   281	            vx.addcmul_(attn1_out, vgate_msa)
   282	            del vgate_msa, attn1_out
   283	            vx.add_(self._apply_text_cross_attention(
   284	                vx, v_context, self.attn2, self.scale_shift_table,
   285	                getattr(self, 'prompt_scale_shift_table', None),
   286	                v_timestep, v_prompt_timestep, attention_mask, transformer_options,)
   287	            )
   288	
   289	        # audio
   290	        if run_ax:
   291	            # audio self-attention
   292	            ashift_msa, ascale_msa = (self.get_ada_values(self.audio_scale_shift_table, ax.shape[0], a_timestep, slice(0, 2)))
   293	            norm_ax = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(ax) * (1 + ascale_msa) + ashift_msa
   294	            del ashift_msa, ascale_msa
   295	            attn1_out = self.audio_attn1(norm_ax, pe=a_pe, transformer_options=transformer_options)
   296	            del norm_ax
   297	            # audio cross-attention
   298	            agate_msa = self.get_ada_values(self.audio_scale_shift_table, ax.shape[0], a_timestep, slice(2, 3))[0]
   299	            ax.addcmul_(attn1_out, agate_msa)
   300	            del agate_msa, attn1_out
   301	            ax.add_(self._apply_text_cross_attention(
   302	                ax, a_context, self.audio_attn2, self.audio_scale_shift_table,
   303	                getattr(self, 'audio_prompt_scale_shift_table', None),
   304	                a_timestep, a_prompt_timestep, attention_mask, transformer_options,)
   305	            )
   306	
   307	        # video - audio cross attention.
   308	        if run_a2v or run_v2a:
   309	            vx_norm3 = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(vx)
   310	            ax_norm3 = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(ax)
   311	
   312	            # audio to video cross attention
   313	            if run_a2v:
   314	                scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_a2v, shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_a2v = self.get_ada_values(
   315	                    self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_audio[:4, :], ax.shape[0], a_cross_scale_shift_timestep)[:2]
   316	                scale_ca_video_hidden_states_a2v_v, shift_ca_video_hidden_states_a2v_v = self.get_ada_values(
   317	                    self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_video[:4, :], vx.shape[0], v_cross_scale_shift_timestep)[:2]
   318	
   319	                vx_scaled = vx_norm3 * (1 + scale_ca_video_hidden_states_a2v_v) + shift_ca_video_hidden_states_a2v_v
   320	                ax_scaled = ax_norm3 * (1 + scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_a2v) + shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_a2v
   321	                del scale_ca_video_hidden_states_a2v_v, shift_ca_video_hidden_states_a2v_v, scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_a2v, shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_a2v
   322	
   323	                a2v_out = self.audio_to_video_attn(vx_scaled, context=ax_scaled, pe=v_cross_pe, k_pe=a_cross_pe, transformer_options=transformer_options)
   324	                del vx_scaled, ax_scaled
   325	
   326	                gate_out_a2v = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_video[4:, :], vx.shape[0], v_cross_gate_timestep)[0]
   327	                vx.addcmul_(a2v_out, gate_out_a2v)
   328	                del gate_out_a2v, a2v_out
   329	
   330	            # video to audio cross attention
   331	            if run_v2a:
   332	                scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a = self.get_ada_values(
   333	                    self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_audio[:4, :], ax.shape[0], a_cross_scale_shift_timestep)[2:4]
   334	                scale_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a = self.get_ada_values(
   335	                    self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_video[:4, :], vx.shape[0], v_cross_scale_shift_timestep)[2:4]
   336	
   337	                ax_scaled = ax_norm3 * (1 + scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a) + shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a
   338	                vx_scaled = vx_norm3 * (1 + scale_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a) + shift_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a
   339	                del scale_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a, scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a
   340	
   341	                v2a_out = self.video_to_audio_attn(ax_scaled, context=vx_scaled, pe=a_cross_pe, k_pe=v_cross_pe, transformer_options=transformer_options)
   342	                del ax_scaled, vx_scaled
   343	
   344	                gate_out_v2a = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_audio[4:, :], ax.shape[0], a_cross_gate_timestep)[0]
   345	                ax.addcmul_(v2a_out, gate_out_v2a)
   346	                del gate_out_v2a, v2a_out
   347	
   348	            del vx_norm3, ax_norm3
   349	
   350	        # video feedforward
   351	        if run_vx:
   352	            vshift_mlp, vscale_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table, vx.shape[0], v_timestep, slice(3, 5))
   353	            vx_scaled = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(vx) * (1 + vscale_mlp) + vshift_mlp
   354	            del vshift_mlp, vscale_mlp
   355	
   356	            ff_out = self.ff(vx_scaled)
   357	            del vx_scaled
   358	
   359	            vgate_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table, vx.shape[0], v_timestep, slice(5, 6))[0]
   360	            vx.addcmul_(ff_out, vgate_mlp)
   361	            del vgate_mlp, ff_out
   362	
   363	        # audio feedforward
   364	        if run_ax:
   365	            ashift_mlp, ascale_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.audio_scale_shift_table, ax.shape[0], a_timestep, slice(3, 5))
   366	            ax_scaled = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(ax) * (1 + ascale_mlp) + ashift_mlp
   367	            del ashift_mlp, ascale_mlp
   368	
   369	            ff_out = self.audio_ff(ax_scaled)
   370	            del ax_scaled
   371	
   372	            agate_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.audio_scale_shift_table, ax.shape[0], a_timestep, slice(5, 6))[0]
   373	            ax.addcmul_(ff_out, agate_mlp)
   374	            del agate_mlp, ff_out
   375	
   376	        return vx, ax
   377	
   378

   564	    def preprocess_text_embeds(self, context, unprocessed=False):
   565	        # LTXv2 fully processed context has dimension of self.caption_channels * 2
   566	        # LTXv2.3 fully processed context has dimension of self.cross_attention_dim + self.audio_cross_attention_dim
   567	        if not unprocessed:
   568	            if context.shape[-1] in (self.cross_attention_dim + self.audio_cross_attention_dim, self.caption_channels * 2):
   569	                return context
   570	        if context.shape[-1] == self.cross_attention_dim + self.audio_cross_attention_dim:
   571	            context_vid = context[:, :, :self.cross_attention_dim]
   572	            context_audio = context[:, :, self.cross_attention_dim:]
   573	        else:
   574	            context_vid = context
   575	            context_audio = context
   576	        if self.caption_proj_before_connector:
   577	            context_vid = self.caption_projection(context_vid)
   578	            context_audio = self.audio_caption_projection(context_audio)
   579	        out_vid = self.video_embeddings_connector(context_vid)[0]
   580	        out_audio = self.audio_embeddings_connector(context_audio)[0]
   581	        return torch.concat((out_vid, out_audio), dim=-1)
   582	
   583	    def _init_transformer_blocks(self, device, dtype, **kwargs):
   584	        """Initialize transformer blocks for LTXAV."""
   585	        self.transformer_blocks = nn.ModuleList(
   586	            [
   587	                BasicAVTransformerBlock(
   588	                    v_dim=self.inner_dim,
   589	                    a_dim=self.audio_inner_dim,
   590	                    v_heads=self.num_attention_heads,
   591	                    a_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   592	                    vd_head=self.attention_head_dim,
   593	                    ad_head=self.audio_attention_head_dim,
   594	                    v_context_dim=self.cross_attention_dim,
   595	                    a_context_dim=self.audio_cross_attention_dim,
   596	                    apply_gated_attention=self.apply_gated_attention,
   597	                    cross_attention_adaln=self.cross_attention_adaln,
   598	                    dtype=dtype,
   599	                    device=device,
   600	                    operations=self.operations,
   601	                )
   602	                for _ in range(self.num_layers)
   603	            ]
   604	        )

   606	    def _init_output_components(self, device, dtype):
   607	        """Initialize output components for LTXAV."""
   608	        # Video output components
   609	        super()._init_output_components(device, dtype)
   610	        # Audio output components
   611	        self.audio_scale_shift_table = nn.Parameter(
   612	            torch.empty(2, self.audio_inner_dim, dtype=dtype, device=device)
   613	        )
   614	        self.audio_norm_out = self.operations.LayerNorm(
   615	            self.audio_inner_dim, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6, dtype=dtype, device=device
   616	        )
   617	        self.audio_proj_out = self.operations.Linear(
   618	            self.audio_inner_dim, self.audio_out_channels, dtype=dtype, device=device
   619	        )
   620	        self.a_patchifier = AudioPatchifier(1, start_end=True)

   622	    def separate_audio_and_video_latents(self, x, audio_length):
   623	        """Separate audio and video latents from combined input."""
   624	        # vx = x[:, : self.in_channels]
   625	        # ax = x[:, self.in_channels :]
   626	        #
   627	        # ax = ax.reshape(ax.shape[0], -1)
   628	        # ax = ax[:, : audio_length * self.num_audio_channels * self.audio_frequency_bins]
   629	        #
   630	        # ax = ax.reshape(
   631	        #     ax.shape[0], self.num_audio_channels, audio_length, self.audio_frequency_bins
   632	        # )
   633	
   634	        vx = x[0]
   635	        ax = x[1] if len(x) > 1 else torch.zeros(
   636	            (vx.shape[0], self.num_audio_channels, 0, self.audio_frequency_bins),
   637	            device=vx.device, dtype=vx.dtype
   638	        )
   639	        return vx, ax

   641	    def recombine_audio_and_video_latents(self, vx, ax, target_shape=None):
   642	        if ax.numel() == 0:
   643	            return vx
   644	        else:
   645	            return [vx, ax]
   646	        """Recombine audio and video latents for output."""
   647	        # if ax.device != vx.device or ax.dtype != vx.dtype:
   648	        #     logging.warning("Audio and video latents are on different devices or dtypes.")
   649	        #     ax = ax.to(device=vx.device, dtype=vx.dtype)
   650	        #     logging.warning(f"Audio audio latent moved to device: {ax.device}, dtype: {ax.dtype}")
   651	        #
   652	        # ax = ax.reshape(ax.shape[0], -1)
   653	        # # pad to f x h x w of the video latents
   654	        # divisor = vx.shape[-1] * vx.shape[-2] * vx.shape[-3]
   655	        # if target_shape is None:
   656	        #     repetitions = math.ceil(ax.shape[-1] / divisor)
   657	        # else:
   658	        #     repetitions = target_shape[1] - vx.shape[1]
   659	        # padded_len = repetitions * divisor
   660	        # ax = F.pad(ax, (0, padded_len - ax.shape[-1]))
   661	        # ax = ax.reshape(ax.shape[0], -1, vx.shape[-3], vx.shape[-2], vx.shape[-1])
   662	        # return torch.cat([vx, ax], dim=1)
   663	
   664	    def _process_input(self, x, keyframe_idxs, denoise_mask, **kwargs):
   665	        """Process input for LTXAV - separate audio and video, then patchify."""
   666	        audio_length = kwargs.get("audio_length", 0)
   667	        # Separate audio and video latents
   668	        vx, ax = self.separate_audio_and_video_latents(x, audio_length)
   669	
   670	        has_spatial_mask = False
   671	        if denoise_mask is not None:
   672	            # check if any frame has spatial variation (inpainting)
   673	            for frame_idx in range(denoise_mask.shape[2]):
   674	                frame_mask = denoise_mask[0, 0, frame_idx]
   675	                if frame_mask.numel() > 0 and frame_mask.min() != frame_mask.max():
   676	                    has_spatial_mask = True
   677	                    break
   678	
   679	        [vx, v_pixel_coords, additional_args] = super()._process_input(
   680	            vx, keyframe_idxs, denoise_mask, **kwargs
   681	        )
   682	        additional_args["has_spatial_mask"] = has_spatial_mask
   683	
   684	        ax, a_latent_coords = self.a_patchifier.patchify(ax)
   685	
   686	        # Inject reference audio for ID-LoRA in-context conditioning
   687	        ref_audio = kwargs.get("ref_audio", None)
   688	        ref_audio_seq_len = 0
   689	        if ref_audio is not None:
   690	            ref_tokens = ref_audio["tokens"].to(dtype=ax.dtype, device=ax.device)
   691	            if ref_tokens.shape[0] < ax.shape[0]:
   692	                ref_tokens = ref_tokens.expand(ax.shape[0], -1, -1)
   693	            ref_audio_seq_len = ref_tokens.shape[1]
   694	            B = ax.shape[0]
   695	
   696	            # Compute negative temporal positions matching ID-LoRA convention:
   697	            # offset by -(end_of_last_token + time_per_latent) so reference ends just before t=0
   698	            p = self.a_patchifier
   699	            tpl = p.hop_length * p.audio_latent_downsample_factor / p.sample_rate
   700	            ref_start = p._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(0, ref_audio_seq_len, torch.float32, ax.device)
   701	            ref_end = p._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(1, ref_audio_seq_len + 1, torch.float32, ax.device)
   702	            time_offset = ref_end[-1].item() + tpl
   703	            ref_start = (ref_start - time_offset).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   704	            ref_end = (ref_end - time_offset).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   705	            ref_pos = torch.stack([ref_start, ref_end], dim=-1)
   706	
   707	            additional_args["ref_audio_seq_len"] = ref_audio_seq_len
   708	            additional_args["target_audio_seq_len"] = ax.shape[1]
   709	            ax = torch.cat([ref_tokens, ax], dim=1)
   710	            a_latent_coords = torch.cat([ref_pos.to(a_latent_coords), a_latent_coords], dim=2)
   711	
   712	        ax = self.audio_patchify_proj(ax)
   713	
   714	        # additional_args.update({"av_orig_shape": list(x.shape)})
   715	        return [vx, ax], [v_pixel_coords, a_latent_coords], additional_args
   716	
   717	    def _prepare_timestep(self, timestep, batch_size, hidden_dtype, **kwargs):
   718	        """Prepare timestep embeddings."""
   719	        # TODO: some code reuse is needed here.
   720	        grid_mask = kwargs.get("grid_mask", None)
   721	        if grid_mask is not None:
   722	            timestep = timestep[:, grid_mask]
   723	
   724	        timestep_scaled = timestep * self.timestep_scale_multiplier
   725	
   726	        v_timestep, v_embedded_timestep = self.adaln_single(
   727	            timestep_scaled.flatten(),
   728	            {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   729	            batch_size=batch_size,
   730	            hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   731	        )
   732	
   733	        # Calculate patches_per_frame from orig_shape: [batch, channels, frames, height, width]
   734	        # Video tokens are arranged as (frames * height * width), so patches_per_frame = height * width
   735	        orig_shape = kwargs.get("orig_shape")
   736	        has_spatial_mask = kwargs.get("has_spatial_mask", None)
   737	        v_patches_per_frame = None
   738	        if not has_spatial_mask and orig_shape is not None and len(orig_shape) == 5:
   739	            # orig_shape[3] = height, orig_shape[4] = width (in latent space)
   740	            v_patches_per_frame = orig_shape[3] * orig_shape[4]
   717	    def _prepare_timestep(self, timestep, batch_size, hidden_dtype, **kwargs):
   718	        """Prepare timestep embeddings."""
   719	        # TODO: some code reuse is needed here.
   720	        grid_mask = kwargs.get("grid_mask", None)
   721	        if grid_mask is not None:
   722	            timestep = timestep[:, grid_mask]
   723	
   724	        timestep_scaled = timestep * self.timestep_scale_multiplier
   725	
   726	        v_timestep, v_embedded_timestep = self.adaln_single(
   727	            timestep_scaled.flatten(),
   728	            {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   729	            batch_size=batch_size,
   730	            hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   731	        )
   732	
   733	        # Calculate patches_per_frame from orig_shape: [batch, channels, frames, height, width]
   734	        # Video tokens are arranged as (frames * height * width), so patches_per_frame = height * width
   735	        orig_shape = kwargs.get("orig_shape")
   736	        has_spatial_mask = kwargs.get("has_spatial_mask", None)
   737	        v_patches_per_frame = None
   738	        if not has_spatial_mask and orig_shape is not None and len(orig_shape) == 5:
   739	            # orig_shape[3] = height, orig_shape[4] = width (in latent space)
   740	            v_patches_per_frame = orig_shape[3] * orig_shape[4]
   741	
   742	        # Reshape to [batch_size, num_tokens, dim] and compress for storage
   743	        v_timestep = CompressedTimestep(v_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, v_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame)
   744	        v_embedded_timestep = CompressedTimestep(v_embedded_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, v_embedded_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame)
   745	
   746	        v_prompt_timestep = compute_prompt_timestep(
   747	            self.prompt_adaln_single, timestep_scaled, batch_size, hidden_dtype
   748	        )
   749	
   750	        # Prepare audio timestep
   751	        a_timestep = kwargs.get("a_timestep")
   752	        ref_audio_seq_len = kwargs.get("ref_audio_seq_len", 0)
   753	        if ref_audio_seq_len > 0 and a_timestep is not None:
   754	            # Reference tokens must have timestep=0, expand scalar/1D timestep to per-token so ref=0 and target=sigma.
   755	            target_len = kwargs.get("target_audio_seq_len")
   756	            if a_timestep.dim() <= 1:
   757	                a_timestep = a_timestep.view(-1, 1).expand(batch_size, target_len)
   758	            ref_ts = torch.zeros(batch_size, ref_audio_seq_len, *a_timestep.shape[2:], device=a_timestep.device, dtype=a_timestep.dtype)
   759	            a_timestep = torch.cat([ref_ts, a_timestep], dim=1)
   760	        if a_timestep is not None:
   761	            a_timestep_scaled = a_timestep * self.timestep_scale_multiplier
   762	            a_timestep_flat = a_timestep_scaled.flatten()
   763	            timestep_flat = timestep_scaled.flatten()
   764	            av_ca_factor = self.av_ca_timestep_scale_multiplier / self.timestep_scale_multiplier
   765	
   766	            # Cross-attention timesteps - compress these too
   767	            av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_audio_scale_shift_adaln_single(
   768	                timestep.max().expand_as(a_timestep_flat),
   769	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   770	                batch_size=batch_size,
   771	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   772	            )
   773	            av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_video_scale_shift_adaln_single(
   774	                a_timestep.max().expand_as(timestep_flat),
   775	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   776	                batch_size=batch_size,
   777	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   778	            )
   779	            av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_a2v_gate_adaln_single(
   780	                a_timestep.max().expand_as(timestep_flat) * av_ca_factor,
   781	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   782	                batch_size=batch_size,
   783	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   784	            )
   785	            av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_v2a_gate_adaln_single(
   786	                timestep.max().expand_as(a_timestep_flat) * av_ca_factor,
   787	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   788	                batch_size=batch_size,
   789	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   790	            )
   791	
   792	            # Compress cross-attention timesteps (only video side, audio is too small to benefit)
   793	            # v_patches_per_frame is None for spatial masks, set for temporal masks or no mask
   794	            cross_av_timestep_ss = [
   795	                av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep.shape[-1]),
   796	                CompressedTimestep(av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame),  # video - compressed if possible
   797	                CompressedTimestep(av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame),  # video - compressed if possible
   798	                av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep.shape[-1]),
   799	            ]
   800	
   801	            a_timestep, a_embedded_timestep = self.audio_adaln_single(
   802	                a_timestep_flat,
   803	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   804	                batch_size=batch_size,
   805	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   806	            )
   807	            # Audio timesteps
   808	            a_timestep = a_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, a_timestep.shape[-1])
   809	            a_embedded_timestep = a_embedded_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, a_embedded_timestep.shape[-1])
   810	
   811	            a_prompt_timestep = compute_prompt_timestep(
   812	                self.audio_prompt_adaln_single, a_timestep_scaled, batch_size, hidden_dtype
   813	            )
   814	        else:
   815	            a_timestep = timestep_scaled
   816	            a_embedded_timestep = kwargs.get("embedded_timestep")
   817	            cross_av_timestep_ss = []
   818	            a_prompt_timestep = None
   819	
   820	        return [v_timestep, a_timestep, cross_av_timestep_ss, v_prompt_timestep, a_prompt_timestep], [
   821	            v_embedded_timestep,
   822	            a_embedded_timestep,
   823	        ], None
   824	
   825	    def _prepare_context(self, context, batch_size, x, attention_mask=None):
   826	        vx = x[0]
   827	        ax = x[1]
   828	        video_dim = vx.shape[-1]
   829	        audio_dim = ax.shape[-1]
   830	
   831	        v_context_dim = self.caption_channels if self.caption_proj_before_connector is False else video_dim
   832	        a_context_dim = self.caption_channels if self.caption_proj_before_connector is False else audio_dim
   833	
   834	        v_context, a_context = torch.split(
   835	            context, [v_context_dim, a_context_dim], len(context.shape) - 1
   836	        )
   837	
   838	        v_context, attention_mask = super()._prepare_context(
   839	            v_context, batch_size, vx, attention_mask
   840	        )
   841	        if self.caption_proj_before_connector is False:
   842	            a_context = self.audio_caption_projection(a_context)
   843	        a_context = a_context.view(batch_size, -1, audio_dim)
   844	
   845	        return [v_context, a_context], attention_mask
   846	
   847	    def _prepare_positional_embeddings(self, pixel_coords, frame_rate, x_dtype):
   848	        v_pixel_coords = pixel_coords[0]
   849	        v_pe = super()._prepare_positional_embeddings(v_pixel_coords, frame_rate, x_dtype)
   850	
   851	        a_latent_coords = pixel_coords[1]
   852	        a_pe = self._precompute_freqs_cis(
   853	            a_latent_coords,
   854	            dim=self.audio_inner_dim,
   855	            out_dtype=x_dtype,
   856	            max_pos=self.audio_positional_embedding_max_pos,
   857	            use_middle_indices_grid=self.use_middle_indices_grid,
   858	            num_attention_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   859	        )
   860	
   861	        # calculate positional embeddings for the middle of the token duration, to use in av cross attention layers.
   862	        max_pos = max(
   863	            self.positional_embedding_max_pos[0], self.audio_positional_embedding_max_pos[0]
   864	        )
   865	        v_pixel_coords = v_pixel_coords.to(torch.float32)
   866	        v_pixel_coords[:, 0] = v_pixel_coords[:, 0] * (1.0 / frame_rate)
   867	        av_cross_video_freq_cis = self._precompute_freqs_cis(
   868	            v_pixel_coords[:, 0:1, :],
   869	            dim=self.audio_cross_attention_dim,
   870	            out_dtype=x_dtype,
   871	            max_pos=[max_pos],
   872	            use_middle_indices_grid=True,
   873	            num_attention_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   874	        )
   875	        av_cross_audio_freq_cis = self._precompute_freqs_cis(
   876	            a_latent_coords[:, 0:1, :],
   877	            dim=self.audio_cross_attention_dim,
   878	            out_dtype=x_dtype,
   879	            max_pos=[max_pos],
   880	            use_middle_indices_grid=True,
   881	            num_attention_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   882	        )
   883	
   884	        return [(v_pe, av_cross_video_freq_cis), (a_pe, av_cross_audio_freq_cis)]
   885	
   886	    def _process_transformer_blocks(
   887	        self, x, context, attention_mask, timestep, pe, transformer_options={}, self_attention_mask=None, **kwargs
   888	    ):
   889	        vx = x[0]
   890	        ax = x[1]
   891	        v_context = context[0]
   892	        a_context = context[1]
   893	        v_timestep = timestep[0]
   894	        a_timestep = timestep[1]
   895	        v_pe, av_cross_video_freq_cis = pe[0]
   896	        a_pe, av_cross_audio_freq_cis = pe[1]
   897	
   898	        (
   899	            av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep,
   900	            av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep,
   901	            av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep,
   902	            av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep,
   903	        ) = timestep[2]
   904	
   905	        v_prompt_timestep = timestep[3]
   906	        a_prompt_timestep = timestep[4]
   907	
   908	        """Process transformer blocks for LTXAV."""
   909	        patches_replace = transformer_options.get("patches_replace", {})
   910	        blocks_replace = patches_replace.get("dit", {})
   911	        prefetch_queue = comfy.model_prefetch.make_prefetch_queue(list(self.transformer_blocks), vx.device, transformer_options)
   912	
   913	        # Process transformer blocks
   914	        for i, block in enumerate(self.transformer_blocks):
   915	            comfy.model_prefetch.prefetch_queue_pop(prefetch_queue, vx.device, block)
   916	            if ("double_block", i) in blocks_replace:
   917	
   918	                def block_wrap(args):
   919	                    out = {}
   920	                    out["img"] = block(
   921	                        args["img"],
   922	                        v_context=args["v_context"],
   923	                        a_context=args["a_context"],
   924	                        attention_mask=args["attention_mask"],
   925	                        v_timestep=args["v_timestep"],
   926	                        a_timestep=args["a_timestep"],
   927	                        v_pe=args["v_pe"],
   928	                        a_pe=args["a_pe"],
   929	                        v_cross_pe=args["v_cross_pe"],
   930	                        a_cross_pe=args["a_cross_pe"],
   931	                        v_cross_scale_shift_timestep=args["v_cross_scale_shift_timestep"],
   932	                        a_cross_scale_shift_timestep=args["a_cross_scale_shift_timestep"],
   933	                        v_cross_gate_timestep=args["v_cross_gate_timestep"],
   934	                        a_cross_gate_timestep=args["a_cross_gate_timestep"],
   935	                        transformer_options=args["transformer_options"],
   936	                        self_attention_mask=args.get("self_attention_mask"),
   937	                        v_prompt_timestep=args.get("v_prompt_timestep"),
   938	                        a_prompt_timestep=args.get("a_prompt_timestep"),
   939	                    )
   940	                    return out
   941	
   942	                out = blocks_replace[("double_block", i)](
   943	                    {
   944	                        "img": (vx, ax),
   945	                        "v_context": v_context,
   946	                        "a_context": a_context,
   947	                        "attention_mask": attention_mask,
   948	                        "v_timestep": v_timestep,
   949	                        "a_timestep": a_timestep,
   950	                        "v_pe": v_pe,
   951	                        "a_pe": a_pe,
   952	                        "v_cross_pe": av_cross_video_freq_cis,
   953	                        "a_cross_pe": av_cross_audio_freq_cis,
   954	                        "v_cross_scale_shift_timestep": av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep,
   955	                        "a_cross_scale_shift_timestep": av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep,
   956	                        "v_cross_gate_timestep": av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep,
   957	                        "a_cross_gate_timestep": av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep,
   958	                        "transformer_options": transformer_options,
   959	                        "self_attention_mask": self_attention_mask,
   960	                        "v_prompt_timestep": v_prompt_timestep,
   961	                        "a_prompt_timestep": a_prompt_timestep,
   962	                    },
   963	                    {"original_block": block_wrap},
   964	                )
   965	                vx, ax = out["img"]
   966	            else:
   967	                vx, ax = block(
   968	                    (vx, ax),
   969	                    v_context=v_context,
   970	                    a_context=a_context,
   971	                    attention_mask=attention_mask,
   972	                    v_timestep=v_timestep,
   973	                    a_timestep=a_timestep,
   974	                    v_pe=v_pe,
   975	                    a_pe=a_pe,
   976	                    v_cross_pe=av_cross_video_freq_cis,
   977	                    a_cross_pe=av_cross_audio_freq_cis,
   978	                    v_cross_scale_shift_timestep=av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep,
   979	                    a_cross_scale_shift_timestep=av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep,
   980	                    v_cross_gate_timestep=av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep,
   981	                    a_cross_gate_timestep=av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep,
   982	                    transformer_options=transformer_options,
   983	                    self_attention_mask=self_attention_mask,
   984	                    v_prompt_timestep=v_prompt_timestep,
   985	                    a_prompt_timestep=a_prompt_timestep,
   986	                )
   987	
   988	        comfy.model_prefetch.prefetch_queue_pop(prefetch_queue, vx.device, None)
   989	
   990	        return [vx, ax]

   992	    def _process_output(self, x, embedded_timestep, keyframe_idxs, **kwargs):
   993	        vx = x[0]
   994	        ax = x[1]
   995	        v_embedded_timestep = embedded_timestep[0]
   996	        a_embedded_timestep = embedded_timestep[1]
   997	
   998	        # Trim reference audio tokens before unpatchification
   999	        ref_audio_seq_len = kwargs.get("ref_audio_seq_len", 0)
  1000	        if ref_audio_seq_len > 0:
  1001	            ax = ax[:, ref_audio_seq_len:]
  1002	            if a_embedded_timestep.shape[1] > 1:
  1003	                a_embedded_timestep = a_embedded_timestep[:, ref_audio_seq_len:]
  1004	
  1005	        # Expand compressed video timestep if needed
  1006	        if isinstance(v_embedded_timestep, CompressedTimestep):
  1007	            v_embedded_timestep = v_embedded_timestep.expand()
  1008	
  1009	        vx = super()._process_output(vx, v_embedded_timestep, keyframe_idxs, **kwargs)
  1010	
  1011	        # Process audio output
  1012	        a_scale_shift_values = (
  1013	            self.audio_scale_shift_table[None, None].to(device=a_embedded_timestep.device, dtype=a_embedded_timestep.dtype)
  1014	            + a_embedded_timestep[:, :, None]
  1015	        )
  1016	        a_shift, a_scale = a_scale_shift_values[:, :, 0], a_scale_shift_values[:, :, 1]
  1017	
  1018	        ax = self.audio_norm_out(ax)
  1019	        ax = ax * (1 + a_scale) + a_shift
  1020	        ax = self.audio_proj_out(ax)
  1021	
  1022	        # Unpatchify audio
  1023	        ax = self.a_patchifier.unpatchify(
  1024	            ax, channels=self.num_audio_channels, freq=self.audio_frequency_bins
  1025	        )
  1026	
  1027	        # Recombine audio and video
  1028	        original_shape = kwargs.get("av_orig_shape")
  1029	        return self.recombine_audio_and_video_latents(vx, ax, original_shape)
  1030	
  1031	    def forward(
  1032	        self,
  1033	        x,
  1034	        timestep,
  1035	        context,
  1036	        attention_mask=None,
  1037	        frame_rate=25,
  1038	        transformer_options={},
  1039	        keyframe_idxs=None,
  1040	        **kwargs,
  1041	    ):
  1042	        """
  1043	        Forward pass for LTXAV model.
  1044	
  1045	        Args:
  1046	            x: Combined audio-video input tensor
  1047	            timestep: Tuple of (video_timestep, audio_timestep) or single timestep
  1048	            context: Context tensor (e.g., text embeddings)
  1049	            attention_mask: Attention mask tensor
  1050	            frame_rate: Frame rate for temporal processing
  1051	            transformer_options: Additional options for transformer blocks
  1052	            keyframe_idxs: Keyframe indices for temporal processing
  1053	            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments including audio_length
  1054	
  1055	        Returns:
  1056	            Combined audio-video output tensor
  1057	        """
  1058	        # Handle timestep format
  1059	        if isinstance(timestep, (tuple, list)) and len(timestep) == 2:
  1060	            v_timestep, a_timestep = timestep
  1061	            kwargs["a_timestep"] = a_timestep
  1062	            timestep = v_timestep
  1063	        else:
  1064	            kwargs["a_timestep"] = timestep
  1065	
  1066	        # Call parent forward method
  1067	        return super().forward(
  1068	            x,
  1069	            timestep,
  1070	            context,
  1071	            attention_mask,
  1072	            frame_rate,
  1073	            transformer_options,
  1074	            keyframe_idxs,
  1075	            **kwargs,
  1076	        )

   502	            operations=self.operations,
   503	        )
   504	        self.av_ca_v2a_gate_adaln_single = AdaLayerNormSingle(
   505	            self.audio_inner_dim,
   506	            use_additional_conditions=False,
   507	            embedding_coefficient=1,
   508	            dtype=dtype,
   509	            device=device,
   510	            operations=self.operations,
   511	        )
   512	
   513	        # Audio caption projection
   514	        if self.caption_proj_before_connector:
   515	            if self.caption_projection_first_linear:
   516	                self.audio_caption_projection = NormSingleLinearTextProjection(
   517	                    in_features=self.caption_channels,
   518	                    hidden_size=self.audio_inner_dim,
   519	                    dtype=dtype,
   520	                    device=device,
   521	                    operations=self.operations,
   522	                )
   523	            else:
   524	                self.audio_caption_projection = lambda a: a
   525	        else:
   526	            self.audio_caption_projection = PixArtAlphaTextProjection(
   527	                in_features=self.caption_channels,
   528	                hidden_size=self.audio_inner_dim,
   529	                dtype=dtype,
   530	                device=device,
   531	                operations=self.operations,
   532	            )
   533	
   534	        connector_split_rope = kwargs.get("rope_type", "split") == "split"
   535	        connector_gated_attention = kwargs.get("connector_apply_gated_attention", False)
   536	        attention_head_dim = kwargs.get("connector_attention_head_dim", 128)
   537	        num_attention_heads = kwargs.get("connector_num_attention_heads", 30)
   538	        num_layers = kwargs.get("connector_num_layers", 2)
   539	
   540	        self.audio_embeddings_connector = Embeddings1DConnector(
   541	            attention_head_dim=kwargs.get("audio_connector_attention_head_dim", attention_head_dim),
   542	            num_attention_heads=kwargs.get("audio_connector_num_attention_heads", num_attention_heads),
   543	            num_layers=num_layers,
   544	            split_rope=connector_split_rope,
   545	            double_precision_rope=True,
   546	            apply_gated_attention=connector_gated_attention,
   547	            dtype=dtype,
   548	            device=device,
   549	            operations=self.operations,
   550	        )
   551	
   552	        self.video_embeddings_connector = Embeddings1DConnector(
   553	            attention_head_dim=attention_head_dim,
   554	            num_attention_heads=num_attention_heads,
   555	            num_layers=num_layers,
   556	            split_rope=connector_split_rope,
   557	            double_precision_rope=True,
   558	            apply_gated_attention=connector_gated_attention,
   559	            dtype=dtype,
   560	            device=device,
   561	            operations=self.operations,
   562	        )
   563	
   564	    def preprocess_text_embeds(self, context, unprocessed=False):
   565	        # LTXv2 fully processed context has dimension of self.caption_channels * 2
   566	        # LTXv2.3 fully processed context has dimension of self.cross_attention_dim + self.audio_cross_attention_dim
   567	        if not unprocessed:
   568	            if context.shape[-1] in (self.cross_attention_dim + self.audio_cross_attention_dim, self.caption_channels * 2):
   569	                return context
   570	        if context.shape[-1] == self.cross_attention_dim + self.audio_cross_attention_dim:
   571	            context_vid = context[:, :, :self.cross_attention_dim]
   572	            context_audio = context[:, :, self.cross_attention_dim:]
   573	        else:
   574	            context_vid = context
   575	            context_audio = context
   576	        if self.caption_proj_before_connector:
   577	            context_vid = self.caption_projection(context_vid)
   578	            context_audio = self.audio_caption_projection(context_audio)
   579	        out_vid = self.video_embeddings_connector(context_vid)[0]
   580	        out_audio = self.audio_embeddings_connector(context_audio)[0]
   581	        return torch.concat((out_vid, out_audio), dim=-1)
   582	
   583	    def _init_transformer_blocks(self, device, dtype, **kwargs):
   584	        """Initialize transformer blocks for LTXAV."""
   585	        self.transformer_blocks = nn.ModuleList(
   586	            [
   587	                BasicAVTransformerBlock(
   588	                    v_dim=self.inner_dim,
   589	                    a_dim=self.audio_inner_dim,
   590	                    v_heads=self.num_attention_heads,
   591	                    a_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   592	                    vd_head=self.attention_head_dim,
   593	                    ad_head=self.audio_attention_head_dim,
   594	                    v_context_dim=self.cross_attention_dim,
   595	                    a_context_dim=self.audio_cross_attention_dim,
   596	                    apply_gated_attention=self.apply_gated_attention,
   597	                    cross_attention_adaln=self.cross_attention_adaln,
   598	                    dtype=dtype,
   599	                    device=device,
   600	                    operations=self.operations,
   601	                )
   602	                for _ in range(self.num_layers)
   603	            ]
   604	        )

   607	        """Initialize output components for LTXAV."""

   610	        # Audio output components

   620	        self.a_patchifier = AudioPatchifier(1, start_end=True)

   622	    def separate_audio_and_video_latents(self, x, audio_length):
   623	        """Separate audio and video latents from combined input."""
   624	        # vx = x[:, : self.in_channels]
   625	        # ax = x[:, self.in_channels :]
   626	        #
   627	        # ax = ax.reshape(ax.shape[0], -1)
   628	        # ax = ax[:, : audio_length * self.num_audio_channels * self.audio_frequency_bins]
   629	        #
   630	        # ax = ax.reshape(
   631	        #     ax.shape[0], self.num_audio_channels, audio_length, self.audio_frequency_bins
   632	        # )

   634	        vx = x[0]
   635	        ax = x[1] if len(x) > 1 else torch.zeros(
   636	            (vx.shape[0], self.num_audio_channels, 0, self.audio_frequency_bins),
   637	            device=vx.device, dtype=vx.dtype
   638	        )
   639	        return vx, ax

   641	    def recombine_audio_and_video_latents(self, vx, ax, target_shape=None):
   642	        if ax.numel() == 0:
   643	            return vx
   644	        else:
   645	            return [vx, ax]
   646	        """Recombine audio and video latents for output."""
   647	        # if ax.device != vx.device or ax.dtype != vx.dtype:
   648	        #     logging.warning("Audio and video latents are on different devices or dtypes.")
   649	        #     ax = ax.to(device=vx.device, dtype=vx.dtype)
   650	        #     logging.warning(f"Audio audio latent moved to device: {ax.device}, dtype: {ax.dtype}")
   651	        #
   652	        # ax = ax.reshape(ax.shape[0], -1)
   653	        # # pad to f x h x w of the video latents
   654	        # divisor = vx.shape[-1] * vx.shape[-2] * vx.shape[-3]
   655	        # if target_shape is None:
   656	        #     repetitions = math.ceil(ax.shape[-1] / divisor)
   657	        # else:
   658	        #     repetitions = target_shape[1] - vx.shape[1]
   659	        # padded_len = repetitions * divisor
   660	        # ax = F.pad(ax, (0, padded_len - ax.shape[-1]))
   661	        # ax = ax.reshape(ax.shape[0], -1, vx.shape[-3], vx.shape[-2], vx.shape[-1])
   662	        # return torch.cat([vx, ax], dim=1)
   663	
   664	    def _process_input(self, x, keyframe_idxs, denoise_mask, **kwargs):
   665	        """Process input for LTXAV - separate audio and video, then patchify."""
   666	        audio_length = kwargs.get("audio_length", 0)
   667	        # Separate audio and video latents
   668	        vx, ax = self.separate_audio_and_video_latents(x, audio_length)
   669	
   670	        has_spatial_mask = False
   671	        if denoise_mask is not None:
   672	            # check if any frame has spatial variation (inpainting)
   673	            for frame_idx in range(denoise_mask.shape[2]):
   674	                frame_mask = denoise_mask[0, 0, frame_idx]
   675	                if frame_mask.numel() > 0 and frame_mask.min() != frame_mask.max():
   676	                    has_spatial_mask = True
   677	                    break
   678	
   679	        [vx, v_pixel_coords, additional_args] = super()._process_input(
   680	            vx, keyframe_idxs, denoise_mask, **kwargs
   681	        )
   682	        additional_args["has_spatial_mask"] = has_spatial_mask
   683	
   684	        ax, a_latent_coords = self.a_patchifier.patchify(ax)
   685	
   686	        # Inject reference audio for ID-LoRA in-context conditioning
   687	        ref_audio = kwargs.get("ref_audio", None)
   688	        ref_audio_seq_len = 0
   689	        if ref_audio is not None:
   690	            ref_tokens = ref_audio["tokens"].to(dtype=ax.dtype, device=ax.device)
   691	            if ref_tokens.shape[0] < ax.shape[0]:
   692	                ref_tokens = ref_tokens.expand(ax.shape[0], -1, -1)
   693	            ref_audio_seq_len = ref_tokens.shape[1]
   694	            B = ax.shape[0]
   695	
   696	            # Compute negative temporal positions matching ID-LoRA convention:
   697	            # offset by -(end_of_last_token + time_per_latent) so reference ends just before t=0
   698	            p = self.a_patchifier
   699	            tpl = p.hop_length * p.audio_latent_downsample_factor / p.sample_rate
   700	            ref_start = p._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(0, ref_audio_seq_len, torch.float32, ax.device)
   701	            ref_end = p._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(1, ref_audio_seq_len + 1, torch.float32, ax.device)
   702	            time_offset = ref_end[-1].item() + tpl
   703	            ref_start = (ref_start - time_offset).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   704	            ref_end = (ref_end - time_offset).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   705	            ref_pos = torch.stack([ref_start, ref_end], dim=-1)
   706	
   707	            additional_args["ref_audio_seq_len"] = ref_audio_seq_len
   708	            additional_args["target_audio_seq_len"] = ax.shape[1]
   709	            ax = torch.cat([ref_tokens, ax], dim=1)
   710	            a_latent_coords = torch.cat([ref_pos.to(a_latent_coords), a_latent_coords], dim=2)
   711	
   712	        ax = self.audio_patchify_proj(ax)
   713	
   714	        # additional_args.update({"av_orig_shape": list(x.shape)})
   715	        return [vx, ax], [v_pixel_coords, a_latent_coords], additional_args
   716

  1103	    def extra_conds(self, **kwargs):
  1104	        out = super().extra_conds(**kwargs)
  1105	        attention_mask = kwargs.get("attention_mask", None)
  1106	        if attention_mask is not None:
  1107	            out['attention_mask'] = comfy.conds.CONDRegular(attention_mask)
  1108	        cross_attn = kwargs.get("cross_attn", None)
  1109	        if cross_attn is not None:
  1110	            out['c_crossattn'] = comfy.conds.CONDRegular(cross_attn)
  1111	
  1112	        guidance = kwargs.get("guidance", 6.0)
  1113	        if guidance is not None:
  1114	            out['guidance'] = comfy.conds.CONDRegular(torch.FloatTensor([guidance]))
  1115	
  1116	        guiding_frame_index = kwargs.get("guiding_frame_index", None)
  1117	        if guiding_frame_index is not None:
  1118	            out['guiding_frame_index'] = comfy.conds.CONDRegular(torch.FloatTensor([guiding_frame_index]))
  1119	
  1120	        ref_latent = kwargs.get("ref_latent", None)
  1121	        if ref_latent is not None:
  1122	            out['ref_latent'] = comfy.conds.CONDRegular(self.process_latent_in(ref_latent))
  1123	
  1124	        return out
  1125	
   690	        b, f, c, h, w = z.shape
   691	        z = z.reshape(b, f, 2, c // 2, h, w)
   692	        z = z.permute(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).reshape(b, f * 2, c // 2, h, w)
   693	        z = z.permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
   694	        z = z[:, :, 1:]
   695	        return z

   133	            outputs=[io.Latent.Output(display_name="Latent")],

   136	    @classmethod
   137	    def execute(
   138	        cls,
   139	        frames_number: int,
   140	        frame_rate: int,
   141	        batch_size: int,
   142	        audio_vae,
   143	    ) -> io.NodeOutput:
   144	        """Generate empty audio latents matching the reference pipeline structure."""
   145	
   146	        assert audio_vae is not None, "Audio VAE model is required"
   147	
   148	        z_channels = audio_vae.latent_channels
   149	        audio_freq = audio_vae.first_stage_model.latent_frequency_bins
   150	        sampling_rate = int(audio_vae.first_stage_model.sample_rate)
   151	
   152	        num_audio_latents = audio_vae.first_stage_model.num_of_latents_from_frames(frames_number, frame_rate)
   153	
   154	        audio_latents = torch.zeros(
   155	            (batch_size, z_channels, num_audio_latents, audio_freq),
   156	            device=comfy.model_management.intermediate_device(),
   157	        )
   158	
   159	        return io.NodeOutput(
   160	            {
   161	                "samples": audio_latents,
   162	                "sample_rate": sampling_rate,
   163	                "type": "audio",
   164	            }
   165	        )

    18	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    19	class AudioVAEComponentConfig:
    20	    """Container for model component configuration extracted from metadata."""
    21	
    22	    autoencoder: dict
    23	    vocoder: dict
    24	
    25	    @classmethod
    26	    def from_metadata(cls, metadata: dict) -> "AudioVAEComponentConfig":
    27	        assert metadata is not None and "config" in metadata, "Metadata is required for audio VAE"
    28	
    29	        raw_config = metadata["config"]
    30	        if isinstance(raw_config, str):
    31	            parsed_config = json.loads(raw_config)
    32	        else:
    33	            parsed_config = raw_config
    34	
    35	        audio_config = parsed_config.get("audio_vae")
    36	        vocoder_config = parsed_config.get("vocoder")
    37	
    38	        assert audio_config is not None, "Audio VAE config is required for audio VAE"
    39	        assert vocoder_config is not None, "Vocoder config is required for audio VAE"
    40	
    41	        return cls(autoencoder=audio_config, vocoder=vocoder_config)
