    43	class AudioLatentNormalizer:
    44	    """Applies per-channel statistics in patch space and restores original layout."""
    45	
    46	    def __init__(self, patchfier: AudioPatchifier, statistics_processor: torch.nn.Module):
    47	        self.patchifier = patchfier
    48	        self.statistics = statistics_processor
    49	
    50	    def normalize(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    51	        channels = latents.shape[1]
    52	        freq = latents.shape[3]
    53	        patched, _ = self.patchifier.patchify(latents)
    54	        normalized = self.statistics.normalize(patched)
    55	        return self.patchifier.unpatchify(normalized, channels=channels, freq=freq)
    56	
    57	    def denormalize(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    58	        channels = latents.shape[1]
    59	        freq = latents.shape[3]
    60	        patched, _ = self.patchifier.patchify(latents)
    61	        denormalized = self.statistics.un_normalize(patched)
    62	        return self.patchifier.unpatchify(denormalized, channels=channels, freq=freq)
    63	
    64	
    65	class AudioPreprocessor:
    66	    """Prepares raw waveforms for the autoencoder by matching training conditions."""
    67	
    68	    def __init__(self, target_sample_rate: int, mel_bins: int, mel_hop_length: int, n_fft: int):
    69	        self.target_sample_rate = target_sample_rate
    70	        self.mel_bins = mel_bins
    71	        self.mel_hop_length = mel_hop_length
    72	        self.n_fft = n_fft
    73	
    74	    def resample(self, waveform: torch.Tensor, source_rate: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    75	        if source_rate == self.target_sample_rate:
    76	            return waveform
    77	        return torchaudio.functional.resample(waveform, source_rate, self.target_sample_rate)
    78	
    79	    def waveform_to_mel(
    80	        self, waveform: torch.Tensor, waveform_sample_rate: int, device
    81	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
    82	        waveform = self.resample(waveform, waveform_sample_rate)
    83	
    84	        mel_transform = torchaudio.transforms.MelSpectrogram(
    85	            sample_rate=self.target_sample_rate,
    86	            n_fft=self.n_fft,
    87	            win_length=self.n_fft,
    88	            hop_length=self.mel_hop_length,
    89	            f_min=0.0,
    90	            f_max=self.target_sample_rate / 2.0,
    91	            n_mels=self.mel_bins,
    92	            window_fn=torch.hann_window,
    93	            center=True,
    94	            pad_mode="reflect",
    95	            power=1.0,
    96	            mel_scale="slaney",
    97	            norm="slaney",
    98	        ).to(device)
    99	
   100	        mel = mel_transform(waveform)
   101	        mel = torch.log(torch.clamp(mel, min=1e-5))
   102	        return mel.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).contiguous()
   103	
   104	
   105	class AudioVAE(torch.nn.Module):
   106	    """High-level Audio VAE wrapper exposing encode and decode entry points."""
   107	
   108	    def __init__(self, metadata: dict):
   109	        super().__init__()
   110	
   111	        component_config = AudioVAEComponentConfig.from_metadata(metadata)
   112	
   113	        self.autoencoder = CausalAudioAutoencoder(config=component_config.autoencoder)
   114	        if "bwe" in component_config.vocoder:
   115	            self.vocoder = VocoderWithBWE(config=component_config.vocoder)
   116	        else:
   117	            self.vocoder = Vocoder(config=component_config.vocoder)
   118	
   119	        autoencoder_config = self.autoencoder.get_config()
   120	        self.normalizer = AudioLatentNormalizer(
   121	            AudioPatchifier(
   122	                patch_size=1,
   123	                audio_latent_downsample_factor=LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR,
   124	                sample_rate=autoencoder_config["sampling_rate"],
   125	                hop_length=autoencoder_config["mel_hop_length"],
   126	                is_causal=autoencoder_config["is_causal"],
   127	            ),
   128	            self.autoencoder.per_channel_statistics,
   129	        )
   130	
   131	        self.preprocessor = AudioPreprocessor(
   132	            target_sample_rate=autoencoder_config["sampling_rate"],
   133	            mel_bins=autoencoder_config["mel_bins"],
   134	            mel_hop_length=autoencoder_config["mel_hop_length"],
   135	            n_fft=autoencoder_config["n_fft"],
   136	        )
   137	
   138	    def encode(self, audio, sample_rate=44100) -> torch.Tensor:
   139	        """Encode a waveform dictionary into normalized latent tensors."""
   140	
   141	        waveform = audio
   142	        waveform_sample_rate = sample_rate
   143	        input_device = waveform.device
   144	        expected_channels = self.autoencoder.encoder.in_channels
   145	        if waveform.shape[1] != expected_channels:
   146	            if waveform.shape[1] == 1:
   147	                waveform = waveform.expand(-1, expected_channels, *waveform.shape[2:])
   148	            else:
   149	                raise ValueError(
   150	                    f"Input audio must have {expected_channels} channels, got {waveform.shape[1]}"
   151	                )
   152	
   153	        mel_spec = self.preprocessor.waveform_to_mel(
   154	            waveform, waveform_sample_rate, device=waveform.device
   155	        )
   156	
   157	        latents = self.autoencoder.encode(mel_spec)
   158	        posterior = DiagonalGaussianDistribution(latents)
   159	        latent_mode = posterior.mode()
   160	
   161	        normalized = self.normalizer.normalize(latent_mode)
   162	        return normalized.to(input_device)
   163	
   164	    def decode(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   165	        """Decode normalized latent tensors into an audio waveform."""
   166	        original_shape = latents.shape
   167	
   168	        latents = self.normalizer.denormalize(latents)
   169	
   170	        target_shape = self.target_shape_from_latents(original_shape)
   171	        mel_spec = self.autoencoder.decode(latents, target_shape=target_shape)
   172	
   173	        waveform = self.run_vocoder(mel_spec)
   174	        return waveform
   175	
   176	    def target_shape_from_latents(self, latents_shape):
   177	        batch, _, time, _ = latents_shape
   178	        target_length = time * LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR
   179	        if self.autoencoder.causality_axis != CausalityAxis.NONE:
   180	            target_length -= LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR - 1
   181	        return (
   182	            batch,
   183	            self.autoencoder.decoder.out_ch,
   184	            target_length,
   185	            self.autoencoder.mel_bins,
   186	        )
   187	
   188	    def num_of_latents_from_frames(self, frames_number: int, frame_rate: int) -> int:
   189	        return math.ceil((float(frames_number) / frame_rate) * self.latents_per_second)
   190	
   191	    def run_vocoder(self, mel_spec: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   192	        audio_channels = self.autoencoder.decoder.out_ch
   193	        vocoder_input = mel_spec.transpose(2, 3)
   194	
   195	        if audio_channels == 1:
   196	            vocoder_input = vocoder_input.squeeze(1)
   197	        elif audio_channels != 2:
   198	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported audio_channels: {audio_channels}")
   199	
   200	        return self.vocoder(vocoder_input)
   201	
   202	    @property
   203	    def sample_rate(self) -> int:
   204	        return int(self.autoencoder.sampling_rate)
   205	
   206	    @property
   207	    def mel_hop_length(self) -> int:
   208	        return int(self.autoencoder.mel_hop_length)
   209	
   210	    @property
   211	    def mel_bins(self) -> int:
   212	        return int(self.autoencoder.mel_bins)
   213	
   214	    @property
   215	    def latent_channels(self) -> int:
   216	        return int(self.autoencoder.decoder.z_channels)
   217	
   218	    @property
   219	    def latent_frequency_bins(self) -> int:
   220	        return int(self.mel_bins // LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR)
   221	
   222	    @property
   223	    def latents_per_second(self) -> float:
   224	        return self.sample_rate / self.mel_hop_length / LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR
   225	
   226	    @property
   227	    def output_sample_rate(self) -> int:
   228	        output_rate = getattr(self.vocoder, "output_sample_rate", None)

   231	        upsample_factor = getattr(self.vocoder, "upsample_factor", None)

   233	            raise AttributeError(

   235	            )
   236	        return int(self.sample_rate * upsample_factor / self.mel_hop_length)

   419	        self.latent_rgb_factors_bias = None
   420

   422	    latent_channels = 16
   423	    latent_dimensions = 3
   424	    scale_factor = 0.476986
   425	    latent_rgb_factors = [
   426	        [-0.0395, -0.0331,  0.0445],
   427	        [ 0.0696,  0.0795,  0.0518],
   428	        [ 0.0135, -0.0945, -0.0282],

     1	from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
     2	from typing import Tuple
     3	
     4	import torch
     5	from einops import rearrange
     6	from torch import Tensor
     7	
     8	
     9	def latent_to_pixel_coords(
    10	    latent_coords: Tensor, scale_factors: Tuple[int, int, int], causal_fix: bool = False
    11	) -> Tensor:
    12	    """
    13	    Converts latent coordinates to pixel coordinates by scaling them according to the VAE's
    14	    configuration.
    15	    Args:
    16	        latent_coords (Tensor): A tensor of shape [batch_size, 3, num_latents]
    17	        containing the latent corner coordinates of each token.
    18	        scale_factors (Tuple[int, int, int]): The scale factors of the VAE's latent space.
    19	        causal_fix (bool): Whether to take into account the different temporal scale
    20	            of the first frame. Default = False for backwards compatibility.
    21	    Returns:
    22	        Tensor: A tensor of pixel coordinates corresponding to the input latent coordinates.
    23	    """
    24	    shape = [1] * latent_coords.ndim
    25	    shape[1] = -1
    26	    pixel_coords = (
    27	        latent_coords
    28	        * torch.tensor(scale_factors, device=latent_coords.device).view(*shape)
    29	    )
    30	    if causal_fix:
    31	        # Fix temporal scale for first frame to 1 due to causality
    32	        pixel_coords[:, 0, ...] = (pixel_coords[:, 0, ...] + 1 - scale_factors[0]).clamp(min=0)
    33	    return pixel_coords
    34	
    35	
    36	class Patchifier(ABC):
    37	    def __init__(self, patch_size: int, start_end: bool=False):
    38	        super().__init__()
    39	        self._patch_size = (1, patch_size, patch_size)
    40	        self.start_end = start_end
    41	
    42	    @abstractmethod
    43	    def patchify(
    44	        self, latents: Tensor, frame_rates: Tensor, scale_grid: bool
    45	    ) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
    46	        pass
    47	
    48	    @abstractmethod
    49	    def unpatchify(
    50	        self,
    51	        latents: Tensor,
    52	        output_height: int,
    53	        output_width: int,
    54	        output_num_frames: int,
    55	        out_channels: int,
    56	    ) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
    57	        pass
    58	
    59	    @property
    60	    def patch_size(self):
    61	        return self._patch_size
    62	
    63	    def get_latent_coords(
    64	        self, latent_num_frames, latent_height, latent_width, batch_size, device
    65	    ):
    66	        """
    67	        Return a tensor of shape [batch_size, 3, num_patches] containing the
    68	            top-left corner latent coordinates of each latent patch.
    69	        The tensor is repeated for each batch element.
    70	        """
    71	        latent_sample_coords = torch.meshgrid(
    72	            torch.arange(0, latent_num_frames, self._patch_size[0], device=device),
    73	            torch.arange(0, latent_height, self._patch_size[1], device=device),
    74	            torch.arange(0, latent_width, self._patch_size[2], device=device),
    75	            indexing="ij",
    76	        )
    77	        latent_sample_coords_start = torch.stack(latent_sample_coords, dim=0)
    78	        delta = torch.tensor(self._patch_size, device=latent_sample_coords_start.device, dtype=latent_sample_coords_start.dtype)[:, None, None, None]
    79	        latent_sample_coords_end = latent_sample_coords_start + delta
    80	
    81	        latent_sample_coords_start = latent_sample_coords_start.unsqueeze(0).repeat(batch_size, 1, 1, 1, 1)
    82	        latent_sample_coords_start = rearrange(
    83	            latent_sample_coords_start, "b c f h w -> b c (f h w)", b=batch_size
    84	        )
    85	        if self.start_end:
    86	            latent_sample_coords_end = latent_sample_coords_end.unsqueeze(0).repeat(batch_size, 1, 1, 1, 1)
    87	            latent_sample_coords_end = rearrange(
    88	                latent_sample_coords_end, "b c f h w -> b c (f h w)", b=batch_size
    89	            )
    90	
    91	            latent_coords = torch.stack((latent_sample_coords_start, latent_sample_coords_end), dim=-1)
    92	        else:
    93	            latent_coords = latent_sample_coords_start
    94	        return latent_coords
    95	
    96	
    97	class SymmetricPatchifier(Patchifier):
    98	    def patchify(
    99	        self,
   100	        latents: Tensor,
   101	    ) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
   102	        b, _, f, h, w = latents.shape
   103	        latent_coords = self.get_latent_coords(f, h, w, b, latents.device)
   104	        latents = rearrange(
   105	            latents,
   106	            "b c (f p1) (h p2) (w p3) -> b (f h w) (c p1 p2 p3)",
   107	            p1=self._patch_size[0],
   108	            p2=self._patch_size[1],
   109	            p3=self._patch_size[2],
   110	        )
   111	        return latents, latent_coords
   112	
   113	    def unpatchify(
   114	        self,
   115	        latents: Tensor,
   116	        output_height: int,
   117	        output_width: int,
   118	        output_num_frames: int,
   119	        out_channels: int,
   120	    ) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:
   121	        output_height = output_height // self._patch_size[1]
   122	        output_width = output_width // self._patch_size[2]
   123	        latents = rearrange(
   124	            latents,
   125	            "b (f h w) (c p q) -> b c f (h p) (w q) ",
   126	            f=output_num_frames,
   127	            h=output_height,
   128	            w=output_width,
   129	            p=self._patch_size[1],
   130	            q=self._patch_size[2],
   131	        )
   132	        return latents
   133	
   134	
   135	class AudioPatchifier(Patchifier):
   136	    def __init__(self, patch_size: int,
   137	        sample_rate=16000,
   138	        hop_length=160,
   139	        audio_latent_downsample_factor=4,
   140	        is_causal=True,
   141	        start_end=False,
   142	        shift = 0
   143	    ):
   144	        super().__init__(patch_size, start_end=start_end)
   145	        self.hop_length = hop_length
   146	        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
   147	        self.audio_latent_downsample_factor = audio_latent_downsample_factor
   148	        self.is_causal = is_causal
   149	        self.shift = shift
   150	
   151	    def copy_with_shift(self, shift):
   152	        return AudioPatchifier(
   153	            self.patch_size, self.sample_rate, self.hop_length, self.audio_latent_downsample_factor,
   154	            self.is_causal, self.start_end, shift
   155	        )
   156	
   157	    def _get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(self, start_latent, end_latent: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device=torch.device):
   158	        audio_latent_frame = torch.arange(start_latent, end_latent, dtype=dtype, device=device)
   159	        audio_mel_frame = audio_latent_frame * self.audio_latent_downsample_factor
   160	        if self.is_causal:
   161	            audio_mel_frame = (audio_mel_frame + 1 - self.audio_latent_downsample_factor).clip(min=0)
   162	        return audio_mel_frame * self.hop_length / self.sample_rate
   163	
   164	
   165	    def patchify(self, audio_latents: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
   166	        # audio_latents: (batch, channels, time, freq)
   167	        b, _, t, _ = audio_latents.shape
   168	        audio_latents = rearrange(
   169	            audio_latents,
   170	            "b c t f -> b t (c f)",
   171	        )
   172	
   173	        audio_latents_start_timings = self._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(self.shift, t + self.shift, torch.float32, audio_latents.device)
   174	        audio_latents_start_timings = audio_latents_start_timings.unsqueeze(0).expand(b, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   175	
   176	        if self.start_end:
   177	            audio_latents_end_timings = self._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(self.shift + 1, t + self.shift + 1, torch.float32, audio_latents.device)
   178	            audio_latents_end_timings = audio_latents_end_timings.unsqueeze(0).expand(b, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   179	
   180	            audio_latents_timings = torch.stack([audio_latents_start_timings, audio_latents_end_timings], dim=-1)
   181	        else:
   182	            audio_latents_timings = audio_latents_start_timings
   183	        return audio_latents, audio_latents_timings
   184	
   185	    def unpatchify(self, audio_latents: torch.Tensor, channels: int, freq: int) -> torch.Tensor:
   186	        # audio_latents: (batch, time, freq * channels)
   187	        audio_latents = rearrange(
   188	            audio_latents, "b t (c f) -> b c t f", c=channels, f=freq
   189	        )
   190	        return audio_latents

   452

   454	        # Strip appended keyframe tokens (multi-anchor with frame_idx>0).
   455	        gen_tokens_1 = output_1.video_latent[:, : F * H_half * W_half, :]
   456	        video_half = self.video_patchifier.unpatchify(gen_tokens_1, (F, H_half, W_half))
   457	
   458	        video_mlx = video_half.transpose(0, 2, 3, 4, 1)  # (B,C,F,H,W) -> (B,F,H,W,C)
   459	        video_denorm = self.vae_encoder.denormalize_latent(video_mlx)
   460	        video_denorm = video_denorm.transpose(0, 4, 1, 2, 3)
   461	        video_upscaled = self.upsampler(video_denorm)
   462	        video_up_mlx = video_upscaled.transpose(0, 2, 3, 4, 1)
   463	        video_upscaled = self.vae_encoder.normalize_latent(video_up_mlx)
   464	        video_upscaled = video_upscaled.transpose(0, 4, 1, 2, 3)
   465	        mx.eval(video_upscaled)
   466	
   467	        # Derive full-resolution dims from actual upscaled shape
   468	        H_full = H_half * 2
   469	        W_full = W_half * 2
   470	
   471	        # I2V conditioning at full resolution for Stage 2 (re-encode at upscaled dims)
   472	        conditionings_2: list = []
   473	        if resolved_images:
   474	            enc_h_full = H_full * 32
   475	            enc_w_full = W_full * 32
   476	            conditionings_2 = combined_image_conditionings(
   477	                resolved_images,
   478	                enc_h=enc_h_full,
   479	                enc_w=enc_w_full,
   480	                spatial_dims=(F, H_full, W_full),
   481	                video_encoder=self.vae_encoder,
   482	            )
   483	
   484	        # Free VAE encoder + upsampler before Stage 2 denoising
   485	        if self.low_memory:
   486	            self.image_conditioner.free()
   487	            self.upsampler = None
   488	            aggressive_cleanup()
   489	
   490	        # --- Stage 2: Refine at full resolution (no CFG) ---
   491	        video_tokens, _ = self.video_patchifier.patchify(video_upscaled)
   492	
   493	        sigmas_2 = STAGE_2_SIGMAS[: stage2_steps + 1] if stage2_steps else STAGE_2_SIGMAS
   494	        start_sigma = sigmas_2[0]
   495	
   496	        video_positions_2 = compute_video_positions(F, H_full, W_full)
   497	
   498	        # Stage 2 video: scalar blend BEFORE conditionings to bit-match legacy
   499	        # ``noise * 0.05 + video_tokens * 0.95`` Python-scalar arithmetic. Without
   500	        # the flag, noise_latent_state's bf16 ``mask * sigma`` blend quantizes 0.05
   501	        # to ~0.05005 → ~3e-3 input error → 27 dB G1 PSNR drift after VAE decode.
   502	        video_state_2 = create_noised_state(
   503	            base_shape=video_tokens.shape,
   504	            conditionings=conditionings_2,
   505	            spatial_dims=(F, H_full, W_full),
   506	            positions=video_positions_2,
   507	            seed=seed + 2,
   508	            sigma=start_sigma,
   509	            initial_latent=video_tokens,
   510	            legacy_scalar_blend=True,
   511	        )
   512	
   513	        # Stage 2 audio: legacy used noise_latent_state (bf16 mask path),
   514	        # so leave legacy_scalar_blend=False (default) to preserve bit-equivalence.
   515	        audio_tokens_1 = output_1.audio_latent
   516	        audio_state_2 = create_noised_state(
   517	            base_shape=audio_tokens_1.shape,
   518	            conditionings=[],
   519	            spatial_dims=(F, H_full, W_full),  # unused
   520	            positions=audio_positions,
   521	            seed=seed + 2,
   522	            sigma=start_sigma,
   523	            initial_latent=audio_tokens_1,
   524	        )
   525	
   526	        # Stage 2 reuses the same x0_model as stage 1 by default. With
   527	        # modality tiling enabled, stage 2 has a different latent shape
   528	        # (full resolution) so we need a fresh tiler+wrapper.
   529	        stage2_x0_model = x0_model
   530	        if self._tile_count is not None:
   531	            from ltx_core_mlx.components.modality_tiling import TiledLTXModel, VideoModalityTiler
   532	
   533	            tiler_2 = VideoModalityTiler(self._tile_count, latent_shape=(F, H_full, W_full))
   534	            stage2_x0_model = X0Model(TiledLTXModel(self.dit, tiler_2))
   535	
   536	        output_2 = denoise_loop(
   537	            model=stage2_x0_model,
   538	            video_state=video_state_2,
   539	            audio_state=audio_state_2,
   540	            video_text_embeds=video_embeds,
   541	            audio_text_embeds=audio_embeds,
   542	            sigmas=sigmas_2,
   543	        )
   544	        if self.low_memory:
   545	            aggressive_cleanup()
   546	
   547	        gen_tokens_2 = output_2.video_latent[:, : F * H_full * W_full, :]
   548	        video_latent = self.video_patchifier.unpatchify(gen_tokens_2, (F, H_full, W_full))
   549	        audio_latent = self.audio_patchifier.unpatchify(output_2.audio_latent)
   550	
   551	        return video_latent, audio_latent
   552	
   553	    def generate_and_save(
   554	        self,
   555	        prompt: str,
   556	        output_path: str,
   557	        height: int = 480,
   558	        width: int = 704,
   559	        num_frames: int = 97,
   560	        seed: int = 42,
   561	        stage1_steps: int | None = None,
   562	        stage2_steps: int | None = None,
   563	        cfg_scale: float = DEFAULT_CFG_SCALE,
   564	        stg_scale: float = 1.0,
   565	        image: str | None = None,
   566	        images=None,
   567	        video_guider_params: MultiModalGuiderParams | None = None,
   568	        audio_guider_params: MultiModalGuiderParams | None = None,
   569	        enable_teacache: bool = False,
   570	        teacache_thresh: float | None = None,
   100	
   101	        if self.upsampler is None:
   102	            self._load_upsampler()
   103	
   104	        self._loaded = True
   105	
   106	    def generate_two_stage(  # type: ignore[override]
   107	        self,
   108	        prompt: str,
   109	        height: int = 480,
   110	        width: int = 704,
   111	        num_frames: int = 97,
   112	        seed: int = 42,
   113	        stage1_steps: int | None = None,
   114	        stage2_steps: int | None = None,
   115	        image: str | None = None,
   116	        images=None,
   117	        **_unused_kwargs,
   118	    ) -> tuple[mx.array, mx.array]:
   119	        """Generate video using the distilled two-stage pipeline.
   120	
   121	        Args:
   122	            prompt: Text prompt.
   123	            height: Final video height.
   124	            width: Final video width.
   125	            num_frames: Number of frames.
   126	            seed: Random seed.
   127	            stage1_steps: Stage 1 steps (default: full DISTILLED_SIGMAS = 8).
   128	            stage2_steps: Stage 2 steps (default: full STAGE_2_SIGMAS = 3).
   129	            image: Optional reference image for I2V conditioning.
   130	            **_unused_kwargs: Accepted (and ignored) for signature compatibility
   131	                with :meth:`TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline.generate_two_stage`. CFG / STG /
   132	                TeaCache flags don't apply to the distilled flow.
   133	
   134	        Returns:
   135	            Tuple of (video_latent, audio_latent) at full resolution.
   136	        """
   137	        # --- Text encoding (positive only — no CFG) ---
   138	        self._load_text_encoder()
   139	        video_embeds, audio_embeds = self._encode_text(prompt)
   140	        _materialize(video_embeds, audio_embeds)
   141	        if self.low_memory:
   142	            self.prompt_encoder.free()
   143	            aggressive_cleanup()
   144	
   145	        # --- Load distilled DiT + VAE encoder + upsampler ---
   146	        self.load()
   147	        assert self.dit is not None
   148	        assert self.vae_encoder is not None
   149	        assert self.upsampler is not None
   150	
   151	        # --- Stage 1: half resolution ---
   152	        half_h, half_w = height // 2, width // 2
   153	        F, H_half, W_half = compute_video_latent_shape(num_frames, half_h, half_w)
   154	        video_shape = (1, F * H_half * W_half, 128)
   155	        audio_T = compute_audio_token_count(num_frames)
   156	        audio_shape = (1, audio_T, 128)
   157	
   158	        video_positions_1 = compute_video_positions(F, H_half, W_half)
   159	        audio_positions = compute_audio_positions(audio_T)
   160	
   161	        # I2V conditioning at half resolution. ``images`` is the upstream-iso
   162	        # multi-anchor list; ``image`` is the legacy single-image shorthand.
   163	        from ltx_pipelines_mlx.utils._orchestration import combined_image_conditionings
   164	        from ltx_pipelines_mlx.utils.args import ImageConditioningInput
   165	
   166	        enc_h_half = H_half * 32
   167	        enc_w_half = W_half * 32
   168	        resolved_images = list(images) if images else []
   169	        if image is not None and not resolved_images:
   170	            resolved_images = [ImageConditioningInput(path=image, frame_idx=0, strength=1.0)]
   171	        conditionings_1: list = []
   172	        if resolved_images:
   173	            conditionings_1 = combined_image_conditionings(
   174	                resolved_images,
   175	                enc_h=enc_h_half,
   176	                enc_w=enc_w_half,
   177	                spatial_dims=(F, H_half, W_half),
   178	                video_encoder=self.vae_encoder,
   179	            )
   180	
   181	        video_state = create_noised_state(
   182	            base_shape=video_shape,
   183	            conditionings=conditionings_1,
   184	            spatial_dims=(F, H_half, W_half),
   185	            positions=video_positions_1,
   186	            seed=seed,
   187	            sigma=1.0,
   188	            initial_latent=None,
   189	            legacy_scalar_blend=True,
   190	        )
   191	        audio_state = create_noised_state(
   192	            base_shape=audio_shape,
   193	            conditionings=[],
   194	            spatial_dims=(F, H_half, W_half),  # unused
   195	            positions=audio_positions,
   196	            seed=seed + 1,
   197	            sigma=1.0,
   198	            initial_latent=None,
   199	            legacy_scalar_blend=True,
   200	        )
   201	
   202	        sigmas_1 = DISTILLED_SIGMAS[: stage1_steps + 1] if stage1_steps else DISTILLED_SIGMAS
   203	
   204	        stage1_dit = self.dit
   205	        if self._tile_count is not None:
   206	            from ltx_core_mlx.components.modality_tiling import TiledLTXModel, VideoModalityTiler
   207	
   208	            tiler_1 = VideoModalityTiler(self._tile_count, latent_shape=(F, H_half, W_half))
   209	            stage1_dit = TiledLTXModel(self.dit, tiler_1)
   210	
   211	        x0_model = X0Model(stage1_dit)
   212	
   213	        output_1 = denoise_loop(
   214	            model=x0_model,
   215	            video_state=video_state,
   216	            audio_state=audio_state,
   217	            video_text_embeds=video_embeds,
   218	            audio_text_embeds=audio_embeds,
   219	            sigmas=sigmas_1,
   220	        )
   221	        if self.low_memory:
   222	            aggressive_cleanup()
   223	
   224	        # --- Upscale (same denorm/upsample/renorm as TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline) ---
   225	        # Strip appended keyframe tokens (multi-anchor with frame_idx>0).
   226	        gen_tokens_1 = output_1.video_latent[:, : F * H_half * W_half, :]
   227	        video_half = self.video_patchifier.unpatchify(gen_tokens_1, (F, H_half, W_half))
   228	        video_mlx = video_half.transpose(0, 2, 3, 4, 1)
   229	        video_denorm = self.vae_encoder.denormalize_latent(video_mlx)
   230	        video_denorm = video_denorm.transpose(0, 4, 1, 2, 3)
   231	        video_upscaled = self.upsampler(video_denorm)
   232	        video_up_mlx = video_upscaled.transpose(0, 2, 3, 4, 1)
   233	        video_upscaled = self.vae_encoder.normalize_latent(video_up_mlx)
   234	        video_upscaled = video_upscaled.transpose(0, 4, 1, 2, 3)
   235	        _materialize(video_upscaled)
   236	
   237	        H_full = H_half * 2
   238	        W_full = W_half * 2
   239	
   240	        # I2V conditioning at full resolution (re-encode at upscaled dims)
   241	        conditionings_2: list = []
   242	        if resolved_images:
   243	            enc_h_full = H_full * 32
   244	            enc_w_full = W_full * 32
   245	            conditionings_2 = combined_image_conditionings(
   246	                resolved_images,
   247	                enc_h=enc_h_full,
   248	                enc_w=enc_w_full,
   249	                spatial_dims=(F, H_full, W_full),
   250	                video_encoder=self.vae_encoder,
   251	            )
   252	
   253	        if self.low_memory:
   254	            self.image_conditioner.free()
   255	            self.upsampler = None
   256	            aggressive_cleanup()
   257	
   258	        # --- Stage 2: full resolution refine (no LoRA swap — already distilled) ---
   259	        video_tokens, _ = self.video_patchifier.patchify(video_upscaled)
   260	        sigmas_2 = STAGE_2_SIGMAS[: stage2_steps + 1] if stage2_steps else STAGE_2_SIGMAS
   261	        start_sigma = sigmas_2[0]
   262	
   263	        video_positions_2 = compute_video_positions(F, H_full, W_full)
   264	
   265	        video_state_2 = create_noised_state(
   266	            base_shape=video_tokens.shape,
   267	            conditionings=conditionings_2,
   268	            spatial_dims=(F, H_full, W_full),
   269	            positions=video_positions_2,
   270	            seed=seed + 2,
   271	            sigma=start_sigma,
   272	            initial_latent=video_tokens,
   273	            legacy_scalar_blend=True,
   274	        )
   275	
   276	        audio_tokens_1 = output_1.audio_latent
   277	        audio_state_2 = create_noised_state(
   278	            base_shape=audio_tokens_1.shape,
   279	            conditionings=[],
   280	            spatial_dims=(F, H_full, W_full),  # unused
   281	            positions=audio_positions,
   282	            seed=seed + 2,
   283	            sigma=start_sigma,
   284	            initial_latent=audio_tokens_1,
   285	        )
   286	
   287	        stage2_x0_model = x0_model
   288	        if self._tile_count is not None:
   289	            from ltx_core_mlx.components.modality_tiling import TiledLTXModel, VideoModalityTiler
   290	
   291	            tiler_2 = VideoModalityTiler(self._tile_count, latent_shape=(F, H_full, W_full))
   292	            stage2_x0_model = X0Model(TiledLTXModel(self.dit, tiler_2))
   293	
   294	        output_2 = denoise_loop(
   295	            model=stage2_x0_model,
   296	            video_state=video_state_2,
   297	            audio_state=audio_state_2,
   298	            video_text_embeds=video_embeds,
   299	            audio_text_embeds=audio_embeds,
   300	            sigmas=sigmas_2,
   301	        )
   302	        if self.low_memory:
   303	            aggressive_cleanup()
   304	
   305	        gen_tokens_2 = output_2.video_latent[:, : F * H_full * W_full, :]
   306	        video_latent = self.video_patchifier.unpatchify(gen_tokens_2, (F, H_full, W_full))
   307	        audio_latent = self.audio_patchifier.unpatchify(output_2.audio_latent)
   308	
   309	        return video_latent, audio_latent

   312	__all__ = ["DistilledPipeline"]
     1	"""Position computation for video and audio tokens.
     2	
     3	Video positions are 3D (time, height, width) in pixel-space with causal fix, time/fps.
     4	Audio positions are 1D (time) in real-time seconds.
     5	"""
     6	
     7	from __future__ import annotations
     8	
     9	import mlx.core as mx
    10	
    11	# VAE scale factors
    12	VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE = 8
    13	VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE = 32
    14	AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR = 4
    15	AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH = 160
    16	AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
    17	AUDIO_LATENTS_PER_SECOND = AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE / AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH / AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR  # 25.0
    18	
    19	
    20	def compute_audio_token_count(num_video_frames: int, fps: float = 24.0) -> int:
    21	    """Compute the number of audio latent tokens for a given video length.
    22	
    23	    Args:
    24	        num_video_frames: Number of pixel frames.
    25	        fps: Video frame rate.
    26	
    27	    Returns:
    28	        Number of audio tokens.
    29	    """
    30	    duration = num_video_frames / fps
    31	    return round(duration * AUDIO_LATENTS_PER_SECOND)
    32	
    33	
    34	def compute_video_positions(
    35	    num_frames: int,
    36	    height: int,
    37	    width: int,
    38	    fps: float = 24.0,
    39	) -> mx.array:
    40	    """Compute 3D positions for video tokens in pixel-space with causal fix.
    41	
    42	    Matches reference: get_pixel_coords(causal_fix=True) -> midpoints -> temporal/fps.
    43	
    44	    Args:
    45	        num_frames: Number of latent frames F.
    46	        height: Latent height H.
    47	        width: Latent width W.
    48	        fps: Video frame rate (default 24.0).
    49	
    50	    Returns:
    51	        positions: (1, F*H*W, 3) float32 positions [time, height, width].
    52	    """
    53	    # Temporal: pixel coords with causal fix
    54	    # latent frame i -> pixel range [max(0, i*8 + 1 - 8), (i+1)*8 + 1 - 8]
    55	    #                             = [max(0, (i-1)*8 + 1), i*8 + 1]
    56	    # Midpoint = (start + end) / 2, then divide by fps
    57	    idx = mx.arange(num_frames).astype(mx.float32)
    58	    f_starts = mx.maximum(idx * VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE + 1 - VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE, 0.0)
    59	    f_ends = mx.maximum((idx + 1) * VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE + 1 - VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE, 0.0)
    60	    f_mids = (f_starts + f_ends) / 2.0 / fps
    61	
    62	    # Spatial: simple pixel midpoints (no causal fix)
    63	    # latent h -> pixel range [h*32, (h+1)*32], midpoint = h*32 + 16
    64	    h_mids = mx.arange(height).astype(mx.float32) * VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE + VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE / 2.0
    65	    w_mids = mx.arange(width).astype(mx.float32) * VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE + VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE / 2.0
    66	
    67	    # Build 3D meshgrid
    68	    f_grid = mx.repeat(mx.repeat(f_mids[:, None, None], height, axis=1), width, axis=2)
    69	    h_grid = mx.repeat(mx.repeat(h_mids[None, :, None], num_frames, axis=0), width, axis=2)
    70	    w_grid = mx.repeat(mx.repeat(w_mids[None, None, :], num_frames, axis=0), height, axis=1)
    71	
    72	    # Stack and flatten: (F, H, W, 3) -> (1, F*H*W, 3)
    73	    positions = mx.stack([f_grid, h_grid, w_grid], axis=-1).reshape(-1, 3)
    74	    return positions[None, :, :].astype(mx.float32)
    75	
    76	
    77	def compute_audio_positions(
    78	    num_tokens: int,
    79	) -> mx.array:
    80	    """Compute 1D positions for audio tokens in real-time seconds.
    81	
    82	    Matches reference _compute_audio_timings with causal=True.
    83	
    84	    Args:
    85	        num_tokens: Number of audio tokens T.
    86	
    87	    Returns:
    88	        positions: (1, T, 1) float32 positions in seconds.
    89	    """
    90	    # Reference: _get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(idx, shift=0):
    91	    #   audio_mel_frame = idx * downsample_factor
    92	    #   causal: audio_mel_frame = (audio_mel_frame + 1 - downsample_factor).clip(min=0)
    93	    #   time = audio_mel_frame * hop_length / sample_rate
    94	    # For token i: start = _get(i), end = _get(i+1)
    95	    # Midpoint = (start + end) / 2
    96	    idx = mx.arange(num_tokens).astype(mx.float32)
    97	    starts = (
    98	        mx.maximum(idx * AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR + 1 - AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR, 0.0)
    99	        * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH
   100	        / AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
   101	    )
   102	    ends = (
   103	        mx.maximum((idx + 1) * AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR + 1 - AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR, 0.0)
   104	        * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH
   105	        / AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
   106	    )
   107	    mids = (starts + ends) / 2.0
   108	
   109	    return mids[None, :, None]

// LTX2Attention.swift — Multi-head attention with QK-RMSNorm and optional gating
// Phase 3 of the LTX-2 Swift/MLX port
//
// Supports both self-attention and cross-attention. Key features:
// - Q/K normalization via RMSNorm before RoPE application
// - Optional per-head gate logits (LTX-2.3) for output modulation
// - RoPE applied after QK-norm, before attention computation
// - Cross-attention: Q from hidden states, K/V from context (no RoPE)
// - Skip-attention mode for STG perturbation (bypasses Q*K*V)
//
// Reference: attention.py class Attention

import Foundation
import MLX
import MLXFast
import MLXNN

/// Multi-head attention with QK-RMSNorm, RoPE, and optional per-head gating.
///
/// Weight key mapping:
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.to_q.weight`, `.bias` (self-attention Q)
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.to_k.weight`, `.bias` (self-attention K)
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.to_v.weight`, `.bias` (self-attention V)
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.to_out.weight`, `.bias` (self-attention output)
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.q_norm.weight` (Q RMSNorm)
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.k_norm.weight` (K RMSNorm)
/// - `transformer_blocks.N.attn1.to_gate_logits.weight`, `.bias` (optional)
/// - Same pattern for `attn2` (cross-attention)
public final class LTX2Attention: Module {
  let numHeads: Int
  let headDim: Int
  let ropeMode: LTX2RoPEMode

  @ModuleInfo(key: "to_q") var toQ: Linear
  @ModuleInfo(key: "to_k") var toK: Linear
  @ModuleInfo(key: "to_v") var toV: Linear
  @ModuleInfo(key: "to_out") var toOut: Linear
  @ModuleInfo(key: "q_norm") var qNorm: RMSNorm
  @ModuleInfo(key: "k_norm") var kNorm: RMSNorm
  @ModuleInfo(key: "to_gate_logits") var toGateLogits: Linear?

  let hasGateLogits: Bool

  /// Initialize the attention module.
  ///
  /// - Parameters:
  ///   - queryDim: Dimension of query input.
  ///   - contextDim: Dimension of context input for cross-attention. Nil for self-attention.
  ///   - heads: Number of attention heads. Default 32.
  ///   - dimHead: Dimension per head. Default 128.
  ///   - normEps: Epsilon for RMSNorm. Default 1e-6.
  ///   - ropeMode: RoPE mode. Default `.split`.
  ///   - hasGateLogits: Whether to use per-head gate logits. Default false.
  public init(
    queryDim: Int,
    contextDim: Int? = nil,
    heads: Int = 32,
    dimHead: Int = 128,
    normEps: Float = 1e-6,
    ropeMode: LTX2RoPEMode = .split,
    hasGateLogits: Bool = false
  ) {
    self.numHeads = heads
    self.headDim = dimHead
    self.ropeMode = ropeMode
    self.hasGateLogits = hasGateLogits

    let innerDim = dimHead * heads
    let ctxDim = contextDim ?? queryDim

    self._toQ.wrappedValue = Linear(queryDim, innerDim, bias: true)
    self._toK.wrappedValue = Linear(ctxDim, innerDim, bias: true)
    self._toV.wrappedValue = Linear(ctxDim, innerDim, bias: true)
    self._toOut.wrappedValue = Linear(innerDim, queryDim, bias: true)

    self._qNorm.wrappedValue = RMSNorm(dimensions: innerDim, eps: normEps)
    self._kNorm.wrappedValue = RMSNorm(dimensions: innerDim, eps: normEps)

    if hasGateLogits {
      self._toGateLogits.wrappedValue = Linear(queryDim, heads, bias: true)
    }
  }

  /// Forward pass.
  ///
  /// - Parameters:
  ///   - x: Query input `(B, seqLen, queryDim)`.
  ///   - context: Context for cross-attention. If nil, uses x (self-attention).
  ///   - mask: Optional attention mask.
  ///   - pe: Position embeddings `(cos, sin)` for Q (and K if kPE is nil).
  ///   - kPE: Optional separate position embeddings for K.
  ///   - skipAttention: If true, bypass Q*K*V and use V only (STG perturbation).
  /// - Returns: Attention output `(B, seqLen, queryDim)`.
  public func callAsFunction(
    _ x: MLXArray,
    context: MLXArray? = nil,
    mask: MLXArray? = nil,
    pe: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray)? = nil,
    kPE: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray)? = nil,
    skipAttention: Bool = false
  ) -> MLXArray {
    let b = x.dim(0)
    let qSeqLen = x.dim(1)

    // Compute per-head gate early (from original input, before context mixing)
    var gate: MLXArray? = nil
    if hasGateLogits, let gateProj = toGateLogits {
      gate = 2.0 * sigmoid(gateProj(x))  // (B, seqLen, heads)
    }

    let ctx = context ?? x
    let v = toV(ctx)

    let out: MLXArray
    if skipAttention {
      // STG: bypass Q*K*V, use V only
      out = v
    } else {
      // Standard attention
      var q = qNorm(toQ(x))
      var k = kNorm(toK(ctx))

      // Reshape to per-head: (B, T, H*D) -> (B, T, H, D) -> (B, H, T, D)
      let kvSeqLen = ctx.dim(1)
      var qH = q.reshaped(b, qSeqLen, numHeads, headDim).transposed(0, 2, 1, 3)
      var kH = k.reshaped(b, kvSeqLen, numHeads, headDim).transposed(0, 2, 1, 3)
      let vH = v.reshaped(b, kvSeqLen, numHeads, headDim).transposed(0, 2, 1, 3)

      // Apply RoPE to Q and K if provided
      if let pe = pe {
        qH = ltx2ApplyRoPE(qH, freqsCIS: pe, mode: ropeMode)
        let kFreqs = kPE ?? pe
        kH = ltx2ApplyRoPE(kH, freqsCIS: kFreqs, mode: ropeMode)
      }

      // Scaled dot-product attention
      let scale = 1.0 / Float(headDim).squareRoot()

      var attnMask: MLXArray? = mask
      if let m = attnMask {
        // Ensure mask has batch and head dimensions
        var expanded = m
        if expanded.ndim == 2 {
          expanded = expanded.expandedDimensions(axis: 0)
        }
        if expanded.ndim == 3 {
          expanded = expanded.expandedDimensions(axis: 1)
        }
        attnMask = expanded
      }

      // Query-tiled attention (#37): at very long sequences (289f refine ≈
      // 53,872 tokens) the SDPA kernel's token×token index overflows int32
      // (same class as the conv/decode bug) and the process aborts. Splitting
      // the QUERIES into blocks — each attending to the FULL K/V set — keeps
      // every kernel call's qBlock×kv product under 2^31. This is exact (no
      // online softmax needed: each block's softmax is over the complete key
      // axis), so it's numerically identical to a single call, zero seams.
      // Threshold well below the 2^31/kv boundary; disabled at normal lengths.
      let attnProduct = qSeqLen * kvSeqLen
      let tileThreshold = 1_500_000_000  // < 2^31, margin for head batching
      let attnOut: MLXArray
      if attnProduct > tileThreshold {
        let maxQ = max(1, tileThreshold / max(kvSeqLen, 1))
        var blocks: [MLXArray] = []
        var qs = 0
        while qs < qSeqLen {
          let qe = min(qs + maxQ, qSeqLen)
          let qBlock = qH[0..., 0..., qs..<qe, 0...]
          let mBlock: MLXArray? = attnMask  // key-axis mask applies to every query block
          let ob = MLXFast.scaledDotProductAttention(
            queries: qBlock, keys: kH, values: vH, scale: scale, mask: mBlock)
          eval(ob)
          blocks.append(ob)
          qs = qe
        }
        attnOut = blocks.count == 1 ? blocks[0] : MLX.concatenated(blocks, axis: 2)
      } else {
        attnOut = MLXFast.scaledDotProductAttention(
          queries: qH, keys: kH, values: vH,
          scale: scale,
          mask: attnMask
        )
      }

      // Reshape back: (B, H, T, D) -> (B, T, H*D)
      out = attnOut.transposed(0, 2, 1, 3).reshaped(b, qSeqLen, numHeads * headDim)
    }

    // Apply per-head gating (LTX-2.3)
    var gatedOut = out
    if let gate = gate {
      gatedOut = gatedOut.reshaped(b, qSeqLen, numHeads, headDim)
      gatedOut = gatedOut * gate.expandedDimensions(axis: -1)
      gatedOut = gatedOut.reshaped(b, qSeqLen, -1)
    }

    return toOut(gatedOut)
  }
}

   101	  ) -> MLXArray {
   102	    let b = x.dim(0)
   103	    let qSeqLen = x.dim(1)
   104	
   105	    // Compute per-head gate early (from original input, before context mixing)
   106	    var gate: MLXArray? = nil
   107	    if hasGateLogits, let gateProj = toGateLogits {
   108	      gate = 2.0 * sigmoid(gateProj(x))  // (B, seqLen, heads)
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    let ctx = context ?? x
   112	    let v = toV(ctx)
   113	
   114	    let out: MLXArray
   115	    if skipAttention {
   116	      // STG: bypass Q*K*V, use V only
   117	      out = v
   118	    } else {
   119	      // Standard attention
   120	      var q = qNorm(toQ(x))
   121	      var k = kNorm(toK(ctx))
   122	
   123	      // Reshape to per-head: (B, T, H*D) -> (B, T, H, D) -> (B, H, T, D)
   124	      let kvSeqLen = ctx.dim(1)
   125	      var qH = q.reshaped(b, qSeqLen, numHeads, headDim).transposed(0, 2, 1, 3)
   126	      var kH = k.reshaped(b, kvSeqLen, numHeads, headDim).transposed(0, 2, 1, 3)
   127	      let vH = v.reshaped(b, kvSeqLen, numHeads, headDim).transposed(0, 2, 1, 3)
   128	
   129	      // Apply RoPE to Q and K if provided
   130	      if let pe = pe {
   131	        qH = ltx2ApplyRoPE(qH, freqsCIS: pe, mode: ropeMode)
   132	        let kFreqs = kPE ?? pe
   133	        kH = ltx2ApplyRoPE(kH, freqsCIS: kFreqs, mode: ropeMode)
   134	      }
   135	
   136	      // Scaled dot-product attention
   137	      let scale = 1.0 / Float(headDim).squareRoot()
   138	
   139	      var attnMask: MLXArray? = mask
   140	      if let m = attnMask {
   141	        // Ensure mask has batch and head dimensions
   142	        var expanded = m
   143	        if expanded.ndim == 2 {
   144	          expanded = expanded.expandedDimensions(axis: 0)
   145	        }
   146	        if expanded.ndim == 3 {
   147	          expanded = expanded.expandedDimensions(axis: 1)
   148	        }
   149	        attnMask = expanded
   150	      }
   151	
   152	      // Query-tiled attention (#37): at very long sequences (289f refine ≈
   153	      // 53,872 tokens) the SDPA kernel's token×token index overflows int32
   154	      // (same class as the conv/decode bug) and the process aborts. Splitting
   155	      // the QUERIES into blocks — each attending to the FULL K/V set — keeps
   165	
   166	  /// Weight-free RMSNorm over the audio hidden width.
   167	  private func audioRMSNorm(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   168	    MLXFast.rmsNorm(x, weight: audioRmsNormOnes, eps: normEps)
   169	  }
   170	
   171	  /// Dual-stream forward: run the video sub-steps (self-attn, text cross-attn,
   172	  /// FF) alongside the audio sub-steps and the bidirectional a2v/v2a cross-modal
   173	  /// attention, returning updated `(video, audio)`.
   174	  ///
   175	  /// PARITY DEFERRED: the module *structure* (and thus weight loading) is exact,
   176	  /// but the precise interleaving / AdaLN composition of the reference dual-stream
   177	  /// block is not numerically validated here (no reference on-box). The video-only
   178	  /// `callAsFunction` above is unchanged and remains the verified path.
   179	  ///
   180	  /// - Parameters:
   181	  ///   - video: Video hidden states `(B, T_v, dim)`.
   182	  ///   - audio: Audio hidden states `(B, T_a, audioDim)`.
   183	  ///   - context: Video text embeddings.
   184	  ///   - audioContext: Audio text embeddings `(B, S_a, audioDim)`.
   185	  ///   - timestep: Video timestep embedding `(B, 1, 9*dim)`.
   186	  ///   - audioTimestep: Audio timestep embedding `(B, 1, 9*audioDim)`.
   187	  ///   - pe: Video RoPE.
   188	  ///   - audioPE: Audio RoPE.
   189	  public func callDualStream(
   190	    video: MLXArray,
   191	    audio: MLXArray,
   192	    context: MLXArray,
   193	    audioContext: MLXArray,
   194	    contextMask: MLXArray? = nil,
   195	    audioContextMask: MLXArray? = nil,
   196	    timestep: MLXArray,
   197	    audioTimestep: MLXArray,
   198	    pe: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray)? = nil,
   199	    audioPE: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray)? = nil,
   200	    promptTimestep: MLXArray? = nil,
   201	    audioPromptTimestep: MLXArray? = nil
   202	  ) -> (video: MLXArray, audio: MLXArray) {
   203	    precondition(hasAudio, "callDualStream requires hasAudio")
   204	    let b = video.dim(0)
   205	
   206	    // ---- Video stream: self-attn, text cross-attn (reuse video sub-logic) ----
   207	    var v = video
   208	    let vMSA = getAdaValues(table: scaleShiftTable, batchSize: b, timestep: timestep, range: 0..<3)
   209	    var vNorm = weightFreeRMSNorm(v) * (1 + vMSA[1]) + vMSA[0]
   210	    v = v + attn1(vNorm, pe: pe) * vMSA[2]
   211	
   212	    let vCross = getAdaValues(table: scaleShiftTable, batchSize: b, timestep: timestep, range: 6..<9)
   213	    var vCtx = context
   214	    if let pTS = promptTimestep, let pTable = promptScaleShiftTable {
   215	      let pp = getAdaValues(table: pTable, batchSize: b, timestep: pTS, range: 0..<2)
   216	      vCtx = context * (1 + pp[1]) + pp[0]
   217	    }
   218	    v = v + attn2(weightFreeRMSNorm(v) * (1 + vCross[1]) + vCross[0],
   219	                  context: vCtx, mask: contextMask) * vCross[2]
   220	
   221	    // ---- Audio stream: self-attn, text cross-attn ----
   222	    var a = audio
   223	    let aMSA = getAdaValues(table: audioScaleShiftTable!, batchSize: b, timestep: audioTimestep, range: 0..<3)
   224	    a = a + audioAttn1!(audioRMSNorm(a) * (1 + aMSA[1]) + aMSA[0], pe: audioPE) * aMSA[2]
   225	
   226	    let aCross = getAdaValues(table: audioScaleShiftTable!, batchSize: b, timestep: audioTimestep, range: 6..<9)
   227	    var aCtx = audioContext
   228	    if let pTS = audioPromptTimestep, let pTable = audioPromptScaleShiftTable {
   229	      let pp = getAdaValues(table: pTable, batchSize: b, timestep: pTS, range: 0..<2)
   230	      aCtx = audioContext * (1 + pp[1]) + pp[0]
   231	    }
   232	    a = a + audioAttn2!(audioRMSNorm(a) * (1 + aCross[1]) + aCross[0],
   233	                        context: aCtx, mask: audioContextMask) * aCross[2]
   234	
   235	    // ---- Cross-modal: A2V (update video from audio) + V2A (update audio) ----
   236	    // NOTE (parity deferred): the reference conditions this gating on the
   237	    // top-level av_ca_*_adaln_single timestep modules; here we use the per-block
   238	    // scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_* rows directly (shift/scale/gate = rows 0/1/2 of
   239	    // the [5, dim] table). Shape-correct and runs; timestep-conditioned av_ca is
   240	    // wired in the generateAV pipeline step (not yet landed).
   241	    let vShift = scaleShiftTableA2VCaVideo![0].reshaped(1, 1, -1)
   242	    let vScale = scaleShiftTableA2VCaVideo![1].reshaped(1, 1, -1)
   243	    let vGate = scaleShiftTableA2VCaVideo![2].reshaped(1, 1, -1)
   244	    v = v + audioToVideoAttn!(weightFreeRMSNorm(v) * (1 + vScale) + vShift,
   245	                              context: audioRMSNorm(a)) * vGate
   246	    let aShift = scaleShiftTableA2VCaAudio![0].reshaped(1, 1, -1)
   247	    let aScale = scaleShiftTableA2VCaAudio![1].reshaped(1, 1, -1)
   248	    let aGate = scaleShiftTableA2VCaAudio![2].reshaped(1, 1, -1)
   249	    a = a + videoToAudioAttn!(audioRMSNorm(a) * (1 + aScale) + aShift,
   250	                              context: weightFreeRMSNorm(v)) * aGate
   251	
   252	    // ---- Feed-forward on both streams ----
   253	    let vMLP = getAdaValues(table: scaleShiftTable, batchSize: b, timestep: timestep, range: 3..<6)
   254	    v = v + ff(weightFreeRMSNorm(v) * (1 + vMLP[1]) + vMLP[0]) * vMLP[2]
   255	    let aMLP = getAdaValues(table: audioScaleShiftTable!, batchSize: b, timestep: audioTimestep, range: 3..<6)
   256	    a = a + audioFF!(audioRMSNorm(a) * (1 + aMLP[1]) + aMLP[0]) * aMLP[2]
   257	
   258	    return (v, a)
   259	  }

    88	  /// Encode a tokenized input to video and audio embeddings.
    89	  ///
    90	  /// This is the main encoding function that takes pre-tokenized input
    91	  /// (input IDs and attention mask) and runs the full pipeline.
    92	  ///
    93	  /// - Parameters:

    98	  public func encode(

   100	    attentionMask: MLXArray,
   101	    returnAudioEmbeddings: Bool = true
   102	  ) -> LTX2TextEncoderOutput {
   103	    // Step 1: Gemma 3 forward pass — extract ALL hidden states

   142	        audioEmbeddings = audioOut

   145	      }
   146	
   147	    } else {
   148	      // LTX-2 original: V1 feature extraction with shared features
   149	      guard let extractor = featureExtractorV1 else {

   151	      }
   152	
   153	      let features = extractor(
   154	        hiddenStates: allHiddenStates,
   155	        attentionMask: attentionMask
   156	      )
   157	
   158	      let additiveMask = buildAdditiveMask(
   159	        attentionMask: attentionMask, dtype: features.dtype)
   160	
   161	      let (videoOut, _) = videoConnector(
   162	        hiddenStates: features, attentionMask: additiveMask)
   163	      videoEmbeddings = videoOut
   164	
   165	      if returnAudioEmbeddings {
   166	        let (audioOut, _) = audioConnector(
   167	          hiddenStates: features, attentionMask: additiveMask)
   168	        audioEmbeddings = audioOut
   169	      } else {
   170	        audioEmbeddings = MLX.zeros([inputIds.dim(0), inputIds.dim(1), config.audioDim])
   171	      }
   172	    }
   173	
   174	    return LTX2TextEncoderOutput(
   175	      videoEmbeddings: videoEmbeddings,
   176	      audioEmbeddings: audioEmbeddings,
   177	      attentionMask: attentionMask
   178	    )

    57	// MARK: - V2 Feature Extractor
    58	
    59	/// V2 feature extractor (LTX-2.3): per-token RMSNorm + rescale normalization
    60	/// with separate video and audio projection heads.
    61	///
    62	/// Process:
    63	/// 1. Stack hidden states: (B, T, D, L)
    64	/// 2. Per-token RMSNorm across hidden dimension
    65	/// 3. Flatten: (B, T, D*L)
    66	/// 4. Rescale: x * sqrt(target_dim / embedding_dim)
    67	/// 5. Project through video or audio linear head
    68	///
    69	/// Weight key mapping:
    70	/// - `video_aggregate_embed.weight`, `video_aggregate_embed.bias`
    71	/// - `audio_aggregate_embed.weight`, `audio_aggregate_embed.bias`
    72	public final class LTX2FeatureExtractorV2: Module {
    73	  let embeddingDim: Int
    74	
    75	  @ModuleInfo(key: "video_aggregate_embed") var videoAggregateEmbed: Linear
    76	  @ModuleInfo(key: "audio_aggregate_embed") var audioAggregateEmbed: Linear
    77	
    78	  public init(config: LTX2FeatureExtractorConfig) {
    79	    self.embeddingDim = config.embeddingDim
    80	    self._videoAggregateEmbed.wrappedValue = Linear(
    81	      config.inputDim, config.videoOutputDim, bias: config.bias)
    82	    self._audioAggregateEmbed.wrappedValue = Linear(
    83	      config.inputDim, config.audioOutputDim, bias: config.bias)
    84	  }
    85	
    86	  /// Extract video features from hidden states.
    87	  ///
    88	  /// - Parameters:
    89	  ///   - hiddenStates: List of hidden state arrays, each `[B, T, D]`.
    90	  ///   - attentionMask: Binary attention mask `[B, T]` (1 = valid, 0 = pad).
    91	  /// - Returns: Projected video features `[B, T, videoOutputDim]`.
    92	  public func videoFeatures(
    93	    hiddenStates: [MLXArray],
    94	    attentionMask: MLXArray
    95	  ) -> MLXArray {
    96	    let normed = LTX2FeatureExtractor.normAndConcatPerTokenRMS(
    97	      hiddenStates: hiddenStates,
    98	      attentionMask: attentionMask
    99	    )
   100	    let targetDim = videoAggregateEmbed.weight.dim(0)
   101	    let rescaled = LTX2FeatureExtractor.rescaleNorm(
   102	      normed, targetDim: targetDim, sourceDim: embeddingDim)
   103	    return videoAggregateEmbed(rescaled)
   104	  }
   105	
   106	  /// Extract audio features from hidden states.
   107	  ///
   108	  /// - Parameters:
   109	  ///   - hiddenStates: List of hidden state arrays, each `[B, T, D]`.
   110	  ///   - attentionMask: Binary attention mask `[B, T]` (1 = valid, 0 = pad).
   111	  /// - Returns: Projected audio features `[B, T, audioOutputDim]`.
   112	  public func audioFeatures(
   113	    hiddenStates: [MLXArray],
   114	    attentionMask: MLXArray
   115	  ) -> MLXArray {
   116	    let normed = LTX2FeatureExtractor.normAndConcatPerTokenRMS(
   117	      hiddenStates: hiddenStates,
   118	      attentionMask: attentionMask
   119	    )
   120	    let targetDim = audioAggregateEmbed.weight.dim(0)
   121	    let rescaled = LTX2FeatureExtractor.rescaleNorm(
   122	      normed, targetDim: targetDim, sourceDim: embeddingDim)
   123	    return audioAggregateEmbed(rescaled)
   124	  }
   125	}

   326	                gate_out_a2v = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_video[4:, :], vx.shape[0], v_cross_gate_timestep)[0]
   327	                vx.addcmul_(a2v_out, gate_out_a2v)
   328	                del gate_out_a2v, a2v_out
   329	
   330	            # video to audio cross attention
   331	            if run_v2a:
   332	                scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a = self.get_ada_values(
   333	                    self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_audio[:4, :], ax.shape[0], a_cross_scale_shift_timestep)[2:4]
   334	                scale_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a = self.get_ada_values(
   335	                    self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_video[:4, :], vx.shape[0], v_cross_scale_shift_timestep)[2:4]
   336	
   337	                ax_scaled = ax_norm3 * (1 + scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a) + shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a
   338	                vx_scaled = vx_norm3 * (1 + scale_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a) + shift_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a
   339	                del scale_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_video_hidden_states_v2a, scale_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a, shift_ca_audio_hidden_states_v2a
   340	
   341	                v2a_out = self.video_to_audio_attn(ax_scaled, context=vx_scaled, pe=a_cross_pe, k_pe=v_cross_pe, transformer_options=transformer_options)
   342	                del ax_scaled, vx_scaled
   343	
   344	                gate_out_v2a = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table_a2v_ca_audio[4:, :], ax.shape[0], a_cross_gate_timestep)[0]
   345	                ax.addcmul_(v2a_out, gate_out_v2a)
   346	                del gate_out_v2a, v2a_out
   347	
   348	            del vx_norm3, ax_norm3
   349	
   350	        # video feedforward
   351	        if run_vx:
   352	            vshift_mlp, vscale_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table, vx.shape[0], v_timestep, slice(3, 5))
   353	            vx_scaled = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(vx) * (1 + vscale_mlp) + vshift_mlp
   354	            del vshift_mlp, vscale_mlp
   355	
   356	            ff_out = self.ff(vx_scaled)
   357	            del vx_scaled
   358	
   359	            vgate_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.scale_shift_table, vx.shape[0], v_timestep, slice(5, 6))[0]
   360	            vx.addcmul_(ff_out, vgate_mlp)
   361	            del vgate_mlp, ff_out
   362	
   363	        # audio feedforward
   364	        if run_ax:
   365	            ashift_mlp, ascale_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.audio_scale_shift_table, ax.shape[0], a_timestep, slice(3, 5))
   366	            ax_scaled = comfy.ldm.common_dit.rms_norm(ax) * (1 + ascale_mlp) + ashift_mlp
   367	            del ashift_mlp, ascale_mlp
   368	
   369	            ff_out = self.audio_ff(ax_scaled)
   370	            del ax_scaled
   371	
   372	            agate_mlp = self.get_ada_values(self.audio_scale_shift_table, ax.shape[0], a_timestep, slice(5, 6))[0]
   373	            ax.addcmul_(ff_out, agate_mlp)
   374	            del agate_mlp, ff_out
   375	
   740	            v_patches_per_frame = orig_shape[3] * orig_shape[4]
   741	
   742	        # Reshape to [batch_size, num_tokens, dim] and compress for storage
   743	        v_timestep = CompressedTimestep(v_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, v_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame)
   744	        v_embedded_timestep = CompressedTimestep(v_embedded_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, v_embedded_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame)
   745	
   746	        v_prompt_timestep = compute_prompt_timestep(
   747	            self.prompt_adaln_single, timestep_scaled, batch_size, hidden_dtype
   748	        )
   749	
   750	        # Prepare audio timestep
   751	        a_timestep = kwargs.get("a_timestep")
   752	        ref_audio_seq_len = kwargs.get("ref_audio_seq_len", 0)
   753	        if ref_audio_seq_len > 0 and a_timestep is not None:
   754	            # Reference tokens must have timestep=0, expand scalar/1D timestep to per-token so ref=0 and target=sigma.
   755	            target_len = kwargs.get("target_audio_seq_len")
   756	            if a_timestep.dim() <= 1:
   757	                a_timestep = a_timestep.view(-1, 1).expand(batch_size, target_len)
   758	            ref_ts = torch.zeros(batch_size, ref_audio_seq_len, *a_timestep.shape[2:], device=a_timestep.device, dtype=a_timestep.dtype)
   759	            a_timestep = torch.cat([ref_ts, a_timestep], dim=1)
   760	        if a_timestep is not None:
   761	            a_timestep_scaled = a_timestep * self.timestep_scale_multiplier
   762	            a_timestep_flat = a_timestep_scaled.flatten()
   763	            timestep_flat = timestep_scaled.flatten()
   764	            av_ca_factor = self.av_ca_timestep_scale_multiplier / self.timestep_scale_multiplier
   765	
   766	            # Cross-attention timesteps - compress these too
   767	            av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_audio_scale_shift_adaln_single(
   768	                timestep.max().expand_as(a_timestep_flat),
   769	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   770	                batch_size=batch_size,
   771	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   772	            )
   773	            av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_video_scale_shift_adaln_single(
   774	                a_timestep.max().expand_as(timestep_flat),
   775	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   776	                batch_size=batch_size,
   777	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   778	            )
   779	            av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_a2v_gate_adaln_single(
   780	                a_timestep.max().expand_as(timestep_flat) * av_ca_factor,
   781	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   782	                batch_size=batch_size,
   783	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   784	            )
   785	            av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep, _ = self.av_ca_v2a_gate_adaln_single(
   786	                timestep.max().expand_as(a_timestep_flat) * av_ca_factor,
   787	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   788	                batch_size=batch_size,
   789	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   790	            )
   791	
   792	            # Compress cross-attention timesteps (only video side, audio is too small to benefit)
   793	            # v_patches_per_frame is None for spatial masks, set for temporal masks or no mask
   794	            cross_av_timestep_ss = [
   795	                av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_audio_scale_shift_timestep.shape[-1]),
   796	                CompressedTimestep(av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_video_scale_shift_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame),  # video - compressed if possible
   797	                CompressedTimestep(av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_a2v_gate_noise_timestep.shape[-1]), v_patches_per_frame),  # video - compressed if possible
   798	                av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, av_ca_v2a_gate_noise_timestep.shape[-1]),
   799	            ]
   800	
   801	            a_timestep, a_embedded_timestep = self.audio_adaln_single(
   802	                a_timestep_flat,
   803	                {"resolution": None, "aspect_ratio": None},
   804	                batch_size=batch_size,
   805	                hidden_dtype=hidden_dtype,
   806	            )
   807	            # Audio timesteps
   808	            a_timestep = a_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, a_timestep.shape[-1])
   809	            a_embedded_timestep = a_embedded_timestep.view(batch_size, -1, a_embedded_timestep.shape[-1])
   810	
   811	            a_prompt_timestep = compute_prompt_timestep(
   812	                self.audio_prompt_adaln_single, a_timestep_scaled, batch_size, hidden_dtype
   813	            )
   814	        else:
   815	            a_timestep = timestep_scaled
   816	            a_embedded_timestep = kwargs.get("embedded_timestep")
   817	            cross_av_timestep_ss = []
   818	            a_prompt_timestep = None
   819	
   820	        return [v_timestep, a_timestep, cross_av_timestep_ss, v_prompt_timestep, a_prompt_timestep], [
   821	            v_embedded_timestep,
   822	            a_embedded_timestep,
   823	        ], None
   824	
   825	    def _prepare_context(self, context, batch_size, x, attention_mask=None):
   826	        vx = x[0]
   827	        ax = x[1]
   828	        video_dim = vx.shape[-1]
   829	        audio_dim = ax.shape[-1]
   830	
   831	        v_context_dim = self.caption_channels if self.caption_proj_before_connector is False else video_dim
   832	        a_context_dim = self.caption_channels if self.caption_proj_before_connector is False else audio_dim
   833	
   834	        v_context, a_context = torch.split(
   835	            context, [v_context_dim, a_context_dim], len(context.shape) - 1
   836	        )
   837	
   838	        v_context, attention_mask = super()._prepare_context(
   839	            v_context, batch_size, vx, attention_mask
   840	        )
   841	        if self.caption_proj_before_connector is False:
   842	            a_context = self.audio_caption_projection(a_context)
   843	        a_context = a_context.view(batch_size, -1, audio_dim)
   844	
   845	        return [v_context, a_context], attention_mask

   847	    def _prepare_positional_embeddings(self, pixel_coords, frame_rate, x_dtype):
   848	        v_pixel_coords = pixel_coords[0]
   849	        v_pe = super()._prepare_positional_embeddings(v_pixel_coords, frame_rate, x_dtype)
   850	
   851	        a_latent_coords = pixel_coords[1]
   852	        a_pe = self._precompute_freqs_cis(
   853	            a_latent_coords,
   854	            dim=self.audio_inner_dim,
   855	            out_dtype=x_dtype,
   856	            max_pos=self.audio_positional_embedding_max_pos,
   857	            use_middle_indices_grid=self.use_middle_indices_grid,
   858	            num_attention_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   859	        )
   860	
   861	        # calculate positional embeddings for the middle of the token duration, to use in av cross attention layers.
   862	        max_pos = max(
   863	            self.positional_embedding_max_pos[0], self.audio_positional_embedding_max_pos[0]
   864	        )
   865	        v_pixel_coords = v_pixel_coords.to(torch.float32)
   866	        v_pixel_coords[:, 0] = v_pixel_coords[:, 0] * (1.0 / frame_rate)
   867	        av_cross_video_freq_cis = self._precompute_freqs_cis(
   868	            v_pixel_coords[:, 0:1, :],
   869	            dim=self.audio_cross_attention_dim,
   870	            out_dtype=x_dtype,
   871	            max_pos=[max_pos],
   872	            use_middle_indices_grid=True,
   873	            num_attention_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   874	        )
   875	        av_cross_audio_freq_cis = self._precompute_freqs_cis(
   876	            a_latent_coords[:, 0:1, :],
   877	            dim=self.audio_cross_attention_dim,
   878	            out_dtype=x_dtype,
   879	            max_pos=[max_pos],
   880	            use_middle_indices_grid=True,
   881	            num_attention_heads=self.audio_num_attention_heads,
   882	        )
   883	
   884	        return [(v_pe, av_cross_video_freq_cis), (a_pe, av_cross_audio_freq_cis)]

     1	"""Position computation for video and audio tokens.
     2	
     3	Video positions are 3D (time, height, width) in pixel-space with causal fix, time/fps.
     4	Audio positions are 1D (time) in real-time seconds.
     5	"""
     6	
     7	from __future__ import annotations
     8	
     9	import mlx.core as mx
    10	
    11	# VAE scale factors
    12	VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE = 8
    13	VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE = 32
    14	AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR = 4
    15	AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH = 160
    16	AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE = 16000
    17	AUDIO_LATENTS_PER_SECOND = AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE / AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH / AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR  # 25.0
    18	
    19	
    20	def compute_audio_token_count(num_video_frames: int, fps: float = 24.0) -> int:
    21	    """Compute the number of audio latent tokens for a given video length.
    22	
    23	    Args:
    24	        num_video_frames: Number of pixel frames.
    25	        fps: Video frame rate.
    26	
    27	    Returns:
    28	        Number of audio tokens.
    29	    """
    30	    duration = num_video_frames / fps
    31	    return round(duration * AUDIO_LATENTS_PER_SECOND)
    32	
    33	
    34	def compute_video_positions(
    35	    num_frames: int,
    36	    height: int,
    37	    width: int,
    38	    fps: float = 24.0,
    39	) -> mx.array:
    40	    """Compute 3D positions for video tokens in pixel-space with causal fix.
    41	
    42	    Matches reference: get_pixel_coords(causal_fix=True) -> midpoints -> temporal/fps.
    43	
    44	    Args:
    45	        num_frames: Number of latent frames F.
    46	        height: Latent height H.
    47	        width: Latent width W.
    48	        fps: Video frame rate (default 24.0).
    49	
    50	    Returns:
    51	        positions: (1, F*H*W, 3) float32 positions [time, height, width].
    52	    """
    53	    # Temporal: pixel coords with causal fix
    54	    # latent frame i -> pixel range [max(0, i*8 + 1 - 8), (i+1)*8 + 1 - 8]
    55	    #                             = [max(0, (i-1)*8 + 1), i*8 + 1]
    56	    # Midpoint = (start + end) / 2, then divide by fps
    57	    idx = mx.arange(num_frames).astype(mx.float32)
    58	    f_starts = mx.maximum(idx * VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE + 1 - VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE, 0.0)
    59	    f_ends = mx.maximum((idx + 1) * VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE + 1 - VIDEO_TEMPORAL_SCALE, 0.0)
    60	    f_mids = (f_starts + f_ends) / 2.0 / fps
    61	
    62	    # Spatial: simple pixel midpoints (no causal fix)
    63	    # latent h -> pixel range [h*32, (h+1)*32], midpoint = h*32 + 16
    64	    h_mids = mx.arange(height).astype(mx.float32) * VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE + VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE / 2.0
    65	    w_mids = mx.arange(width).astype(mx.float32) * VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE + VIDEO_SPATIAL_SCALE / 2.0
    66	
    67	    # Build 3D meshgrid
    68	    f_grid = mx.repeat(mx.repeat(f_mids[:, None, None], height, axis=1), width, axis=2)
    69	    h_grid = mx.repeat(mx.repeat(h_mids[None, :, None], num_frames, axis=0), width, axis=2)
    70	    w_grid = mx.repeat(mx.repeat(w_mids[None, None, :], num_frames, axis=0), height, axis=1)
    71	
    72	    # Stack and flatten: (F, H, W, 3) -> (1, F*H*W, 3)
    73	    positions = mx.stack([f_grid, h_grid, w_grid], axis=-1).reshape(-1, 3)
    74	    return positions[None, :, :].astype(mx.float32)
    75	
    76	
    77	def compute_audio_positions(
    78	    num_tokens: int,
    79	) -> mx.array:
    80	    """Compute 1D positions for audio tokens in real-time seconds.
    81	
    82	    Matches reference _compute_audio_timings with causal=True.
    83	
    84	    Args:
    85	        num_tokens: Number of audio tokens T.
    86	
    87	    Returns:
    88	        positions: (1, T, 1) float32 positions in seconds.
    89	    """
    90	    # Reference: _get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(idx, shift=0):
    91	    #   audio_mel_frame = idx * downsample_factor
    92	    #   causal: audio_mel_frame = (audio_mel_frame + 1 - downsample_factor).clip(min=0)
    93	    #   time = audio_mel_frame * hop_length / sample_rate
    94	    # For token i: start = _get(i), end = _get(i+1)
    95	    # Midpoint = (start + end) / 2
    96	    idx = mx.arange(num_tokens).astype(mx.float32)
    97	    starts = (
    98	        mx.maximum(idx * AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR + 1 - AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR, 0.0)
    99	        * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH
   100	        / AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
   101	    )
   102	    ends = (
   103	        mx.maximum((idx + 1) * AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR + 1 - AUDIO_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR, 0.0)
   104	        * AUDIO_HOP_LENGTH
   105	        / AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
   106	    )
   107	    mids = (starts + ends) / 2.0
   108	
   109	    return mids[None, :, None]

     1	"""Audio VAE Decoder — latent to mel spectrogram.
     2	
     3	Ported from ltx-core/src/ltx_core/model/audio_vae/audio_vae.py
     4	
     5	The audio VAE uses Conv2d (not Conv1d). The latent (B, 8, T, 16) is treated
     6	as a 2D spatial tensor (B, T, 16, 8) in MLX NHWC layout, and the network
     7	upsamples the frequency (16) dimension while keeping time (T) unchanged,
     8	finally producing a (B, T, 64, 2) output reshaped to (B, 2, T, 64) mel.
     9	
    10	Weight key structure (after stripping "audio_vae." prefix):
    11	    conv_in.conv.{weight,bias}             — Conv2d(8, 512, 3x3)
    12	    mid.block_1.conv{1,2}.conv.{w,b}       — ResBlock(512)
    13	    mid.attn_1.{norm,q,k,v,proj_out}.*     — AttnBlock(512)
    14	    mid.block_2.conv{1,2}.conv.{w,b}       — ResBlock(512)
    15	    up.2.block.{0,1,2}.*                   — 3 ResBlocks(512), upsample 512
    16	    up.2.attn.{0,1,2}.*                    — 3 AttnBlocks(512)
    17	    up.2.upsample.conv.conv.{w,b}          — Upsample(512)
    18	    up.1.block.{0,1,2}.*                   — 3 ResBlocks(512→256), upsample 256
    19	    up.1.attn.{0,1,2}.*                    — 3 AttnBlocks(256)
    20	    up.1.upsample.conv.conv.{w,b}          — Upsample(256)
    21	    up.0.block.{0,1,2}.*                   — 3 ResBlocks(256→128), no upsample
    22	    conv_out.conv.{weight,bias}            — Conv2d(128, 2, 3x3)
    23	    per_channel_statistics._mean_of_means  — (128,)
    24	    per_channel_statistics._std_of_means   — (128,)
    25	"""

    33	def pixel_norm(x: mx.array, eps: float = 1e-6) -> mx.array:
    34	    """RMS normalization over the channel dimension (PixelNorm)."""
    35	    return mx.fast.rms_norm(x, weight=None, eps=eps)
