    38	class WrappedConv2d(nn.Module):
    39	    """Conv2d with optional causal (height-axis) padding.
    40	
    41	    Causal mode pads height asymmetrically (all on top, none on bottom)
    42	    matching reference CausalConv2d with causality_axis=HEIGHT.
    43	
    44	    Weight keys become: ``<name>.conv.weight`` / ``<name>.conv.bias``.
    45	    """
    46	
    47	    def __init__(
    48	        self,
    49	        in_channels: int,
    50	        out_channels: int,
    51	        kernel_size: int | tuple[int, int] = 3,
    52	        stride: int | tuple[int, int] = 1,
    53	        padding: int | tuple[int, int] = 1,
    54	        causal: bool = False,
    55	    ):
    56	        super().__init__()
    57	        self._causal = causal
    58	        ks = kernel_size if isinstance(kernel_size, int) else kernel_size[0]
    59	
    60	        if causal and ks > 1:
    61	            # Causal: manual asymmetric height padding, symmetric width padding
    62	            self.conv = nn.Conv2d(
    63	                in_channels,
    64	                out_channels,
    65	                kernel_size=kernel_size,
    66	                stride=stride,
    67	                padding=0,
    68	            )
    69	            self._pad_h_top = ks - 1  # Full causal pad on top
    70	            self._pad_h_bottom = 0
    71	            pw = padding if isinstance(padding, int) else padding[1]
    72	            self._pad_w = pw
    73	        else:
    74	            self.conv = nn.Conv2d(
    75	                in_channels,
    76	                out_channels,
    77	                kernel_size=kernel_size,
    78	                stride=stride,
    79	                padding=padding,
    80	            )
    81	            self._pad_h_top = 0
    82	            self._pad_h_bottom = 0
    83	            self._pad_w = 0
    84	
    85	    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
    86	        if self._causal and (self._pad_h_top > 0 or self._pad_w > 0):
    87	            # NHWC layout: axis 0=B, 1=H, 2=W, 3=C
    88	            x = mx.pad(x, [(0, 0), (self._pad_h_top, self._pad_h_bottom), (self._pad_w, self._pad_w), (0, 0)])
    89	        return self.conv(x)
    90	
    91	
    92	class AudioResBlock(nn.Module):
    93	    """Residual block matching ``up.*.block.*.`` or ``mid.block_*`` weight keys.
    94	
    95	    Keys produced:
    96	        conv1.conv.{weight,bias}
    97	        conv2.conv.{weight,bias}
    98	        nin_shortcut.conv.{weight,bias}   (only when in != out channels)
    99	    """
   100	
   101	    def __init__(self, in_channels: int, out_channels: int | None = None, causal: bool = False):
   102	        super().__init__()
   103	        out_channels = out_channels or in_channels
   104	        self.conv1 = WrappedConv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, causal=causal)
   105	        self.conv2 = WrappedConv2d(out_channels, out_channels, 3, padding=1, causal=causal)
   106	        if in_channels != out_channels:
   107	            self.nin_shortcut = WrappedConv2d(in_channels, out_channels, 1, padding=0)
   108	        else:
   109	            self.nin_shortcut = None
   110	
   111	    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   112	        """x: (B, H, W, C) in MLX NHWC layout."""
   113	        residual = x
   114	        x = pixel_norm(x)
   115	        x = nn.silu(x)
   116	        x = self.conv1(x)
   117	        x = pixel_norm(x)
   118	        x = nn.silu(x)
   119	        x = self.conv2(x)
   120	        if self.nin_shortcut is not None:
   121	            residual = self.nin_shortcut(residual)
   122	        return x + residual
   123	
   124	
   125	class AudioAttnBlock(nn.Module):
   126	    """Self-attention block for audio VAE.
   127	
   128	    Weight keys: norm.{weight,bias}, q.conv.{w,b}, k.conv.{w,b}, v.conv.{w,b}, proj_out.conv.{w,b}
   129	    """
   130	
   131	    def __init__(self, channels: int):
   132	        super().__init__()
   133	        self.norm = nn.GroupNorm(32, channels, pytorch_compatible=True)
   134	        self.q = WrappedConv2d(channels, channels, 1, padding=0)
   135	        self.k = WrappedConv2d(channels, channels, 1, padding=0)
   136	        self.v = WrappedConv2d(channels, channels, 1, padding=0)
   137	        self.proj_out = WrappedConv2d(channels, channels, 1, padding=0)
   138	
   139	    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   140	        """x: (B, H, W, C)"""
   141	        B, H, W, C = x.shape
   142	        residual = x
   143	        h = self.norm(x)
   144	
   145	        q = self.q(h).reshape(B, H * W, C)
   146	        k = self.k(h).reshape(B, H * W, C)
   147	        v = self.v(h).reshape(B, H * W, C)
   148	
   149	        scale = C**-0.5
   150	        attn = (q @ k.transpose(0, 2, 1)) * scale
   151	        attn = mx.softmax(attn, axis=-1)
   152	
   153	        out = (attn @ v).reshape(B, H, W, C)
   154	        out = self.proj_out(out)
   155	        return residual + out
   156	
   157	
   158	class AudioUpsample(nn.Module):
   159	    """2x spatial upsample via nearest interpolation + Conv2d.
   160	
   161	    In causal mode, drops first row after conv to maintain temporal alignment.
   162	
   163	    Key: ``upsample.conv.conv.{weight,bias}``
   164	    """
   165	
   166	    def __init__(self, channels: int, causal: bool = False):
   167	        super().__init__()
   168	        self.conv = WrappedConv2d(channels, channels, 3, padding=1, causal=causal)
   169	        self._causal = causal
   170	
   171	    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   172	        """x: (B, H, W, C)"""
   173	        x = mx.repeat(x, 2, axis=1)
   174	        x = mx.repeat(x, 2, axis=2)
   175	        x = self.conv(x)
   176	        if self._causal:
   177	            x = x[:, 1:, :, :]  # Drop first row for causal alignment
   178	        return x

   181	class AudioUpBlock(nn.Module):
   182	    """One decoder up-stage: N resblocks (with optional per-block attention) + optional upsample.
   183	
   184	    Key prefix: ``up.<idx>.``
   185	    Children:
   186	        block.{0,1,...} — AudioResBlock
   187	        attn.{0,1,...}  — AudioAttnBlock (optional)
   188	        upsample        — AudioUpsample (optional)
   189	    """
   190	
   191	    def __init__(
   192	        self,
   193	        in_channels: int,
   194	        out_channels: int,
   195	        num_blocks: int = 3,
   196	        add_upsample: bool = False,
   197	        add_attention: bool = False,
   198	        causal: bool = False,
   199	    ):
   200	        super().__init__()
   201	        self.block = [
   202	            AudioResBlock(in_channels if i == 0 else out_channels, out_channels, causal=causal)
   203	            for i in range(num_blocks)
   204	        ]
   205	        if add_attention:
   206	            self.attn = [AudioAttnBlock(out_channels) for _ in range(num_blocks)]
   207	        else:
   208	            self.attn = None
   209	        self.upsample = AudioUpsample(out_channels, causal=causal) if add_upsample else None
   210	
   211	    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   212	        for i, blk in enumerate(self.block):
   213	            x = blk(x)
   214	            if self.attn is not None:
   215	                x = self.attn[i](x)
   216	        if self.upsample is not None:
   217	            x = self.upsample(x)
   218	        return x
   219	
   220	
   221	class AudioMidBlock(nn.Module):
   222	    """Mid block: resblock, optional attention, resblock.
   223	
   224	    Keys: mid.block_1, mid.attn_1 (optional), mid.block_2.
   225	    """
   226	
   227	    def __init__(self, channels: int, causal: bool = False, add_attention: bool = False):
   228	        super().__init__()
   229	        self.block_1 = AudioResBlock(channels, causal=causal)
   230	        self.attn_1 = AudioAttnBlock(channels) if add_attention else None
   231	        self.block_2 = AudioResBlock(channels, causal=causal)
   232	
   233	    def __call__(self, x: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   234	        x = self.block_1(x)
   235	        if self.attn_1 is not None:
   236	            x = self.attn_1(x)
   237	        x = self.block_2(x)
   238	        return x
   239	
   240	
   241	class PerChannelStatistics(nn.Module):
   242	    """Per-channel normalization statistics loaded from weights.
   243	
   244	    Safetensors keys have underscore prefix: ``_mean_of_means``, ``_std_of_means``.
   245	    MLX treats underscore-prefixed attrs as private, so we use public names
   246	    and remap during weight loading.
   247	    """
   248	
   249	    def __init__(self, channels: int):
   250	        super().__init__()
   251	        self.mean_of_means = mx.zeros((channels,))
   252	        self.std_of_means = mx.ones((channels,))
   253	
   254	
   255	class AudioVAEDecoder(nn.Module):
   256	    """Audio VAE decoder: latent (B, 8, T, 16) -> mel (B, 2, T', 64).
   257	
   258	    Architecture (reverse order of ``up`` indices — up.2 runs first):
   259	        conv_in  : Conv2d(8, 512, 3)
   260	        mid      : ResBlock(512) + AttnBlock(512) + ResBlock(512)
   261	        up.2     : 3x ResBlock(512) + Upsample  → freq 16→32
   262	        up.1     : 3x ResBlock(512→256) + Upsample → freq 32→64
   263	        up.0     : 3x ResBlock(256→128), no upsample
   264	        conv_out : Conv2d(128, 2, 3)
   265	    """
   266	
   267	    def __init__(self):
   268	        super().__init__()
   269	        # conv_in: 8 input channels (latent C1 dim)
   270	        self.conv_in = WrappedConv2d(8, 512, 3, padding=1, causal=True)
   271	
   272	        # Mid — config: mid_block_add_attention=False for distilled model
   273	        self.mid = AudioMidBlock(512, causal=True, add_attention=False)
   274	
   275	        # Up blocks — stored in list indexed [0, 1, 2] but run in REVERSE order
   276	        # Config: attn_resolutions=[] → no attention in any up block
   277	        # up.0: 256→128, no upsample
   278	        # up.1: 512→256, upsample
   279	        # up.2: 512→512, upsample
   280	        self.up = [
   200	        mag = mx.sqrt(real * real + imag * imag + 1e-9)  # (B, T', 257)
   201	
   202	        # Apply mel filterbank
   203	        mel = mag @ self.mel_basis.T  # (B, T', n_mels)
   204	
   205	        # Log mel
   206	        return mx.log(mx.maximum(mel, 1e-5))
   207	
   208	
   209	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   210	# Full vocoder + BWE pipeline
   211	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   212	
   213	
   214	class VocoderWithBWE(nn.Module):
   215	    """Full audio pipeline: mel -> 16kHz waveform -> 48kHz waveform.
   216	
   217	    Combines base vocoder, 3x Kaiser-sinc resampler, and BWE generator.
   218	    BWE output = clamp(resampled_base + bwe_residual, -1, 1).
   219	
   220	    The forward pass must run in fp32: bfloat16 accumulation errors compound
   221	    through 108 sequential convolutions (BigVGAN v2) and degrade spectral
   222	    metrics (mel_l1, MRSTFT) by 40-90%. Call ``upcast_weights_to_fp32()`` once
   223	    after ``load_weights()`` to promote all parameters to fp32.
   224	
   225	    Weight key hierarchy (all under vocoder.* prefix):
   226	        conv_pre, ups, resblocks, act_post, conv_post — base vocoder
   227	        bwe_generator.*                                — BWE BigVGAN
   228	        mel_stft.*                                     — MelSTFT for BWE
   229	    """
   230	
   231	    def __init__(self):
   232	        super().__init__()
   233	        # Base vocoder: mel -> 16kHz (stereo, 2-ch output)
   234	        # This is a PEER module — base vocoder keys are at the same level,
   235	        # NOT nested under a "vocoder" attribute. The base vocoder keys
   236	        # (conv_pre, ups, resblocks, etc.) live directly in this module.
   237	
   238	        # We need the base vocoder conv_pre, ups, resblocks, act_post, conv_post
   239	        # to load as direct attributes of this class (not nested).
   240	        # Use composition and expose the relevant attributes.
   241	
   242	        # NOTE: The vocoder.safetensors has the base vocoder keys at top level
   243	        # (after stripping "vocoder." prefix). So we DON'T wrap in a sub-module.
   244	        # Instead we construct the BigVGAN components directly.
   245	
   246	        # Import here to build the base vocoder inline
   247	        from ltx_core_mlx.model.audio_vae.vocoder import (
   248	            Activation1d,
   249	            AMPBlock1,
   250	        )
   251	
   252	        # --- Base vocoder (keys at top level) ---
   253	        in_channels = 128
   254	        upsample_initial_channel = 1536
   255	        upsample_rates = (5, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2)
   256	        upsample_kernel_sizes = (11, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4)
   257	        resblock_kernel_sizes = (3, 7, 11)
   258	        resblock_dilation_sizes = ((1, 3, 5), (1, 3, 5), (1, 3, 5))
   259	
   260	        self.conv_pre = nn.Conv1d(in_channels, upsample_initial_channel, kernel_size=7, padding=3)
   261	
   262	        self.ups = []
   263	        self.resblocks = []
   264	        channels = upsample_initial_channel
   265	
   266	        for _i, (rate, kernel) in enumerate(zip(upsample_rates, upsample_kernel_sizes)):
   267	            out_ch = channels // 2
   268	            padding = (kernel - rate) // 2
   269	            self.ups.append(
   270	                nn.ConvTranspose1d(
   271	                    channels,
   272	                    out_ch,
   273	                    kernel_size=kernel,
   274	                    stride=rate,
   275	                    padding=padding,
   276	                )
   277	            )
   278	            for rk, rd in zip(resblock_kernel_sizes, resblock_dilation_sizes):
   279	                self.resblocks.append(AMPBlock1(out_ch, rk, rd))
   280	            channels = out_ch
   281	
   282	        self.act_post = Activation1d(channels)
   283	        self.conv_post = nn.Conv1d(channels, 2, kernel_size=7, padding=3, bias=False)
   284	
   285	        self.num_kernels = len(resblock_kernel_sizes)
   286	        self.num_upsamples = len(upsample_rates)
   287	
   288	        # --- BWE generator ---
   289	        self.bwe_generator = BigVGANVocoder(
   290	            in_channels=128,
   291	            upsample_initial_channel=512,
   292	            upsample_rates=(6, 5, 2, 2, 2),
   293	            upsample_kernel_sizes=(12, 11, 4, 4, 4),
   294	            out_channels=2,
   295	            apply_final_activation=False,
   296	        )
   297	
   298	        # --- Mel STFT for BWE ---
   299	        self.mel_stft = MelSTFT()
   300	
   301	        # --- Resampler (no weights) ---
   302	        self._resampler = HannSincResampler(upsample_factor=3)
   303	
   304	    def upcast_weights_to_fp32(self) -> None:
   305	        """Promote all parameters to fp32 in-place.
   306	
   307	        Required after ``load_weights()`` — running the forward in bf16/fp16
   308	        compounds accumulation errors through 108 sequential convolutions and
   309	        degrades spectral metrics (mel_l1, MRSTFT) by 40-90%. MLX has no
   310	        autocast; the weights themselves must be fp32 for the conv kernels to
   311	        run in fp32.
   312	        """
   313	        from mlx.utils import tree_map
   314	
   315	        self.update(tree_map(lambda p: p.astype(mx.float32), self.parameters()))
   316	
   317	    def _run_base_vocoder(self, mel: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   318	        """Run base vocoder: mel (B, T, 64) -> waveform (B, T_audio, 2)."""
   319	        x = self.conv_pre(mel)
   320	
   321	        for i in range(self.num_upsamples):
   322	            x = self.ups[i](x)
   323	            xs = None
   324	            for j in range(self.num_kernels):
   325	                idx = i * self.num_kernels + j
   326	                if xs is None:
   327	                    xs = self.resblocks[idx](x)
   328	                else:
   329	                    xs = xs + self.resblocks[idx](x)
   330	            x = xs / self.num_kernels
   331	
   332	        x = self.act_post(x)
   333	        x = self.conv_post(x)  # (B, T_audio, 2)
   334	        x = mx.tanh(x)
   335	        return x
   336	
   337	    def __call__(self, mel: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   338	        """Full pipeline: mel -> 48kHz stereo waveform.
   339	
   340	        Reference: ltx-core VocoderWithBWE.forward
   341	
   342	        The stereo mel channels are CONCATENATED (not processed separately):
   343	        (B, 2, T, 64) → rearrange to (B, T, 128) → vocoder → (B, T_audio, 2).
   344	
   345	        Args:
   346	            mel: (B, 2, T, n_mels) stereo mel spectrogram.
   347	
   348	        Returns:
   349	            (B, 2, T_audio) waveform at 48kHz.
   350	        """
   351	        input_dtype = mel.dtype
   352	        mel = mel.astype(mx.float32)
   353	
   354	        B, C, T, M = mel.shape  # (B, 2, T, 64)
   355	
   356	        # 1. Run base vocoder: concatenate stereo channels for input
   357	        # (B, 2, T, 64) → transpose mel_bins to front → (B, 2, 64, T) → rearrange → (B, 128, T) → (B, T, 128)
   358	        mel_concat = mel.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)  # (B, 2, 64, T)
   359	        mel_concat = mel_concat.reshape(B, C * M, T)  # (B, 128, T)
   360	        mel_concat = mel_concat.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, T, 128)
   361	
   362	        waveform_16k = self._run_base_vocoder(mel_concat)  # (B, T_audio_16k, 2)
   363	        waveform_16k = waveform_16k.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, 2, T_audio_16k)
   364	
   365	        # Compute output length before padding
   366	        length_16k = waveform_16k.shape[-1]
   367	        output_length = length_16k * 3  # 3x upsample (16kHz → 48kHz)
   368	
   369	        # Pad to multiple of hop_length for exact mel frame count
   370	        hop = self.mel_stft.hop_length
   371	        remainder = length_16k % hop
   372	        if remainder != 0:
   373	            pad_amount = hop - remainder
   374	            waveform_16k = mx.pad(waveform_16k, [(0, 0), (0, 0), (0, pad_amount)])
   375	
   376	        # 2. Compute mel of vocoder output: (B, 2, T) → (B*2, T) → mel → (B, 2, n_mels, T')
   377	        flat_wav = waveform_16k.reshape(B * C, -1)  # (B*2, T)
   378	        bwe_mel = self.mel_stft(flat_wav)  # (B*2, T', n_mels)
   379	        T_frames = bwe_mel.shape[1]
   380	        bwe_mel = bwe_mel.reshape(B, C, T_frames, M)  # (B, 2, T', 64)
   381	
   382	        # 3. Run BWE generator on mel: (B, 2, T', 64) → same rearrange as base vocoder
   383	        bwe_mel_concat = bwe_mel.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)  # (B, 2, 64, T')
   384	        bwe_mel_concat = bwe_mel_concat.reshape(B, C * M, T_frames)  # (B, 128, T')
   385	        bwe_mel_concat = bwe_mel_concat.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, T', 128)

   811	                        blocks=video_guider.params.stg_blocks,

   813	                )
   814	            if audio_guider.do_perturbed_generation():
   815	                perturbation_list.append(
   816	                    Perturbation(
   817	                        type=PerturbationType.SKIP_AUDIO_SELF_ATTN,
   818	                        blocks=audio_guider.params.stg_blocks,
   819	                    )
   820	                )
   821	            perturbation_config = PerturbationConfig(perturbations=perturbation_list)
   822	            batched_perturbations = BatchedPerturbationConfig(perturbations=[perturbation_config] * B)
   823	
   824	            ptb_kwargs = {
   825	                **base_kwargs,
   826	                "video_text_embeds": video_text_embeds,
   827	                "audio_text_embeds": audio_text_embeds,
   828	                "perturbations": batched_perturbations,
   829	            }
   830	            ptb_video_x0, ptb_audio_x0 = _run_pass("ptb", ptb_kwargs)
   831	
   832	        # --- 4. Isolated modality prediction ---
   833	        mod_video_x0: mx.array | float = 0.0
   834	        mod_audio_x0: mx.array | float = 0.0
   835	
   836	        if video_guider.do_isolated_modality_generation() or audio_guider.do_isolated_modality_generation():
   837	            mod_perturbation_list = [
   838	                Perturbation(type=PerturbationType.SKIP_A2V_CROSS_ATTN, blocks=None),
   839	                Perturbation(type=PerturbationType.SKIP_V2A_CROSS_ATTN, blocks=None),
   840	            ]
   841	            mod_perturbation_config = PerturbationConfig(perturbations=mod_perturbation_list)
   842	            mod_batched_perturbations = BatchedPerturbationConfig(perturbations=[mod_perturbation_config] * B)
   843	
   844	            mod_kwargs = {
   845	                **base_kwargs,
   846	                "video_text_embeds": video_text_embeds,
   847	                "audio_text_embeds": audio_text_embeds,
   848	                "perturbations": mod_batched_perturbations,
   849	            }
   850	            mod_video_x0, mod_audio_x0 = _run_pass("mod", mod_kwargs)
   851	
   852	        if teacache is not None and should_compute_full:
   853	            teacache.cache_residual(captured_residuals)
   854	
   855	        # --- 5. Apply guiders ---
   856	        if video_guider.should_skip_step(step_idx) and last_video_x0 is not None:
   857	            video_x0 = last_video_x0
   858	        else:
   859	            video_x0 = video_guider.calculate(cond_video_x0, neg_video_x0, ptb_video_x0, mod_video_x0)
   860	
   861	        if audio_guider.should_skip_step(step_idx) and last_audio_x0 is not None:
   862	            audio_x0 = last_audio_x0
   863	        else:
   864	            audio_x0 = audio_guider.calculate(cond_audio_x0, neg_audio_x0, ptb_audio_x0, mod_audio_x0)
   865	
   866	        # Apply denoise mask: blend with clean latent
   867	        video_x0 = apply_denoise_mask(video_x0, video_state.clean_latent, video_state.denoise_mask)
   868	        audio_x0 = apply_denoise_mask(audio_x0, audio_state.clean_latent, audio_state.denoise_mask)
   869	
   870	        # Track for skip_step
   871	        last_video_x0 = video_x0
   872	        last_audio_x0 = audio_x0
   873	
   874	        # Euler step
   875	        video_x = euler_step(video_x, video_x0, sigma, sigma_next)

   255	class AudioVAEDecoder(nn.Module):
   256	    """Audio VAE decoder: latent (B, 8, T, 16) -> mel (B, 2, T', 64).
   257	
   258	    Architecture (reverse order of ``up`` indices — up.2 runs first):
   259	        conv_in  : Conv2d(8, 512, 3)
   260	        mid      : ResBlock(512) + AttnBlock(512) + ResBlock(512)
   261	        up.2     : 3x ResBlock(512) + Upsample  → freq 16→32
   262	        up.1     : 3x ResBlock(512→256) + Upsample → freq 32→64
   263	        up.0     : 3x ResBlock(256→128), no upsample
   264	        conv_out : Conv2d(128, 2, 3)
   265	    """
   266	
   267	    def __init__(self):
   268	        super().__init__()
   269	        # conv_in: 8 input channels (latent C1 dim)
   270	        self.conv_in = WrappedConv2d(8, 512, 3, padding=1, causal=True)
   271	
   272	        # Mid — config: mid_block_add_attention=False for distilled model
   273	        self.mid = AudioMidBlock(512, causal=True, add_attention=False)
   274	
   275	        # Up blocks — stored in list indexed [0, 1, 2] but run in REVERSE order
   276	        # Config: attn_resolutions=[] → no attention in any up block
   277	        # up.0: 256→128, no upsample
   278	        # up.1: 512→256, upsample
   279	        # up.2: 512→512, upsample
   280	        self.up = [
   281	            AudioUpBlock(256, 128, num_blocks=3, add_upsample=False, add_attention=False, causal=True),
   282	            AudioUpBlock(512, 256, num_blocks=3, add_upsample=True, add_attention=False, causal=True),
   283	            AudioUpBlock(512, 512, num_blocks=3, add_upsample=True, add_attention=False, causal=True),
   284	        ]
   285	
   286	        # Output
   287	        self.conv_out = WrappedConv2d(128, 2, 3, padding=1, causal=True)
   288	
   289	        # Per-channel normalization for latent denormalization
   290	        self.per_channel_statistics = PerChannelStatistics(128)
   291	
   292	    def decode(self, latent: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   293	        """Decode audio latent to mel spectrogram.
   294	
   295	        Args:
   296	            latent: (B, 8, T, 16) audio latent.
   297	
   298	        Returns:
   299	            Mel spectrogram (B, 2, T', 64).
   300	        """
   301	        B, C1, T, C2 = latent.shape  # (B, 8, T, 16)
   302	
   303	        # Flatten to (B, T, 128) for denormalization
   304	        x_flat = latent.transpose(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, T, C1 * C2)
   305	
   306	        # Denormalize using per-channel statistics
   307	        mean = self.per_channel_statistics.mean_of_means.reshape(1, 1, -1)
   308	        std = self.per_channel_statistics.std_of_means.reshape(1, 1, -1)
   309	        x_flat = x_flat * std + mean
   310	
   311	        # Reshape back to 2D spatial: (B, T, 16, 8) — NHWC for Conv2d
   312	        # T = height, 16 = width (frequency), 8 = channels
   313	        x = x_flat.reshape(B, T, C1, C2).transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)  # (B, T, 8, 16) → (B, T, 16, 8) NHWC
   314	
   315	        # Encoder/Decoder
   316	        x = self.conv_in(x)  # (B, T, 16, 512)
   317	        x = self.mid(x)
   318	
   319	        # Up blocks run in reverse index order: up.2, up.1, up.0
   320	        for i in reversed(range(len(self.up))):
   321	            x = self.up[i](x)
   322	
   323	        x = pixel_norm(x)  # norm_out
   324	        x = nn.silu(x)
   325	        x = self.conv_out(x)  # (B, T', 64, 2) in NHWC
   326	
   327	        # Convert to (B, 2, T', 64)
   328	        x = x.transpose(0, 3, 1, 2)
   329	        return x
   337	    def __call__(self, mel: mx.array) -> mx.array:
   338	        """Full pipeline: mel -> 48kHz stereo waveform.
   339	
   340	        Reference: ltx-core VocoderWithBWE.forward
   341	
   342	        The stereo mel channels are CONCATENATED (not processed separately):
   343	        (B, 2, T, 64) → rearrange to (B, T, 128) → vocoder → (B, T_audio, 2).
   344	
   345	        Args:
   346	            mel: (B, 2, T, n_mels) stereo mel spectrogram.
   347	
   348	        Returns:
   349	            (B, 2, T_audio) waveform at 48kHz.
   350	        """
   351	        input_dtype = mel.dtype
   352	        mel = mel.astype(mx.float32)
   353	
   354	        B, C, T, M = mel.shape  # (B, 2, T, 64)
   355	
   356	        # 1. Run base vocoder: concatenate stereo channels for input
   357	        # (B, 2, T, 64) → transpose mel_bins to front → (B, 2, 64, T) → rearrange → (B, 128, T) → (B, T, 128)
   358	        mel_concat = mel.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)  # (B, 2, 64, T)
   359	        mel_concat = mel_concat.reshape(B, C * M, T)  # (B, 128, T)
   360	        mel_concat = mel_concat.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, T, 128)
   361	
   362	        waveform_16k = self._run_base_vocoder(mel_concat)  # (B, T_audio_16k, 2)
   363	        waveform_16k = waveform_16k.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, 2, T_audio_16k)
   364	
   365	        # Compute output length before padding
   366	        length_16k = waveform_16k.shape[-1]
   367	        output_length = length_16k * 3  # 3x upsample (16kHz → 48kHz)
   368	
   369	        # Pad to multiple of hop_length for exact mel frame count
   370	        hop = self.mel_stft.hop_length
   371	        remainder = length_16k % hop
   372	        if remainder != 0:
   373	            pad_amount = hop - remainder
   374	            waveform_16k = mx.pad(waveform_16k, [(0, 0), (0, 0), (0, pad_amount)])
   375	
   376	        # 2. Compute mel of vocoder output: (B, 2, T) → (B*2, T) → mel → (B, 2, n_mels, T')
   377	        flat_wav = waveform_16k.reshape(B * C, -1)  # (B*2, T)
   378	        bwe_mel = self.mel_stft(flat_wav)  # (B*2, T', n_mels)
   379	        T_frames = bwe_mel.shape[1]
   380	        bwe_mel = bwe_mel.reshape(B, C, T_frames, M)  # (B, 2, T', 64)
   381	
   382	        # 3. Run BWE generator on mel: (B, 2, T', 64) → same rearrange as base vocoder
   383	        bwe_mel_concat = bwe_mel.transpose(0, 1, 3, 2)  # (B, 2, 64, T')
   384	        bwe_mel_concat = bwe_mel_concat.reshape(B, C * M, T_frames)  # (B, 128, T')
   385	        bwe_mel_concat = bwe_mel_concat.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, T', 128)
   386	
   387	        residual = self.bwe_generator(bwe_mel_concat)  # (B, T_bwe, 2)
   388	        residual = residual.transpose(0, 2, 1)  # (B, 2, T_bwe)
   389	
   390	        # 4. Resample base vocoder output to 48kHz
   391	        skip_channels = []
   392	        for c in range(C):
   393	            resampled = self._resampler(waveform_16k[:, c, :])  # (B, T_48k)
   394	            skip_channels.append(resampled)
   395	        skip = mx.stack(skip_channels, axis=1)  # (B, 2, T_48k)
   396	
   397	        # 5. Add residual and clip
   398	        min_len = min(skip.shape[-1], residual.shape[-1])
   399	        output = skip[:, :, :min_len] + residual[:, :, :min_len]
   400	        output = mx.clip(output, -1.0, 1.0)[:, :, :output_length]
   401	        return output.astype(input_dtype)

    10	class TestSnakeBeta:
    11	    def test_shape(self):
    12	        act = SnakeBeta(32)
    13	        x = mx.zeros((2, 10, 32))
    14	        out = act(x)
    15	        assert out.shape == (2, 10, 32)
    16	
    17	    def test_snakebeta_logscale(self):
    18	        """SnakeBeta with log-scale alpha=0 should give exp(0)=1."""
    19	        snake = SnakeBeta(4)
    20	        # Weights are zeros (log-scale) → exp(0) = 1.0
    21	        x = mx.ones((1, 5, 4))
    22	        result = snake(x)
    23	        # With alpha=1.0, beta=1.0: x + sin^2(x) = 1 + sin^2(1)
    24	        expected_val = 1.0 + mx.sin(mx.array(1.0)).item() ** 2
    25	        assert abs(float(result[0, 0, 0]) - expected_val) < 1e-5
    26

    28	class TestAudioVAEDecoder:
    29	    def test_decode_shape(self):
    30	        decoder = AudioVAEDecoder()
    31	        latent = mx.zeros((1, 8, 10, 16))
    32	        mel = decoder.decode(latent)
    33	        assert mel.shape[0] == 1
    34	        assert mel.shape[1] == 2  # stereo
    35	        # After 2 upsample stages (2x each): freq 16 -> 64
    36	        assert mel.shape[3] == 64  # mel bins

The “decoder” boundary in the spec is materially wrong: the Swift VAE returns a two-channel 64-bin mel tensor, not a ready `[B,128,T]` tensor, and it currently omits the checkpoint’s latent denormalization and causal-time convolutions. Separately, Swift’s public vocoder path stops at 16 kHz; the reference’s BWE/resampler stage is what produces 48 kHz stereo.

     1	// LTX2AudioVAE.swift — 2D mel-spectrogram VAE for JoyAI-Echo (Phase 2)
     2	//
     3	// JoyAI-Echo's audio half runs on a compact 2D convolutional VAE (`audio_vae.*`,
     4	// 102 tensors) that compresses a stereo mel spectrogram to an 8-channel latent
     5	// and back. It is a standard AutoencoderKL topology (down / mid / up stages,
     6	// resnet blocks with 1x1 `nin_shortcut`s, strided-conv downsample, NN-upsample)
     7	// but — like the LTX-2 video VAE — it uses **PixelNorm** (weight-free L2 channel
     8	// norm) and SiLU rather than GroupNorm, which is why the checkpoint carries no
     9	// norm weights.
    10	//
    11	// Shape flow (channels-first logical view):
    12	//   encode:  mel (B, 2, F, T)  → (B, 16, F/4, T/4) → split → mean (B, 8, F/4, T/4)
    13	//   decode:  z   (B, 8, F/4, T/4) → (B, 2, F, T)
    14	//
    15	// Internally everything runs channels-last (NHWC = [B, F, T, C]) to match MLX's
    16	// Conv2d weight layout `[O, kH, kW, I]`. Encode/decode accept and return the
    17	// channels-first convention the rest of the LTX-2 stack uses.
    18	//
    19	// Config (from echo-keymap.json + tensor manifest):
    20	//   in_channels 2 (stereo), mel_bins 64, z_channels 8 (double_z → 16 encoder
    21	//   out), ch 128, ch_mult [1,2,4] → [128,256,512], 2 down / 2 up (4× compress),
    22	//   16 kHz. per_channel_statistics carries 128-dim stats for the *patchified*
    23	//   latent (8ch → 128ch via a 4×4 space-to-depth patch the pipeline applies).
    24	//
    25	// NOTE (fidelity, deferred): the reference uses causal conv padding on the time
    26	// axis; this port uses symmetric same-padding, which is shape-exact and decodes
    27	// non-silent audio but is not numerically golden. Causal-padding parity is a
    28	// Phase-4 item (golden tensors unavailable on this box).
    29

    31	import Logging
    32	import MLX
    33	import MLXNN

    37	public struct LTX2AudioVAEConfig {
    38	  public var inChannels: Int = 2
    39	  public var baseChannels: Int = 128
    40	  public var channelMultipliers: [Int] = [1, 2, 4]
    41	  public var numResBlocks: Int = 2      // encoder blocks per level (decoder = +1)
    42	  public var zChannels: Int = 8
    43	  public var latentChannels: Int = 128  // patchified latent width (stats dim)
    44	  public var eps: Float = 1e-6
    45	
    46	  public init() {}
    47	
    48	  /// Resolved per-level channel counts, e.g. [128, 256, 512].
    49	  public var levelChannels: [Int] { channelMultipliers.map { $0 * baseChannels } }
    50	}
    51	
    52	// MARK: - Shared conv wrapper (`<name>.conv.weight`)
    53	
    54	/// A single conv wrapped in a `conv` child so the checkpoint's `foo.conv.weight`
    55	/// key path resolves. Mirrors `LTX2ConvWrapper` (video VAE) but 2D.
    56	public final class LTX2AudioConvWrapper: Module {
    57	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv") var conv: Conv2d
    58	
    59	  public init(_ inChannels: Int, _ outChannels: Int, kernelSize: Int = 3) {
    60	    let pad = kernelSize / 2
    61	    self._conv.wrappedValue = Conv2d(
    62	      inputChannels: inChannels, outputChannels: outChannels,
    63	      kernelSize: IntOrPair(kernelSize), padding: IntOrPair(pad))
    64	    super.init()
    65	  }
    66	
    67	  public func callAsFunction(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray { conv(x) }
    68	}
    69	
    70	// MARK: - Resnet block (PixelNorm + SiLU)
    71	
    72	public final class LTX2AudioResnetBlock: Module {
    73	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv1") var conv1: LTX2AudioConvWrapper
    74	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv2") var conv2: LTX2AudioConvWrapper
    75	  @ModuleInfo(key: "nin_shortcut") var ninShortcut: LTX2AudioConvWrapper?
    76	
    77	  let eps: Float
    78	  let hasShortcut: Bool
    79	
    80	  public init(_ inChannels: Int, _ outChannels: Int, eps: Float = 1e-6) {
    81	    self.eps = eps
    82	    self.hasShortcut = inChannels != outChannels
    83	    self._conv1.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioConvWrapper(inChannels, outChannels)
    84	    self._conv2.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioConvWrapper(outChannels, outChannels)
    85	    self._ninShortcut.wrappedValue = hasShortcut
    86	      ? LTX2AudioConvWrapper(inChannels, outChannels, kernelSize: 1) : nil
    87	    super.init()
    88	  }
    89	
    90	  public func callAsFunction(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
    91	    let residual = hasShortcut ? ninShortcut!(x) : x
    92	    var h = conv1(silu(ltx2AudioPixelNorm(x, eps: eps)))
    93	    h = conv2(silu(ltx2AudioPixelNorm(h, eps: eps)))
    94	    return h + residual
    95	  }
    96	}
    97	
    98	// MARK: - Down / Up / Mid stages
    99	
   100	/// Encoder downsample: asymmetric pad + stride-2 3x3 conv (`downsample.conv.weight`).
   101	public final class LTX2AudioDownsample: Module {
   102	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv") var conv: Conv2d
   103	
   104	  public init(_ channels: Int) {
   105	    self._conv.wrappedValue = Conv2d(
   106	      inputChannels: channels, outputChannels: channels,
   107	      kernelSize: 3, stride: 2, padding: 0)
   108	    super.init()
   109	  }
   110	
   111	  public func callAsFunction(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   112	    // NHWC: pad bottom/right by 1 on F(H) and T(W), then stride-2 3x3.
   113	    let padded = MLX.padded(
   114	      x, widths: [IntOrPair((0, 0)), IntOrPair((0, 1)), IntOrPair((0, 1)), IntOrPair((0, 0))])
   115	    return conv(padded)
   116	  }
   117	}
   118	
   119	/// Decoder upsample: nearest-neighbor 2× then 3x3 conv (`upsample.conv.conv.weight`).
   120	public final class LTX2AudioUpsample: Module {
   121	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv") var conv: LTX2AudioConvWrapper
   122	
   123	  public init(_ channels: Int) {
   124	    self._conv.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioConvWrapper(channels, channels)
   125	    super.init()
   230	  public func callAsFunction(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   231	    var h = convIn(x)
   232	    for level in down { h = level(h) }
   233	    h = mid(h)
   234	    h = convOut(silu(ltx2AudioPixelNorm(h, eps: eps)))
   235	    return h
   236	  }
   237	}
   238	
   239	public final class LTX2AudioDecoder: Module {
   240	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv_in") var convIn: LTX2AudioConvWrapper
   241	  @ModuleInfo(key: "mid") var mid: LTX2AudioMidBlock
   242	  @ModuleInfo(key: "up") var up: [LTX2AudioDecoderLevel]
   243	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv_out") var convOut: LTX2AudioConvWrapper
   244	  let eps: Float
   245	
   246	  public init(config: LTX2AudioVAEConfig) {
   247	    self.eps = config.eps
   248	    let chans = config.levelChannels          // [128, 256, 512]
   249	    let nLevels = chans.count
   250	    let topCh = chans[nLevels - 1]
   251	
   252	    self._convIn.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioConvWrapper(config.zChannels, topCh)
   253	    self._mid.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioMidBlock(topCh)
   254	
   255	    // Levels are stored 0..nLevels-1 but the checkpoint's `up.i` are indexed so
   256	    // that up.(nLevels-1) is the highest-channel (deepest) stage; decode walks
   257	    // them in descending order. up.i output channel = chans[i]; input channel =
   258	    // chans[i+1] for i < top (channel halving), else topCh. Upsample on every
   259	    // level except up.0 (2 upsamples for 3 levels).
   260	    var levels: [LTX2AudioDecoderLevel] = []
   261	    for i in 0..<nLevels {
   262	      let outC = chans[i]
   263	      let inC = i == nLevels - 1 ? topCh : chans[i + 1]
   264	      levels.append(LTX2AudioDecoderLevel(
   265	        inChannels: inC, outChannels: outC,
   266	        numBlocks: config.numResBlocks + 1, upsample: i > 0))
   267	    }
   268	    self._up.wrappedValue = levels
   269	
   270	    self._convOut.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioConvWrapper(chans[0], config.inChannels)
   271	    super.init()
   272	  }
   273	
   274	  public func callAsFunction(_ z: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   275	    var h = convIn(z)
   276	    h = mid(h)
   277	    for i in stride(from: up.count - 1, through: 0, by: -1) { h = up[i](h) }
   278	    h = convOut(silu(ltx2AudioPixelNorm(h, eps: eps)))
   279	    return h
   280	  }
   281	}
   282	
   283	// MARK: - Top-level VAE
   284	
   285	public final class LTX2AudioVAE: Module {
   286	  @ModuleInfo(key: "encoder") var encoder: LTX2AudioEncoder
   287	  @ModuleInfo(key: "decoder") var decoder: LTX2AudioDecoder
   288	  @ModuleInfo(key: "per_channel_statistics") var perChannelStatistics: LTX2PerChannelStatistics
   289	
   290	  public let config: LTX2AudioVAEConfig
   291	
   292	  public init(config: LTX2AudioVAEConfig = LTX2AudioVAEConfig()) {
   293	    self.config = config
   294	    self._encoder.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioEncoder(config: config)
   295	    self._decoder.wrappedValue = LTX2AudioDecoder(config: config)
   296	    self._perChannelStatistics.wrappedValue =
   297	      LTX2PerChannelStatistics(latentChannels: config.latentChannels)
   298	    super.init()
   299	  }
   300	
   301	  /// Encode a mel spectrogram to the posterior-mean latent.
   302	  ///
   303	  /// - Parameter mel: `(B, 2, F, T)` channels-first.
   304	  /// - Returns: `(B, zChannels, F/4, T/4)` channels-first (distribution mean).
   305	  public func encode(_ mel: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   306	    let nhwc = mel.transposed(0, 2, 3, 1)         // (B, F, T, 2)
   307	    let moments = encoder(nhwc)                    // (B, F/4, T/4, 16)
   308	    let z = config.zChannels
   309	    let mean = moments[0..., 0..., 0..., 0..<z]    // first zChannels = mean
   310	    return mean.transposed(0, 3, 1, 2)             // (B, z, F/4, T/4)
   311	  }
   312	
   313	  /// Decode a latent back to a mel spectrogram.
   314	  ///
   315	  /// - Parameter z: `(B, zChannels, F/4, T/4)` channels-first.
   316	  /// - Returns: `(B, 2, F, T)` channels-first.
   317	  public func decode(_ z: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   318	    let nhwc = z.transposed(0, 2, 3, 1)            // (B, F/4, T/4, z)
   319	    let mel = decoder(nhwc)                        // (B, F, T, 2)
   320	    return mel.transposed(0, 3, 1, 2)              // (B, 2, F, T)
   321	  }
   322	}
   323	
   324	// MARK: - PixelNorm (channels-last)
   325	
   326	/// L2 channel-normalization over the last (channel) axis: `x / sqrt(mean(x²)+eps)`.
   327	@inline(__always)
   328	func ltx2AudioPixelNorm(_ x: MLXArray, eps: Float) -> MLXArray {
   329	  x / MLX.sqrt(MLX.mean(x * x, axis: -1, keepDims: true) + eps)
   330	}
   331	
   332	// MARK: - Weight loading
   333	
   334	extension LTX2AudioVAE {
   335	  /// Remap monolith `audio_vae.*` keys to this module's parameter namespace and
   336	  /// transpose PyTorch conv weights `[O,I,H,W]` → MLX `[O,H,W,I]`.
   337	  public static func remapKeys(_ tensors: [String: MLXArray]) -> [(String, MLXArray)] {
   338	    var out: [(String, MLXArray)] = []
   339	    for (key, value) in tensors {
   340	      guard key.hasPrefix("audio_vae.") else { continue }
   341	
   342	      var newKey: String
   343	      if key == "audio_vae.per_channel_statistics.mean-of-means" {
   344	        newKey = "per_channel_statistics.mean"
   345	      } else if key == "audio_vae.per_channel_statistics.std-of-means" {
   346	        newKey = "per_channel_statistics.std"
   347	      } else if key.hasPrefix("audio_vae.per_channel_statistics.") {
   348	        continue  // drop any other statistics (already-mirrored decoder copies etc.)
   349	      } else if key.hasPrefix("audio_vae.encoder.") {
   350	        newKey = "encoder." + String(key.dropFirst("audio_vae.encoder.".count))
   351	      } else if key.hasPrefix("audio_vae.decoder.") {
   352	        newKey = "decoder." + String(key.dropFirst("audio_vae.decoder.".count))
   353	      } else {
   354	        continue
   355	      }
   356	
   357	      var newValue = value
   358	      // 4D conv weights are PyTorch OIHW; MLX Conv2d wants OHWI.
   359	      if newKey.hasSuffix(".weight") && newValue.ndim == 4 {
   360	        newValue = newValue.transposed(0, 2, 3, 1)
   361	      }
   362	      out.append((newKey, newValue))
   363	    }
   364	    return out
   365	  }
   366	
   367	  /// Apply monolith audio-VAE weights with an anti-noise guard (mirrors
   368	  /// `LTX2VideoGenerator.load`): throws if the remap covers <half the module's
   369	  /// parameters, which would otherwise decode silence while reporting success.
   370	  ///
   371	  /// - Returns: `(matched, moduleParamCount)`.
   372	  @discardableResult
   373	  public func loadWeightsFromTensors(
   374	    tensors: [String: MLXArray], logger: Logger
   375	  ) throws -> (matched: Int, total: Int) {
   376	    let remapped = LTX2AudioVAE.remapKeys(tensors)
   377	    let moduleKeys = Set(parameters().flattened().map { $0.0 })
   378	    let matched = remapped.filter { moduleKeys.contains($0.0) }.count
   379	    logger.info(

     2	//
     3	// JoyAI-Echo's `vocoder.*` group (1227 tensors) is a BigVGAN v2 vocoder with
     4	// three sub-modules:
     5	//   • vocoder.vocoder.*        — main generator: mel(128) → stereo waveform.
     6	//       conv_pre(128→1536,k7); 6 ConvTranspose1d upsamples (rates 5,2,2,2,2,2 →
     7	//       ch 1536→768→384→192→96→48→24, ×160 total); a multi-receptive-field
     8	//       (MRF) stack of 18 AMPBlocks (6 stages × kernels {3,7,11}, dilations
     9	//       {1,3,5}); anti-aliased SnakeBeta activations; conv_post(24→2,k7,no bias).
    10	//   • vocoder.bwe_generator.*  — bandwidth-extension generator (rates 6,5,2,2,2,
    11	//       ch 512→…→16, 15 AMPBlocks), same block design.
    12	//   • vocoder.mel_stft.*       — mel filterbank + STFT bases (analysis direction;
    13	//       carried as buffers, not used on the mel→wave synthesis path).
    14	//
    15	// Anti-aliasing: BigVGAN wraps each Snake nonlinearity in an `Activation1d`
    16	// that 2×-upsamples (kaiser-sinc lowpass), applies SnakeBeta at the higher rate,
    17	// then 2×-downsamples. The kaiser-sinc filters are **baked into the checkpoint**
    18	// as `upsample.filter` / `downsample.lowpass.filter` ([1,1,12]) — so we LOAD and
    19	// apply them (grouped/depthwise conv) rather than recompute kaiser windows.
    20	//
    21	// NOTE (fidelity, deferred): exact alias-free-torch edge padding is not
    22	// reproduced; each activation is forced length-preserving (up→snake→down cropped
    23	// back to its input length). Output sample count is therefore governed exactly by
    24	// conv_pre/ups/conv_post (frames × ∏rates), and the audio is non-silent, but the
    25	// result is not numerically golden vs the PyTorch reference (unavailable here).
    26

    32	// MARK: - SnakeBeta activation
    33	
    34	/// SnakeBeta: `x + (1/(β+ε))·sin(αx)²`, with α,β in log-scale (BigVGAN v2 default
    35	/// `alpha_logscale=true`). Params are per-channel `[C]`; input is NLC `[B,L,C]`.
    36	public final class LTX2SnakeBeta: Module {
    37	  @ParameterInfo(key: "alpha") var alpha: MLXArray
    38	  @ParameterInfo(key: "beta") var beta: MLXArray
    39	  let eps: Float
    40	
    41	  public init(channels: Int, eps: Float = 1e-9) {
    42	    self.eps = eps
    43	    self._alpha.wrappedValue = MLXArray.zeros([channels])
    44	    self._beta.wrappedValue = MLXArray.zeros([channels])
    45	    super.init()
    46	  }
    47	
    48	  public func callAsFunction(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
    49	    let a = MLX.exp(alpha).reshaped(1, 1, -1)
    50	    let b = MLX.exp(beta).reshaped(1, 1, -1)
    51	    let s = MLX.sin(a * x)
    52	    return x + (1.0 / (b + eps)) * (s * s)
    53	  }
    54	}
    55	
    56	// MARK: - Anti-aliased activation (Activation1d)
    57

    59	/// `downsample.lowpass.filter` — shape [1,1,K]).

    76	/// BigVGAN anti-aliased activation: 2×-upsample → SnakeBeta → 2×-downsample,
    77	/// forced length-preserving. Uses the checkpoint's baked kaiser-sinc filters via
    78	/// grouped (depthwise) conv.
    79	public final class LTX2AntiAliasActivation: Module {
    80	  @ModuleInfo(key: "act") var act: LTX2SnakeBeta
    81	  @ModuleInfo(key: "upsample") var upsample: LTX2LowPass1d          // has `filter`
    82	  @ModuleInfo(key: "downsample") var downsample: LTX2DownSample1d   // has `lowpass.filter`
    83	  let channels: Int
    84	  let kernel: Int
    85	
    86	  public init(channels: Int, kernel: Int = 12) {
    87	    self.channels = channels
    88	    self.kernel = kernel
    89	    self._act.wrappedValue = LTX2SnakeBeta(channels: channels)
    90	    self._upsample.wrappedValue = LTX2LowPass1d(kernel: kernel)
    91	    self._downsample.wrappedValue = LTX2DownSample1d(kernel: kernel)
    92	    super.init()
    93	  }
    94	
    95	  /// Broadcast a [1,1,K] filter to depthwise weight [C, K, 1].
    96	  private func depthwiseWeight(_ f: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
    97	    let w = f.reshaped(1, kernel, 1).asType(.float32)
    98	    return MLX.broadcast(w, to: [channels, kernel, 1])
    99	  }
   100	
   101	  public func callAsFunction(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   102	    let inDtype = x.dtype
   103	    let L = x.dim(1)
   104	    let xf = x.asType(.float32)
   105	    let pad = kernel / 2
   106	
   107	    // 2× upsample (transposed, depthwise) → force length 2L.
   108	    let upW = depthwiseWeight(upsample.filter)
   109	    var up = MLX.convTransposed1d(
   110	      MLX.padded(xf, widths: [IntOrPair((0, 0)), IntOrPair((pad, pad)), IntOrPair((0, 0))]),
   111	      upW, stride: 2, groups: channels)
   112	    up = 2.0 * up
   113	    up = matchLength(up, to: 2 * L)
   114	
   115	    // SnakeBeta at 2× rate.
   116	    let sn = act(up)
   117	
   118	    // 2× downsample (depthwise) → force length L.
   119	    let dnW = depthwiseWeight(downsample.lowpass.filter)
   120	    var dn = MLX.conv1d(
   121	      MLX.padded(sn, widths: [IntOrPair((0, 0)), IntOrPair((pad, pad)), IntOrPair((0, 0))]),
   122	      dnW, stride: 2, groups: channels)
   123	    dn = matchLength(dn, to: L)
   124	    return dn.asType(inDtype)
   125	  }
   126	
   127	  /// Crop or zero-pad the length (axis 1) to exactly `target`.
   128	  private func matchLength(_ x: MLXArray, to target: Int) -> MLXArray {
   129	    let cur = x.dim(1)
   130	    if cur == target { return x }
   131	    if cur > target { return x[0..., 0..<target, 0...] }
   132	    return MLX.padded(
   133	      x, widths: [IntOrPair((0, 0)), IntOrPair((0, target - cur)), IntOrPair((0, 0))])
   134	  }
   135	}

   208	public final class LTX2BigVGANGenerator: Module {
   209	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv_pre") var convPre: Conv1d
   210	  @ModuleInfo(key: "ups") var ups: [ConvTransposed1d]
   211	  @ModuleInfo(key: "resblocks") var resblocks: [LTX2AMPBlock]
   212	  @ModuleInfo(key: "act_post") var actPost: LTX2AntiAliasActivation
   213	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv_post") var convPost: Conv1d
   214	
   215	  let numKernels: Int
   216	
   217	  public init(config: LTX2BigVGANConfig) {
   218	    self.numKernels = config.resblockKernels.count
   219	
   220	    self._convPre.wrappedValue = Conv1d(
   221	      inputChannels: config.melChannels, outputChannels: config.upsampleInitialChannels,
   222	      kernelSize: 7, padding: 3)
   223	
   224	    var ch = config.upsampleInitialChannels
   225	    var upList: [ConvTransposed1d] = []
   226	    var blocks: [LTX2AMPBlock] = []
   227	    for (i, rate) in config.upsampleRates.enumerated() {
   228	      let k = config.upsampleKernels[i]
   229	      let outCh = ch / 2
   230	      upList.append(ConvTransposed1d(
   231	        inputChannels: ch, outputChannels: outCh,
   232	        kernelSize: k, stride: rate, padding: (k - rate) / 2))
   233	      for rk in config.resblockKernels {
   234	        blocks.append(LTX2AMPBlock(
   235	          channels: outCh, kernelSize: rk, dilations: config.resblockDilations))
   236	      }
   237	      ch = outCh
   238	    }
   239	    self._ups.wrappedValue = upList
   240	    self._resblocks.wrappedValue = blocks
   241	
   242	    self._actPost.wrappedValue = LTX2AntiAliasActivation(channels: ch)
   243	    self._convPost.wrappedValue = Conv1d(
   244	      inputChannels: ch, outputChannels: 2, kernelSize: 7, padding: 3, bias: false)
   245	    super.init()
   246	  }
   247	
   248	  /// - Parameter mel: NLC `[B, T, melChannels]`.
   249	  /// - Returns: NLC `[B, T·∏rates, 2]` stereo waveform in [-1, 1].
   250	  public func callAsFunction(_ mel: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   251	    var x = convPre(mel)
   252	    for i in 0..<ups.count {
   253	      x = ups[i](x)
   254	      var xs = resblocks[i * numKernels](x)
   255	      for j in 1..<numKernels {
   256	        xs = xs + resblocks[i * numKernels + j](x)
   257	      }
   258	      x = xs / MLXArray(Float(numKernels))
   259	    }
   260	    x = actPost(x)
   261	    x = convPost(x)
   262	    return MLX.tanh(x)
   263	  }
   264	}

   302	  /// Synthesize a stereo waveform from a mel spectrogram via the MAIN generator.
   303	  ///
   304	  /// - Parameter mel: channels-first `[B, 128, T]`.
   305	  /// - Returns: channels-first `[B, 2, T·160]` waveform in [-1, 1].
   306	  public func synthesize(_ mel: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   307	    let nlc = mel.transposed(0, 2, 1)         // [B, T, 128]
   308	    let wave = vocoder(nlc)                    // [B, T·160, 2]
   309	    return wave.transposed(0, 2, 1)            // [B, 2, T·160]
   310	  }

   313	// MARK: - Weight loading
   314	
   315	extension LTX2Vocoder {
   316	  /// Remap monolith `vocoder.*` keys to this module namespace + transpose convs.
   317	  ///
   318	  /// - Conv1d weights `[O,I,K]` → MLX `[O,K,I]` (transpose 0,2,1).
   319	  /// - ConvTranspose1d (`ups.*`) weights `[I,O,K]` → MLX `[O,K,I]` (transpose 1,2,0).
   320	  /// - Depthwise filters `[1,1,K]` and snake α/β / mel bases pass through.
   321	  public static func remapKeys(_ tensors: [String: MLXArray]) -> [(String, MLXArray)] {
   322	    var out: [(String, MLXArray)] = []
   323	    for (key, value) in tensors {
   324	      guard key.hasPrefix("vocoder.") else { continue }
   325	      let newKey = String(key.dropFirst("vocoder.".count))
   325	      let newKey = String(key.dropFirst("vocoder.".count))
   326	
   327	      var v = value
   328	      if newKey.hasSuffix(".weight") && v.ndim == 3 {
   329	        if isUpsampleTransposeKey(newKey) {
   330	          v = v.transposed(1, 2, 0)       // ConvTranspose1d IOK → OKI
   331	        } else if !newKey.hasSuffix(".filter") {
   332	          v = v.transposed(0, 2, 1)       // Conv1d OIK → OKI
   333	        }
   334	      }
   335	      out.append((newKey, v))
   336	    }
   337	    return out
   338	  }
   339	
   340	  /// True for `…ups.N.weight` (the ConvTranspose1d layers) — the only transposed
   341	  /// convs in the graph; everything else (`conv_pre/post`, resblock `convs*`) is
   342	  /// a forward Conv1d.
   343	  private static func isUpsampleTransposeKey(_ key: String) -> Bool {
   344	    guard key.hasSuffix(".weight") else { return false }
   345	    let parts = key.split(separator: ".")
   346	    // pattern: <gen>.ups.<idx>.weight
   347	    return parts.count >= 4 && parts[parts.count - 3] == "ups"
   348	  }
   349	
   350	  /// Apply monolith vocoder weights with the anti-noise coverage guard.
   351	  /// - Returns: `(matched, moduleParamCount)`.
   352	  @discardableResult
   353	  public func loadWeightsFromTensors(
   354	    tensors: [String: MLXArray], logger: Logger
   355	  ) throws -> (matched: Int, total: Int) {
   356	    let remapped = LTX2Vocoder.remapKeys(tensors)
   357	    let moduleKeys = Set(parameters().flattened().map { $0.0 })
   358	    let matched = remapped.filter { moduleKeys.contains($0.0) }.count
   359	    logger.info(
   360	      "LTX-2 vocoder: remap matched \(matched)/\(moduleKeys.count) module params (\(remapped.count) remapped keys).")
   361	    if matched * 2 < moduleKeys.count {
   362	      throw LTX2VocoderError.weightCoverageTooLow(matched: matched, total: moduleKeys.count)
   363	    }
   364	    let params = ModuleParameters.unflattened(remapped.map { ($0.0, $0.1) })
   365	    try update(parameters: params, verify: [.shapeMismatch])
   366	    return (matched, moduleKeys.count)
   367	  }
   368	}

    43	class AudioLatentNormalizer:
    44	    """Applies per-channel statistics in patch space and restores original layout."""
    45	
    46	    def __init__(self, patchfier: AudioPatchifier, statistics_processor: torch.nn.Module):
    47	        self.patchifier = patchfier
    48	        self.statistics = statistics_processor
    49	
    50	    def normalize(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    51	        channels = latents.shape[1]
    52	        freq = latents.shape[3]
    53	        patched, _ = self.patchifier.patchify(latents)
    54	        normalized = self.statistics.normalize(patched)
    55	        return self.patchifier.unpatchify(normalized, channels=channels, freq=freq)
    56	
    57	    def denormalize(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    58	        channels = latents.shape[1]
    59	        freq = latents.shape[3]
    60	        patched, _ = self.patchifier.patchify(latents)
    61	        denormalized = self.statistics.un_normalize(patched)
    62	        return self.patchifier.unpatchify(denormalized, channels=channels, freq=freq)

    65	class AudioPreprocessor:
    66	    """Prepares raw waveforms for the autoencoder by matching training conditions."""
    67	
    68	    def __init__(self, target_sample_rate: int, mel_bins: int, mel_hop_length: int, n_fft: int):
    69	        self.target_sample_rate = target_sample_rate
    70	        self.mel_bins = mel_bins
    71	        self.mel_hop_length = mel_hop_length
    72	        self.n_fft = n_fft
    73	
    74	    def resample(self, waveform: torch.Tensor, source_rate: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    75	        if source_rate == self.target_sample_rate:
    76	            return waveform
    77	        return torchaudio.functional.resample(waveform, source_rate, self.target_sample_rate)

    89	            f_min=0.0,
    90	            f_max=self.target_sample_rate / 2.0,
    91	            n_mels=self.mel_bins,
    92	            window_fn=torch.hann_window,
    93	            center=True,
    94	            pad_mode="reflect",
    95	            power=1.0,
    96	            mel_scale="slaney",
    97	            norm="slaney",
    98	        ).to(device)
    99	
   100	        mel = mel_transform(waveform)
   101	        mel = torch.log(torch.clamp(mel, min=1e-5))
   102	        return mel.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).contiguous()
   103

   105	class AudioVAE(torch.nn.Module):
   106	    """High-level Audio VAE wrapper exposing encode and decode entry points."""
   107	
   108	    def __init__(self, metadata: dict):
   109	        super().__init__()
   110	
   111	        component_config = AudioVAEComponentConfig.from_metadata(metadata)
   112	
   113	        self.autoencoder = CausalAudioAutoencoder(config=component_config.autoencoder)
   114	        if "bwe" in component_config.vocoder:
   115	            self.vocoder = VocoderWithBWE(config=component_config.vocoder)
   116	        else:
   117	            self.vocoder = Vocoder(config=component_config.vocoder)
   118	
   119	        autoencoder_config = self.autoencoder.get_config()
   120	        self.normalizer = AudioLatentNormalizer(
   121	            AudioPatchifier(
   122	                patch_size=1,
   123	                audio_latent_downsample_factor=LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR,
   124	                sample_rate=autoencoder_config["sampling_rate"],
   125	                hop_length=autoencoder_config["mel_hop_length"],
   126	                is_causal=autoencoder_config["is_causal"],
   127	            ),
   128	            self.autoencoder.per_channel_statistics,
   129	        )
   130	
   131	        self.preprocessor = AudioPreprocessor(
   132	            target_sample_rate=autoencoder_config["sampling_rate"],
   133	            mel_bins=autoencoder_config["mel_bins"],
   134	            mel_hop_length=autoencoder_config["mel_hop_length"],
   135	            n_fft=autoencoder_config["n_fft"],
   136	        )
   137	
   138	    def encode(self, audio, sample_rate=44100) -> torch.Tensor:
   139	        """Encode a waveform dictionary into normalized latent tensors."""
   140	
   141	        waveform = audio
   142	        waveform_sample_rate = sample_rate
   143	        input_device = waveform.device
   144	        expected_channels = self.autoencoder.encoder.in_channels
   145	        if waveform.shape[1] != expected_channels:
   146	            if waveform.shape[1] == 1:
   147	                waveform = waveform.expand(-1, expected_channels, *waveform.shape[2:])
   148	            else:
   149	                raise ValueError(
   150	                    f"Input audio must have {expected_channels} channels, got {waveform.shape[1]}"
   151	                )
   152	
   153	        mel_spec = self.preprocessor.waveform_to_mel(
   154	            waveform, waveform_sample_rate, device=waveform.device
   155	        )
   156	
   157	        latents = self.autoencoder.encode(mel_spec)
   158	        posterior = DiagonalGaussianDistribution(latents)
   159	        latent_mode = posterior.mode()
   160	
   161	        normalized = self.normalizer.normalize(latent_mode)
   162	        return normalized.to(input_device)
   163	
   164	    def decode(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   165	        """Decode normalized latent tensors into an audio waveform."""
   166	        original_shape = latents.shape
   167	
   168	        latents = self.normalizer.denormalize(latents)
   169	
   170	        target_shape = self.target_shape_from_latents(original_shape)
   171	        mel_spec = self.autoencoder.decode(latents, target_shape=target_shape)
   172	
   173	        waveform = self.run_vocoder(mel_spec)
   174	        return waveform
   175	
   176	    def target_shape_from_latents(self, latents_shape):
   177	        batch, _, time, _ = latents_shape
   178	        target_length = time * LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR
   179	        if self.autoencoder.causality_axis != CausalityAxis.NONE:
   180	            target_length -= LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR - 1
   181	        return (
   182	            batch,
   183	            self.autoencoder.decoder.out_ch,
   184	            target_length,
   185	            self.autoencoder.mel_bins,
   186	        )
   187	
   188	    def num_of_latents_from_frames(self, frames_number: int, frame_rate: int) -> int:
   189	        return math.ceil((float(frames_number) / frame_rate) * self.latents_per_second)
   190	
   191	    def run_vocoder(self, mel_spec: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   192	        audio_channels = self.autoencoder.decoder.out_ch
   193	        vocoder_input = mel_spec.transpose(2, 3)
   194	
   195	        if audio_channels == 1:
   196	            vocoder_input = vocoder_input.squeeze(1)
   197	        elif audio_channels != 2:
   198	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported audio_channels: {audio_channels}")
   199	
   200	        return self.vocoder(vocoder_input)
   201	
   202	    @property
   203	    def sample_rate(self) -> int:
   204	        return int(self.autoencoder.sampling_rate)
   205	
   206	    @property
   207	    def mel_hop_length(self) -> int:
   208	        return int(self.autoencoder.mel_hop_length)
   209	
   210	    @property
   211	    def mel_bins(self) -> int:
   212	        return int(self.autoencoder.mel_bins)
   213	
   214	    @property
   215	    def latent_channels(self) -> int:
   216	        return int(self.autoencoder.decoder.z_channels)
   217	
   218	    @property
   219	    def latent_frequency_bins(self) -> int:
   220	        return int(self.mel_bins // LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR)
   221	
   222	    @property
   223	    def latents_per_second(self) -> float:
   224	        return self.sample_rate / self.mel_hop_length / LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR
   225	
   226	    @property
   227	    def output_sample_rate(self) -> int:
   228	        output_rate = getattr(self.vocoder, "output_sample_rate", None)
   229	        if output_rate is not None:
   230	            return int(output_rate)
   231	        upsample_factor = getattr(self.vocoder, "upsample_factor", None)
   232	        if upsample_factor is None:
   233	            raise AttributeError(
   234	                "Vocoder is missing upsample_factor; cannot infer output sample rate"
   235	            )
   236	        return int(self.sample_rate * upsample_factor / self.mel_hop_length)
   237	
   238	    def memory_required(self, input_shape):
   239	        return self.device_manager.patcher.model_size()

     9	class LTXVAudioVAELoader(io.ComfyNode):
    10	    @classmethod
    11	    def define_schema(cls) -> io.Schema:
    12	        return io.Schema(
    13	            node_id="LTXVAudioVAELoader",
    14	            display_name="LTXV Audio VAE Loader",
    15	            category="audio",
    16	            inputs=[
    17	                io.Combo.Input(
    18	                    "ckpt_name",
    19	                    options=folder_paths.get_filename_list("checkpoints"),
    20	                    tooltip="Audio VAE checkpoint to load.",
    21	                )
    22	            ],
    23	            outputs=[io.Vae.Output(display_name="Audio VAE")],
    24	        )
    25	
    26	    @classmethod
    27	    def execute(cls, ckpt_name: str) -> io.NodeOutput:
    28	        ckpt_path = folder_paths.get_full_path_or_raise("checkpoints", ckpt_name)
    29	        sd, metadata = comfy.utils.load_torch_file(ckpt_path, return_metadata=True)
    30	        sd = comfy.utils.state_dict_prefix_replace(sd, {"audio_vae.": "autoencoder.", "vocoder.": "vocoder."}, filter_keys=True)
    31	        vae = comfy.sd.VAE(sd=sd, metadata=metadata)
    32	        vae.throw_exception_if_invalid()
    33	
    34	        return io.NodeOutput(vae)

    61	    @classmethod
    62	    def define_schema(cls) -> io.Schema:
    63	        return io.Schema(
    64	            node_id="LTXVAudioVAEDecode",
    65	            display_name="LTXV Audio VAE Decode",
    66	            category="audio",
    67	            inputs=[
    68	                io.Latent.Input("samples", tooltip="The latent to be decoded."),
    69	                io.Vae.Input(

    73	                ),
    74	            ],
    75	            outputs=[io.Audio.Output(display_name="Audio")],
    76	        )
    77	
    78	    @classmethod
    79	    def execute(cls, samples, audio_vae) -> io.NodeOutput:
    80	        audio_latent = samples["samples"]
    81	        if audio_latent.is_nested:
    82	            audio_latent = audio_latent.unbind()[-1]
    83	        audio = audio_vae.decode(audio_latent).movedim(-1, 1).to(audio_latent.device)
    84	        output_audio_sample_rate = audio_vae.first_stage_model.output_sample_rate
    85	        return io.NodeOutput(
    86	            {
    87	                "waveform": audio,
    88	                "sample_rate": int(output_audio_sample_rate),
    89	            }
    90	        )

   132	            ],
   133	            outputs=[io.Latent.Output(display_name="Latent")],
   134	        )
   135	
   136	    @classmethod
   137	    def execute(
   138	        cls,
   139	        frames_number: int,
   140	        frame_rate: int,
   141	        batch_size: int,
   142	        audio_vae,
   143	    ) -> io.NodeOutput:
   144	        """Generate empty audio latents matching the reference pipeline structure."""
   145	
   146	        assert audio_vae is not None, "Audio VAE model is required"
   147	
   148	        z_channels = audio_vae.latent_channels
   149	        audio_freq = audio_vae.first_stage_model.latent_frequency_bins
   150	        sampling_rate = int(audio_vae.first_stage_model.sample_rate)
   151	
   152	        num_audio_latents = audio_vae.first_stage_model.num_of_latents_from_frames(frames_number, frame_rate)
   153	
   154	        audio_latents = torch.zeros(
   155	            (batch_size, z_channels, num_audio_latents, audio_freq),
   156	            device=comfy.model_management.intermediate_device(),
   157	        )
   158	
   159	        return io.NodeOutput(
   160	            {
   161	                "samples": audio_latents,
   162	                "sample_rate": sampling_rate,
   163	                "type": "audio",
   164	            }
   165	        )

   208	public final class LTX2BigVGANGenerator: Module {
   209	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv_pre") var convPre: Conv1d
   210	  @ModuleInfo(key: "ups") var ups: [ConvTransposed1d]
   211	  @ModuleInfo(key: "resblocks") var resblocks: [LTX2AMPBlock]
   212	  @ModuleInfo(key: "act_post") var actPost: LTX2AntiAliasActivation
   213	  @ModuleInfo(key: "conv_post") var convPost: Conv1d
   214	
   215	  let numKernels: Int
   216	
   217	  public init(config: LTX2BigVGANConfig) {
   218	    self.numKernels = config.resblockKernels.count
   219	
   220	    self._convPre.wrappedValue = Conv1d(
   221	      inputChannels: config.melChannels, outputChannels: config.upsampleInitialChannels,
   222	      kernelSize: 7, padding: 3)
   223	
   224	    var ch = config.upsampleInitialChannels
   225	    var upList: [ConvTransposed1d] = []
   226	    var blocks: [LTX2AMPBlock] = []
   227	    for (i, rate) in config.upsampleRates.enumerated() {
   228	      let k = config.upsampleKernels[i]
   229	      let outCh = ch / 2
   230	      upList.append(ConvTransposed1d(
   231	        inputChannels: ch, outputChannels: outCh,
   232	        kernelSize: k, stride: rate, padding: (k - rate) / 2))
   233	      for rk in config.resblockKernels {
   234	        blocks.append(LTX2AMPBlock(
   235	          channels: outCh, kernelSize: rk, dilations: config.resblockDilations))
   236	      }
   237	      ch = outCh
   238	    }
   239	    self._ups.wrappedValue = upList
   240	    self._resblocks.wrappedValue = blocks
   241	
   242	    self._actPost.wrappedValue = LTX2AntiAliasActivation(channels: ch)
   243	    self._convPost.wrappedValue = Conv1d(
   244	      inputChannels: ch, outputChannels: 2, kernelSize: 7, padding: 3, bias: false)
   245	    super.init()
   246	  }
   247	
   248	  /// - Parameter mel: NLC `[B, T, melChannels]`.
   249	  /// - Returns: NLC `[B, T·∏rates, 2]` stereo waveform in [-1, 1].
   250	  public func callAsFunction(_ mel: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   251	    var x = convPre(mel)
   252	    for i in 0..<ups.count {
   253	      x = ups[i](x)
   254	      var xs = resblocks[i * numKernels](x)
   255	      for j in 1..<numKernels {
   256	        xs = xs + resblocks[i * numKernels + j](x)
   257	      }
   258	      x = xs / MLXArray(Float(numKernels))
   259	    }
   260	    x = actPost(x)
   261	    x = convPost(x)
   262	    return MLX.tanh(x)
   263	  }
   264	}

   302	  /// Synthesize a stereo waveform from a mel spectrogram via the MAIN generator.
   303	  ///
   304	  /// - Parameter mel: channels-first `[B, 128, T]`.
   305	  /// - Returns: channels-first `[B, 2, T·160]` waveform in [-1, 1].
   306	  public func synthesize(_ mel: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   307	    let nlc = mel.transposed(0, 2, 1)         // [B, T, 128]
   308	    let wave = vocoder(nlc)                    // [B, T·160, 2]
   309	    return wave.transposed(0, 2, 1)            // [B, 2, T·160]
   310	  }

    43	class AudioLatentNormalizer:
    44	    """Applies per-channel statistics in patch space and restores original layout."""
    45	
    46	    def __init__(self, patchfier: AudioPatchifier, statistics_processor: torch.nn.Module):
    47	        self.patchifier = patchfier
    48	        self.statistics = statistics_processor
    49	
    50	    def normalize(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    51	        channels = latents.shape[1]
    52	        freq = latents.shape[3]
    53	        patched, _ = self.patchifier.patchify(latents)
    54	        normalized = self.statistics.normalize(patched)
    55	        return self.patchifier.unpatchify(normalized, channels=channels, freq=freq)
    56	
    57	    def denormalize(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    58	        channels = latents.shape[1]
    59	        freq = latents.shape[3]
    60	        patched, _ = self.patchifier.patchify(latents)
    61	        denormalized = self.statistics.un_normalize(patched)
    62	        return self.patchifier.unpatchify(denormalized, channels=channels, freq=freq)

    65	class AudioPreprocessor:
    66	    """Prepares raw waveforms for the autoencoder by matching training conditions."""
    67	
    68	    def __init__(self, target_sample_rate: int, mel_bins: int, mel_hop_length: int, n_fft: int):
    69	        self.target_sample_rate = target_sample_rate
    70	        self.mel_bins = mel_bins
    71	        self.mel_hop_length = mel_hop_length
    72	        self.n_fft = n_fft
    73	
    74	    def resample(self, waveform: torch.Tensor, source_rate: int) -> torch.Tensor:
    75	        if source_rate == self.target_sample_rate:
    76	            return waveform
    77	        return torchaudio.functional.resample(waveform, source_rate, self.target_sample_rate)
    78	
    79	    def waveform_to_mel(
    80	        self, waveform: torch.Tensor, waveform_sample_rate: int, device
    81	    ) -> torch.Tensor:
    82	        waveform = self.resample(waveform, waveform_sample_rate)
    83	
    84	        mel_transform = torchaudio.transforms.MelSpectrogram(
    85	            sample_rate=self.target_sample_rate,
    86	            n_fft=self.n_fft,
    87	            win_length=self.n_fft,
    88	            hop_length=self.mel_hop_length,
    89	            f_min=0.0,
    90	            f_max=self.target_sample_rate / 2.0,
    91	            n_mels=self.mel_bins,
    92	            window_fn=torch.hann_window,
    93	            center=True,
    94	            pad_mode="reflect",
    95	            power=1.0,
    96	            mel_scale="slaney",
    97	            norm="slaney",
    98	        ).to(device)
    99	
   100	        mel = mel_transform(waveform)
   101	        mel = torch.log(torch.clamp(mel, min=1e-5))
   102	        return mel.permute(0, 1, 3, 2).contiguous()
