   105	class AudioVAE(torch.nn.Module):
   106	    """High-level Audio VAE wrapper exposing encode and decode entry points."""
   107	
   108	    def __init__(self, metadata: dict):
   109	        super().__init__()
   110	
   111	        component_config = AudioVAEComponentConfig.from_metadata(metadata)
   112	
   113	        self.autoencoder = CausalAudioAutoencoder(config=component_config.autoencoder)
   114	        if "bwe" in component_config.vocoder:
   115	            self.vocoder = VocoderWithBWE(config=component_config.vocoder)
   116	        else:
   117	            self.vocoder = Vocoder(config=component_config.vocoder)
   118	
   119	        autoencoder_config = self.autoencoder.get_config()
   120	        self.normalizer = AudioLatentNormalizer(
   121	            AudioPatchifier(
   122	                patch_size=1,
   123	                audio_latent_downsample_factor=LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR,
   124	                sample_rate=autoencoder_config["sampling_rate"],
   125	                hop_length=autoencoder_config["mel_hop_length"],
   126	                is_causal=autoencoder_config["is_causal"],
   127	            ),
   128	            self.autoencoder.per_channel_statistics,
   129	        )
   130	
   131	        self.preprocessor = AudioPreprocessor(
   132	            target_sample_rate=autoencoder_config["sampling_rate"],
   133	            mel_bins=autoencoder_config["mel_bins"],
   134	            mel_hop_length=autoencoder_config["mel_hop_length"],
   135	            n_fft=autoencoder_config["n_fft"],
   136	        )
   137	
   138	    def encode(self, audio, sample_rate=44100) -> torch.Tensor:
   139	        """Encode a waveform dictionary into normalized latent tensors."""
   140	
   141	        waveform = audio
   142	        waveform_sample_rate = sample_rate
   143	        input_device = waveform.device
   144	        expected_channels = self.autoencoder.encoder.in_channels
   145	        if waveform.shape[1] != expected_channels:
   146	            if waveform.shape[1] == 1:
   147	                waveform = waveform.expand(-1, expected_channels, *waveform.shape[2:])
   148	            else:
   149	                raise ValueError(
   150	                    f"Input audio must have {expected_channels} channels, got {waveform.shape[1]}"
   151	                )
   152	
   153	        mel_spec = self.preprocessor.waveform_to_mel(
   154	            waveform, waveform_sample_rate, device=waveform.device
   155	        )
   156	
   157	        latents = self.autoencoder.encode(mel_spec)
   158	        posterior = DiagonalGaussianDistribution(latents)
   159	        latent_mode = posterior.mode()
   160	
   161	        normalized = self.normalizer.normalize(latent_mode)
   162	        return normalized.to(input_device)
   163	
   164	    def decode(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   165	        """Decode normalized latent tensors into an audio waveform."""
   166	        original_shape = latents.shape
   167	
   168	        latents = self.normalizer.denormalize(latents)
   169	
   170	        target_shape = self.target_shape_from_latents(original_shape)
   171	        mel_spec = self.autoencoder.decode(latents, target_shape=target_shape)
   172	
   173	        waveform = self.run_vocoder(mel_spec)
   174	        return waveform
   175	
   176	    def target_shape_from_latents(self, latents_shape):
   177	        batch, _, time, _ = latents_shape
   178	        target_length = time * LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR
   179	        if self.autoencoder.causality_axis != CausalityAxis.NONE:
   180	            target_length -= LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR - 1
   181	        return (
   182	            batch,
   183	            self.autoencoder.decoder.out_ch,
   184	            target_length,
   185	            self.autoencoder.mel_bins,
   186	        )
   187	
   188	    def num_of_latents_from_frames(self, frames_number: int, frame_rate: int) -> int:
   189	        return math.ceil((float(frames_number) / frame_rate) * self.latents_per_second)
   190	
   191	    def run_vocoder(self, mel_spec: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   192	        audio_channels = self.autoencoder.decoder.out_ch
   193	        vocoder_input = mel_spec.transpose(2, 3)
   194	
   195	        if audio_channels == 1:
   196	            vocoder_input = vocoder_input.squeeze(1)
   197	        elif audio_channels != 2:
   198	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported audio_channels: {audio_channels}")
   199	
   200	        return self.vocoder(vocoder_input)
   201	
   202	    @property
   203	    def sample_rate(self) -> int:
   204	        return int(self.autoencoder.sampling_rate)
   205	
   206	    @property
   207	    def mel_hop_length(self) -> int:
   208	        return int(self.autoencoder.mel_hop_length)
   209	
   210	    @property
   211	    def mel_bins(self) -> int:
   212	        return int(self.autoencoder.mel_bins)
   213	
   214	    @property
   215	    def latent_channels(self) -> int:
   216	        return int(self.autoencoder.decoder.z_channels)
   217	
   218	    @property
   219	    def latent_frequency_bins(self) -> int:
   220	        return int(self.mel_bins // LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR)
   221	
   222	    @property
   223	    def latents_per_second(self) -> float:
   224	        return self.sample_rate / self.mel_hop_length / LATENT_DOWNSAMPLE_FACTOR
   225	
   226	    @property
   227	    def output_sample_rate(self) -> int:
   228	        output_rate = getattr(self.vocoder, "output_sample_rate", None)
   229	        if output_rate is not None:
   230	            return int(output_rate)
   231	        upsample_factor = getattr(self.vocoder, "upsample_factor", None)
   232	        if upsample_factor is None:
   233	            raise AttributeError(
   234	                "Vocoder is missing upsample_factor; cannot infer output sample rate"
   235	            )
   236	        return int(self.sample_rate * upsample_factor / self.mel_hop_length)
   237	
   238	    def memory_required(self, input_shape):
   239	        return self.device_manager.patcher.model_size()
   630	
   631	        n_freqs = filter_length // 2 + 1
   632	        self.register_buffer("mel_basis", torch.zeros(n_mel_channels, n_freqs))
   633	
   634	    def mel_spectrogram(
   635	        self, y: torch.Tensor
   636	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
   637	        """Compute log-mel spectrogram and auxiliary spectral quantities.
   638	
   639	        Args:
   640	            y: Waveform tensor of shape (B, T).
   641	
   642	        Returns:
   643	            log_mel:   Log-compressed mel spectrogram, shape (B, n_mel_channels, T_frames).
   644	                       Computed as log(clamp(mel_basis @ magnitude, min=1e-5)).
   645	            magnitude: Linear amplitude spectrogram, shape (B, n_freqs, T_frames).
   646	            phase:     Phase spectrogram in radians, shape (B, n_freqs, T_frames).
   647	            energy:    Per-frame energy (L2 norm over frequency), shape (B, T_frames).
   648	        """
   649	        magnitude, phase = self.stft_fn(y)
   650	        energy = torch.norm(magnitude, dim=1)
   651	        mel = torch.matmul(comfy.model_management.cast_to(self.mel_basis, dtype=magnitude.dtype, device=y.device), magnitude)
   652	        log_mel = torch.log(torch.clamp(mel, min=1e-5))
   653	        return log_mel, magnitude, phase, energy
   654	
   655	
   656	class VocoderWithBWE(torch.nn.Module):
   657	    """Vocoder with bandwidth extension (BWE) for higher sample rate output.
   658	
   659	    Chains a base vocoder (mel → low-rate waveform) with a BWE stage that upsamples
   660	    to a higher rate. The BWE computes a mel spectrogram from the low-rate waveform.
   661	    """
   662	
   663	    def __init__(self, config):
   664	        super().__init__()
   665	        vocoder_config = config["vocoder"]
   666	        bwe_config = config["bwe"]
   667	
   668	        self.vocoder = Vocoder(config=vocoder_config)
   669	        self.bwe_generator = Vocoder(
   670	            config={**bwe_config, "apply_final_activation": False}
   671	        )
   672	
   673	        self.input_sample_rate = bwe_config["input_sampling_rate"]
   674	        self.output_sample_rate = bwe_config["output_sampling_rate"]
   675	        self.hop_length = bwe_config["hop_length"]
   676	
   677	        self.mel_stft = MelSTFT(
   678	            filter_length=bwe_config["n_fft"],
   679	            hop_length=bwe_config["hop_length"],
   680	            win_length=bwe_config["n_fft"],
   681	            n_mel_channels=bwe_config["num_mels"],
   682	            sampling_rate=bwe_config["input_sampling_rate"],
   683	            mel_fmin=0.0,
   684	            mel_fmax=bwe_config["input_sampling_rate"] / 2.0,
   685	        )
   686	        self.resampler = UpSample1d(
   687	            ratio=bwe_config["output_sampling_rate"] // bwe_config["input_sampling_rate"],
   688	            persistent=False,
   689	            window_type="hann",
   690	        )
   691	
   692	    def _compute_mel(self, audio):
   693	        """Compute log-mel spectrogram from waveform using causal STFT bases."""
   694	        B, C, T = audio.shape
   695	        flat = audio.reshape(B * C, -1)                         # (B*C, T)
   696	        mel, _, _, _ = self.mel_stft.mel_spectrogram(flat)      # (B*C, n_mels, T_frames)
   697	        return mel.reshape(B, C, mel.shape[1], mel.shape[2])    # (B, C, n_mels, T_frames)
   698	
   699	    def forward(self, mel_spec):
   700	        x = self.vocoder(mel_spec)
   701	        _, _, T_low = x.shape
   702	        T_out = T_low * self.output_sample_rate // self.input_sample_rate
   703	
   704	        remainder = T_low % self.hop_length
   705	        if remainder != 0:
   706	            x = F.pad(x, (0, self.hop_length - remainder))
   707	
   708	        mel = self._compute_mel(x)
   709	        residual = self.bwe_generator(mel)
   710	        skip = self.resampler(x)
   711	        assert residual.shape == skip.shape, f"residual {residual.shape} != skip {skip.shape}"
   712	
   713	        return torch.clamp(residual + skip, -1, 1)[..., :T_out]
   130	            q=self._patch_size[2],
   131	        )
   132	        return latents
   133	
   134	
   135	class AudioPatchifier(Patchifier):
   136	    def __init__(self, patch_size: int,
   137	        sample_rate=16000,
   138	        hop_length=160,
   139	        audio_latent_downsample_factor=4,
   140	        is_causal=True,
   141	        start_end=False,
   142	        shift = 0
   143	    ):
   144	        super().__init__(patch_size, start_end=start_end)
   145	        self.hop_length = hop_length
   146	        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
   147	        self.audio_latent_downsample_factor = audio_latent_downsample_factor
   148	        self.is_causal = is_causal
   149	        self.shift = shift
   150	
   151	    def copy_with_shift(self, shift):
   152	        return AudioPatchifier(
   153	            self.patch_size, self.sample_rate, self.hop_length, self.audio_latent_downsample_factor,
   154	            self.is_causal, self.start_end, shift
   155	        )
   156	
   157	    def _get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(self, start_latent, end_latent: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device=torch.device):
   158	        audio_latent_frame = torch.arange(start_latent, end_latent, dtype=dtype, device=device)
   159	        audio_mel_frame = audio_latent_frame * self.audio_latent_downsample_factor
   160	        if self.is_causal:
   161	            audio_mel_frame = (audio_mel_frame + 1 - self.audio_latent_downsample_factor).clip(min=0)
   162	        return audio_mel_frame * self.hop_length / self.sample_rate
   163	
   164	
   165	    def patchify(self, audio_latents: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
   166	        # audio_latents: (batch, channels, time, freq)
   167	        b, _, t, _ = audio_latents.shape
   168	        audio_latents = rearrange(
   169	            audio_latents,
   170	            "b c t f -> b t (c f)",
   171	        )
   172	
   173	        audio_latents_start_timings = self._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(self.shift, t + self.shift, torch.float32, audio_latents.device)
   174	        audio_latents_start_timings = audio_latents_start_timings.unsqueeze(0).expand(b, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   175	
   176	        if self.start_end:
   177	            audio_latents_end_timings = self._get_audio_latent_time_in_sec(self.shift + 1, t + self.shift + 1, torch.float32, audio_latents.device)
   178	            audio_latents_end_timings = audio_latents_end_timings.unsqueeze(0).expand(b, -1).unsqueeze(1)
   179	
   180	            audio_latents_timings = torch.stack([audio_latents_start_timings, audio_latents_end_timings], dim=-1)
   181	        else:
   182	            audio_latents_timings = audio_latents_start_timings
   183	        return audio_latents, audio_latents_timings
   184	
   185	    def unpatchify(self, audio_latents: torch.Tensor, channels: int, freq: int) -> torch.Tensor:
   186	        # audio_latents: (batch, time, freq * channels)
   187	        audio_latents = rearrange(
   188	            audio_latents, "b t (c f) -> b c t f", c=channels, f=freq
   189	        )
   190	        return audio_latents

    34	## 2. The four wires
    35	
    36	### Wire 1 — audio latents through the denoising loop (the project)
    37	- Allocate audio latents alongside video latents (shapes/token layout per
    38	  the reference `transformer.py`; audio token count derives from clip
    39	  duration at the audio latent rate).
    40	- Implement the cross-modal attention math in `LTX2CrossModalAttention`
    41	  (replace the stub; weights already load into its slots).
    42	- Audio AdaLN/timestep conditioning via the existing top-level audio branch.
    43	- NAG: the reference author feeds dedicated NEGATIVE audio conditioning
    44	  (08-02 handoff note) — audio joins the NAG positive-pass extrapolation the
    45	  same way video context does.
    46	- Two-stage: audio rides the BASE pass only; the refine pass is spatial
    47	  upsampling and must not touch audio latents. (Verify against the reference
    48	  graphs before assuming — acceptance test 5.3.)
    49	- Scheduler: same sigma schedule as video per reference (verify; if audio
    50	  uses its own schedule, it becomes a registry param via #9's machinery).
    51	
    52	### Wire 2 — decode: latents → mel → waveform
    53	`audio latents → LTX2AudioVAE.decode → mel [B,128,T] → LTX2Vocoder.synthesize
    54	→ stereo PCM`. The AudioVAE golden-tensor validation happens HERE, first:
    55	decode a reference latent from the ComfyUI implementation and compare mel
    56	outputs before trusting the whole chain (the upsampler taught us what
    57	partially-bound/unvalidated modules do).
    58

    60	`LTX2PostProcess.writeMP4` gains an optional PCM track (AVFoundation:

    68	  request/preset-overridable) so provenance/readout come free.

    70	
    71	## 3. Sequencing (validation-first, per the don't-generalize rule)
    72	
    73	1. **Wire 2 first, standalone:** golden-tensor the AudioVAE + vocoder against
    74	   reference outputs (export mel/waveform from the ComfyUI graph on Bolt).
    75	   No pipeline work until the decode chain is proven.
    76	2. Wire 3 (mux) with a synthetic tone — testable without the model.
    77	3. Wire 1 (the transformer/denoise work), behind `audio: false` default.
    78	4. Wire 4 last (it's mechanical once 1–3 exist).
    79	5. A/B: same seed with/without audio — VIDEO output must be unchanged when
    80	   audio=false (byte-comparable latents), and visually equivalent when
    81	   audio=true (cross-modal attention changes the video pathway; the
    82	   reference behavior is "audio-aware video", so equivalence is judged, not
    83	   byte-asserted — Todd's eyes).
    84	
    85	## 4. Acceptance
    86	
    87	1. AudioVAE mel output matches reference golden tensor (tolerance TBD from
    88	   fp16 comparison), vocoder waveform audibly clean on a reference mel.
    89	2. Muxed mp4 plays with audio in QuickTime/Telegram; A/V duration match
    90	   within one frame.
    91	3. audio=false renders are unchanged vs today (the no-regression gate).
    92	4. audio=true at production config (832x448, 241f single-pass, i2v 0.5 +
    93	   NAG): clip sounds plausibly synchronized — speech/foley matches visible
    94	   action. Judged by ear (no automated metric exists here).
    95	5. Two-stage + audio: refine leaves the audio track intact.
    96	6. Memory: peak RSS during an audio render stays within the 40GB admission
    97	   gate (audio branch adds active compute the gate was not sized for —
    98	   measure, then adjust the gate if needed).
    99	
   100	## 5. Risks
   101	
   102	- **AudioVAE was never validated** — could be subtly wrong (the mesh-artifact
   103	  lesson). Mitigated by golden-tensor-first sequencing.
   104	- Cross-modal attention is new math, not a port-and-call — the largest
   105	  correctness surface. Port line-by-line from reference `transformer.py`
   106	  with shape asserts at each seam.
   107	- int8: audio-branch linears were quantized with everything else, but no
   108	  audio render has ever exercised them. If quality is off, the A/B vs a
   109	  bf16 monolith isolates quantization (plist repoint, no code).
   110	- Distil LoRA was baked with audio branches SKIPPED at merge — matches the
   111	  reference author's LoRA (video-only deltas), but verify his v1.8 audio
   112	  demos used the distilled checkpoint at all.

    92	  /// Initialize the LTX-2 transformer.
    93	  ///
    94	  /// - Parameters:
    95	  ///   - numHeads: Number of attention heads. Default 32.
    96	  ///   - headDim: Dimension per head. Default 128.
    97	  ///   - inChannels: Latent input channels. Default 128.
    98	  ///   - outChannels: Output channels. Default 128.
    99	  ///   - numLayers: Number of transformer blocks. Default 48.
   100	  ///   - crossAttentionDim: Text embedding dimension. Default 4096.
   101	  ///   - captionChannels: Caption input channels for text projection. Default 3840.
   102	  ///   - normEps: Epsilon for layer norms. Default 1e-6.
   103	  ///   - hasPromptAdaLN: Whether to use LTX-2.3 prompt AdaLN. Default false.
   104	  ///   - timestepScaleMultiplier: Scale factor for timestep. Default 1000.
   105	  ///   - positionalEmbeddingTheta: RoPE theta. Default 10000.
   106	  ///   - positionalEmbeddingMaxPos: Max positions per dim. Default [20, 2048, 2048].
   107	  ///   - useMiddleIndicesGrid: Use midpoint of position ranges. Default true.
   108	  ///   - ropeMode: RoPE mode. Default `.split`.
   109	  public init(
   110	    numHeads: Int = 32,
   111	    headDim: Int = 128,
   112	    inChannels: Int = 128,
   113	    outChannels: Int = 128,
   114	    numLayers: Int = 48,
   115	    crossAttentionDim: Int = 4096,
   116	    captionChannels: Int = 3840,
   117	    normEps: Float = 1e-6,
   118	    hasPromptAdaLN: Bool = false,
   119	    timestepScaleMultiplier: Float = 1000,
   120	    positionalEmbeddingTheta: Float = 10000,
   121	    positionalEmbeddingMaxPos: [Int] = [20, 2048, 2048],
   122	    useMiddleIndicesGrid: Bool = true,
   123	    ropeMode: LTX2RoPEMode = .split,
   124	    doublePrecisionRoPE: Bool = false,
   125	    hasAudio: Bool = false,
   126	    audioInnerDim: Int = 2048,
   127	    audioInChannels: Int = 128
   128	  ) {
   129	    self.hasAudio = hasAudio
   130	    self.audioInnerDim = audioInnerDim
   131	    self.innerDim = numHeads * headDim
   132	    self.numHeads = numHeads
   133	    self.headDim = headDim
   134	    self.numLayers = numLayers
   135	    self.inChannels = inChannels
   136	    self.outChannels = outChannels
   137	    self.normEps = normEps
   138	    self.hasPromptAdaLN = hasPromptAdaLN
   139	    self.timestepScaleMultiplier = timestepScaleMultiplier
   140	    self.positionalEmbeddingTheta = positionalEmbeddingTheta
   141	    self.positionalEmbeddingMaxPos = positionalEmbeddingMaxPos
   142	    self.useMiddleIndicesGrid = useMiddleIndicesGrid
   143	    self.ropeMode = ropeMode
   144	    self.doublePrecisionRoPE = doublePrecisionRoPE
   145	
   146	    // Patchify projection: latent channels -> inner dim
   147	    self._patchifyProj.wrappedValue = Linear(inChannels, innerDim, bias: true)
   148	
   149	    // Timestep conditioning AdaLN
   150	    let adaLNCoefficient = hasPromptAdaLN ? 9 : 6
   151	    self._adaLNSingle.wrappedValue = LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(
   152	      embeddingDim: innerDim,
   153	      embeddingCoefficient: adaLNCoefficient
   154	    )
   155	
   156	    // Text conditioning
   157	    if hasPromptAdaLN {
   158	      self._captionProjection.wrappedValue = nil
   159	      self._promptAdaLNSingle.wrappedValue = LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(
   160	        embeddingDim: innerDim,
   161	        embeddingCoefficient: 2
   162	      )
   163	    } else {
   164	      self._captionProjection.wrappedValue = LTX2TextProjection(
   165	        inFeatures: captionChannels,
   166	        hiddenSize: innerDim
   167	      )
   168	      self._promptAdaLNSingle.wrappedValue = nil
   169	    }
   170	
   171	    // 48 transformer blocks
   172	    var blocks: [LTX2TransformerBlock] = []
   173	    for _ in 0..<numLayers {
   174	      blocks.append(LTX2TransformerBlock(
   175	        dim: innerDim,
   176	        contextDim: crossAttentionDim,
   177	        heads: numHeads,
   178	        dimHead: headDim,
   179	        normEps: normEps,
   180	        ropeMode: ropeMode,
   181	        hasPromptAdaLN: hasPromptAdaLN,
   182	        hasAudio: hasAudio,
   183	        audioDim: audioInnerDim
   184	      ))
   185	    }
   186	    self._transformerBlocks.wrappedValue = blocks
   187	
   188	    // Output projection
   189	    self._scaleShiftTable.wrappedValue = MLXArray.zeros([2, innerDim])
   190	    self._normOut.wrappedValue = LayerNorm(dimensions: innerDim, eps: normEps, affine: false)
   191	    self._projOut.wrappedValue = Linear(innerDim, outChannels)
   192	
   193	    // Top-level audio branch.
   194	    if hasAudio {

   196	      self._audioProjOut.wrappedValue = Linear(audioInnerDim, audioInChannels, bias: true)
   197	      self._audioAdaLNSingle.wrappedValue =
   198	        LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(embeddingDim: audioInnerDim, embeddingCoefficient: 9)
   199	      self._audioPromptAdaLNSingle.wrappedValue =
   200	        LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(embeddingDim: audioInnerDim, embeddingCoefficient: 2)
   201	      self._audioScaleShiftTable.wrappedValue = MLXArray.zeros([2, audioInnerDim])
   202	      self._avCaA2vGateAdaLN.wrappedValue =
   203	        LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(embeddingDim: innerDim, embeddingCoefficient: 1)
   204	      self._avCaV2aGateAdaLN.wrappedValue =
   205	        LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(embeddingDim: audioInnerDim, embeddingCoefficient: 1)
   206	      self._avCaVideoScaleShiftAdaLN.wrappedValue =
   207	        LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(embeddingDim: innerDim, embeddingCoefficient: 4)
   208	      self._avCaAudioScaleShiftAdaLN.wrappedValue =
   209	        LTX2AdaLayerNormSingle(embeddingDim: audioInnerDim, embeddingCoefficient: 4)
   210	    }

   212	    super.init()
   213	  }
   214	
   215	  /// Forward pass through the transformer.
   216	  ///
   217	  /// - Parameters:
   218	  ///   - latent: Flattened latent tokens `(B, numTokens, inChannels)`.
   219	  ///   - timestep: Raw timestep value (will be scaled by timestepScaleMultiplier).
   220	  ///   - context: Text embeddings `(B, seqLen, captionChannels or crossAttentionDim)`.
   225	  ///   - stgBlocks: Block indices where self-attention is skipped (STG).
   226	  /// - Returns: Velocity prediction `(B, numTokens, outChannels)`.
   227	  ///   - nagContext: NAG's own negative conditioning, projected the same way as
   228	  ///     `context`. Nil (or a disabled `nag`) leaves the forward pass unchanged.
   229	  ///   - nag: NAG strength/blend/clamp; `.disabled` is a true no-op.
   230	  public func callAsFunction(
   231	    latent: MLXArray,
   232	    timestep: MLXArray,
   233	    context: MLXArray,
   234	    positions: MLXArray,
   235	    contextMask: MLXArray? = nil,
   236	    sigma: MLXArray? = nil,
   237	    precomputedPE: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray)? = nil,
   238	    stgBlocks: Set<Int>? = nil,
   239	    nagContext: MLXArray? = nil,
   240	    nag: LTX2NAGConfig = .disabled
   241	  ) -> MLXArray {
   242	    let batchSize = latent.dim(0)
   243	
   244	    // 1. Patchify projection
   245	    var x = patchifyProj(latent)
   246	
   247	    // 2. Timestep conditioning
   248	    let scaledTimestep = timestep * timestepScaleMultiplier
   249	    let (timestepEmb, embeddedTimestep) = adaLNSingle(
   250	      scaledTimestep.reshaped(-1),
   251	      hiddenDtype: x.dtype
   252	    )
   253	    // Reshape to (B, 1, dim) for broadcasting
   254	    let tsEmb = timestepEmb.reshaped(batchSize, -1, timestepEmb.dim(-1))
   255	    let embTS = embeddedTimestep.reshaped(batchSize, -1, embeddedTimestep.dim(-1))
   256	
   257	    // 3. Text conditioning
   258	    var ctx = context
   259	    if let captionProj = captionProjection {
   260	      ctx = captionProj(ctx)
   261	    }
   262	    ctx = ctx.reshaped(batchSize, -1, x.dim(-1))
   263	
   264	    // NAG's negative conditioning goes through the SAME caption projection and
   265	    // reshape as the positive context — otherwise the two cross-attention
   266	    // outputs live in different spaces and the extrapolation is meaningless.
   267	    var nagCtx: MLXArray? = nil
   268	    if nag.isEnabled, var nctx = nagContext {
   269	      if let captionProj = captionProjection { nctx = captionProj(nctx) }
   270	      nagCtx = nctx.reshaped(batchSize, -1, x.dim(-1))
   271	    }
   272	
   273	    // Prepare attention mask
   274	    var attnMask = contextMask
   275	    if let mask = attnMask {
   276	      if mask.dtype != .float32 && mask.dtype != .float16 && mask.dtype != .bfloat16 {
   277	        // Convert boolean/int mask to float: 0 -> -1e9, 1 -> 0
   278	        let floatMask = (mask.asType(latent.dtype) - 1) * 1e9
   279	        attnMask = floatMask.reshaped(mask.dim(0), 1, -1, mask.dim(-1))
   280	      }
   281	    }
   282	
   283	    // 4. RoPE
   284	    let pe: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray)
   285	    if let precomputed = precomputedPE {
   286	      pe = precomputed
   287	    } else {
   288	      pe = ltx2PrecomputeFreqsCIS(
   289	        indicesGrid: positions,
   290	        dim: innerDim,
   291	        theta: positionalEmbeddingTheta,
   292	        maxPos: positionalEmbeddingMaxPos,
   293	        useMiddleIndicesGrid: useMiddleIndicesGrid,
   294	        numAttentionHeads: numHeads,
   295	        ropeMode: ropeMode
   296	      )
   297	    }
   298	
   299	    // Prompt-conditioned timestep for LTX-2.3
   300	    var promptTS: MLXArray? = nil
   301	    if let promptAda = promptAdaLNSingle, let s = sigma {
   302	      let scaledSigma = s * timestepScaleMultiplier
   303	      let (pTS, _) = promptAda(scaledSigma.reshaped(-1), hiddenDtype: x.dtype)
   304	      promptTS = pTS.reshaped(batchSize, -1, pTS.dim(-1))
   305	    }
   306	
   307	    // 5. Process through all transformer blocks
   308	    let stgSet = stgBlocks ?? Set<Int>()
   309	    for (idx, block) in transformerBlocks.enumerated() {
   310	      x = block(
   311	        x,
   312	        context: ctx,
   313	        contextMask: attnMask,
   314	        timestep: tsEmb,
   315	        pe: pe,
   316	        skipSelfAttn: stgSet.contains(idx),
   317	        promptTimestep: promptTS,
   318	        negativeContext: nagCtx,
   319	        nag: nag
   320	      )
   321	    }
   322	
   323	    // 6. Output projection with AdaLN modulation
   324	    x = processOutput(x: x, embeddedTimestep: embTS)
   325	
   326	    return x
   327	  }
   328	
   329	  /// Apply final output modulation and projection.
   330	  ///
   331	  /// Combines the learned scale_shift_table with the embedded timestep,
   332	  /// then applies LayerNorm, modulation, and final Linear.
   333	  ///
   334	  /// - Parameters:
   335	  ///   - x: Hidden states `(B, T, innerDim)`.
   365	  /// - Remaps `.ff.net.2.` -> `.ff.proj_out.`
   366	  /// - Remaps `.linear_1.` -> `.linear1.`
   367	  /// - Remaps `.linear_2.` -> `.linear2.`
   368	  ///
   369	  /// - Parameter weights: Raw weight dictionary.
   370	  /// - Returns: Sanitized weight dictionary.
   371	  /// Audio-inclusive weight sanitization for the JoyAI-Echo dual-stream load.
   372	  ///
   373	  /// Same as `sanitizeWeights` for the video keys, but instead of DROPPING the
   374	  /// `model.diffusion_model.` audio branch it KEEPS and remaps it onto this
   375	  /// module's (hasAudio) parameter namespace: strips the prefix, applies the
   376	  /// shared name remaps (`.to_out.0.`→`.to_out.`, video `.ff.net.*`→`.ff.proj_*`)
   377	  /// plus the audio-FF remaps (`.audio_ff.net.0.proj.`→`.audio_ff.proj_in.`,
   378	  /// `.audio_ff.net.2.`→`.audio_ff.proj_out.`). Connectors and aggregate embeds
   379	  /// (text-encoder concerns) are still skipped.
   380	  ///
   381	  /// Use only with a transformer built `hasAudio: true`.
   382	  public static func sanitizeWeightsWithAudio(_ weights: [String: MLXArray]) -> [String: MLXArray] {
   383	    var sanitized: [String: MLXArray] = [:]
   384	    for (key, value) in weights where key.hasPrefix("model.diffusion_model.") {
   385	      // Connectors + aggregate embeds live on the text-encoder side.
   386	      if key.contains("embeddings_connector") || key.contains("aggregate_embed") { continue }
   387	
   388	      var newKey = String(key.dropFirst("model.diffusion_model.".count))
   389	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".to_out.0.", with: ".to_out.")
   390	      // Audio FF first (more specific), then video FF.
   391	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".audio_ff.net.0.proj.", with: ".audio_ff.proj_in.")
   392	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".audio_ff.net.2.", with: ".audio_ff.proj_out.")
   393	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".ff.net.0.proj.", with: ".ff.proj_in.")
   394	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".ff.net.2.", with: ".ff.proj_out.")
   395	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".linear_1.", with: ".linear1.")
   396	      newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".linear_2.", with: ".linear2.")
   397	      sanitized[newKey] = value
   398	    }
   399	    return sanitized
   400	  }
   401	
   402	  public static func sanitizeWeights(_ weights: [String: MLXArray]) -> [String: MLXArray] {
   403	    // Detect which prefix format the checkpoint uses.
   404	    // LTX-2.3 distilled/dev weights use "transformer." prefix.
   405	    // Older checkpoints use "model.diffusion_model." prefix.
   406	    let hasTransformerPrefix = weights.keys.contains { $0.hasPrefix("transformer.") }
   407	    let hasModelPrefix = weights.keys.contains { $0.hasPrefix("model.diffusion_model.") }
   408	
   409	    guard hasTransformerPrefix || hasModelPrefix else { return weights }
   410	
   411	    var sanitized: [String: MLXArray] = [:]
   412	
   413	    for (key, value) in weights {
   414	      var newKey: String
   415	
   416	      if hasTransformerPrefix && key.hasPrefix("transformer.") {
   417	        // Skip audio-only modules — our Swift transformer is video-only.
   418	        // Audio blocks have keys under audio_* or av_ca_* top-level names.
   419	        let stripped = String(key.dropFirst("transformer.".count))
   420	        let isAudioOnly = stripped.hasPrefix("audio_")
   421	          || stripped.hasPrefix("av_ca_")
   422	          || stripped.contains(".audio_attn")
   423	          || stripped.contains(".audio_ff")
   424	          || stripped.contains(".audio_prompt_scale_shift_table")
   425	          || stripped.contains(".audio_scale_shift_table")
   426	          || stripped.contains(".audio_to_video_attn")
   427	          || stripped.contains(".video_to_audio_attn")
   428	          || stripped.contains(".scale_shift_table_a2v")
   429	        if isAudioOnly { continue }
   430	
   431	        newKey = stripped
   432	
   433	        // Rename norm_out -> norm_out (already correct in weights)
   434	        // No renames needed for transformer. prefix format.
   435	
   436	      } else if hasModelPrefix && key.hasPrefix("model.diffusion_model.") {
   437	        // Skip audio/video embedding connectors (handled in text encoder)
   438	        if key.contains("audio_embeddings_connector") || key.contains("video_embeddings_connector") {
   439	          continue
   440	        }
   441	
   442	        // Skip the audio / cross-modal DiT branch — our Swift transformer is
   443	        // video-only (audio arrives in Phase 2). JoyAI-Echo's monolith carries
   444	        // the full dual-stream half under this `model.diffusion_model.` prefix;
   445	        // without this the audio keys would be silently dropped by
   446	        // `verify:[.shapeMismatch]`. Make the video-only load explicit so it's
   447	        // intentional, mirroring the skip already present on the `transformer.`
   448	        // branch above.
   449	        let ditKey = String(key.dropFirst("model.diffusion_model.".count))
   450	        let isAudioOnly = ditKey.hasPrefix("audio_")
   451	          || ditKey.hasPrefix("av_ca_")
   452	          || ditKey.contains(".audio_attn")
   453	          || ditKey.contains(".audio_ff")
   454	          || ditKey.contains(".audio_prompt_scale_shift_table")
   455	          || ditKey.contains(".audio_scale_shift_table")
   456	          || ditKey.contains(".audio_to_video_attn")
   457	          || ditKey.contains(".video_to_audio_attn")
   458	          || ditKey.contains(".scale_shift_table_a2v")
   459	        if isAudioOnly { continue }
   460	
   461	        newKey = key.replacingOccurrences(of: "model.diffusion_model.", with: "")
   462	        newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".to_out.0.", with: ".to_out.")
   463	        newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".ff.net.0.proj.", with: ".ff.proj_in.")
   464	        newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".ff.net.2.", with: ".ff.proj_out.")
   465	        newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".linear_1.", with: ".linear1.")
   466	        newKey = newKey.replacingOccurrences(of: ".linear_2.", with: ".linear2.")
   467	
   468	      } else {
   469	        continue
   470	      }
   471	
   472	      sanitized[newKey] = value
   473	    }
   474	
   475	    return sanitized
   476	  }
   477	}

   228	    public struct ChunkPlan: Equatable, Sendable {
   229	        public let totalChunks: Int
   230	        public let totalFrames: Int
   231	        public let durationSeconds: Float
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    /// How many chunks and frames a request produces. Each continuation chunk
   235	    /// re-uses the previous chunk's last frame, so it adds `framesPerChunk - 1`
   236	    /// new frames. `extendToSeconds == 0` → a single chunk.
   237	    public static func chunkPlan(framesPerChunk: Int, extendToSeconds: Float, fps: Int) -> ChunkPlan {
   238	        let totalChunks: Int
   239	        if extendToSeconds > 0 {
   240	            let targetFrames = Int(extendToSeconds * Float(fps))
   241	            let continuations = max(0, Int(ceil(Float(targetFrames - framesPerChunk) / Float(framesPerChunk - 1))))
   242	            totalChunks = 1 + continuations
   243	        } else {
   244	            totalChunks = 1
   245	        }
   246	        let totalFrames = framesPerChunk + (framesPerChunk - 1) * (totalChunks - 1)
   247	        return ChunkPlan(
   248	            totalChunks: totalChunks,
   249	            totalFrames: totalFrames,
   250	            durationSeconds: Float(totalFrames) / Float(fps)
   251	        )
   252	    }

   832	                    ]

   836	                                               strength: request.identityAnchorStrength))

   844	                        guidance: request.guidance,

   846	                        negativeAttentionMask: negBatch?.attentionMask,

   848	                } else {

   862	            } else {

   887	                // VAE-encodes to a conditioning latent at 2x latent dims and

   932	                MLX.GPU.clearCache()

   934	                let chunkHeadroom: UInt64 = 40 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
   935	                var settleRounds = 0
   936	                while settleRounds < 3 || (chunkFree < chunkHeadroom && settleRounds < 10) {
   937	                    Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 3.0)

   947	        // two-stage refine on, frames come back at 2x (e.g. 448x768 -> 896x1536);

   207	
   208	    // Video settings. Bitrate: 0.5 bits/pixel (~12 Mbps @ 768x1280x24) is
   209	    // visually equivalent to the old 4 bits/px for generated content but ~8x

   216	      AVVideoWidthKey: width,
   217	      AVVideoHeightKey: height,
   218	      AVVideoCompressionPropertiesKey: [
   219	        AVVideoAverageBitRateKey: Int(Double(width * height * fps) * bitsPerPixel),
   220	        AVVideoMaxKeyFrameIntervalKey: fps,
   221	        AVVideoProfileLevelKey: AVVideoProfileLevelH264HighAutoLevel,
   222	      ] as [String: Any],

   229	    input.expectsMediaDataInRealTime = false

   231	    let adaptor = AVAssetWriterInputPixelBufferAdaptor(

   233	      sourcePixelBufferAttributes: [
   234	        kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey as String: kCVPixelFormatType_32ARGB,

   238	    )
   239

   241	    writer.startWriting()

   243	
   244	    let frameDuration = CMTimeMake(value: 1, timescale: Int32(fps))
   245	
   246	    for (index, cgImage) in frames.enumerated() {
   247	      // Wait for input to be ready
   248	      while !input.isReadyForMoreMediaData {
   249	        Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 0.01)
   250	      }

   252	      let presentationTime = CMTimeMultiply(frameDuration, multiplier: Int32(index))
   253

   256	        throw LTX2PostProcessError.pixelBufferCreationFailed(frameIndex: index)

   262	    input.markAsFinished()

   264	    // Wait for writing to complete
   265	    let semaphore = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
   266	    writer.finishWriting {
   267	      semaphore.signal()
   268	    }
   269	    semaphore.wait()
   270	
   271	    if writer.status == .failed {
   272	      throw LTX2PostProcessError.writingFailed(writer.error?.localizedDescription ?? "unknown")
   273	    }
   274	  }

   117	  /// Generate a video from a text prompt.
   118	  ///
   119	  /// - Parameters:
   120	  ///   - inputIds: Pre-tokenized input IDs `[B, S]`.
   121	  ///   - attentionMask: Attention mask `[B, S]`.
   122	  ///   - width: Output width in pixels (must be divisible by 32).
   123	  ///   - height: Output height in pixels (must be divisible by 32).
   124	  ///   - numFrames: Number of output frames. Must be `1 + 8k`.
   125	  ///   - steps: Number of denoising steps.
   126	  ///   - seed: Optional random seed for reproducibility.
   127	  ///   - guidance: CFG guidance scale. Overrides config if provided.
   128	  ///   - negativeInputIds: Negative prompt token IDs for CFG.
   129	  ///   - negativeAttentionMask: Negative prompt attention mask.
   130	  ///   - progressCallback: Called after each denoising step with `(currentStep, totalSteps)`.
   131	  /// - Returns: Pipeline output with decoded frames.
   132	  public func generateT2V(
   133	    inputIds: MLXArray,
   134	    attentionMask: MLXArray,
   135	    width: Int,
   136	    height: Int,
   137	    numFrames: Int,

   139	    seed: UInt64? = nil,
   140	    guidance: Float? = nil,
   141	    negativeInputIds: MLXArray? = nil,
   142	    negativeAttentionMask: MLXArray? = nil,

   144	  ) -> LTX2PipelineOutput {
   145	    let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()

   147	
   148	    // Validate frame count
   149	    precondition((numFrames - 1) % 8 == 0, "numFrames must be 1 + 8k (got \(numFrames))")
   150	    precondition(width % spatialCompression == 0, "width must be divisible by \(spatialCompression)")
   151	    precondition(height % spatialCompression == 0, "height must be divisible by \(spatialCompression)")
   152	
   153	    logger.info("T2V generation: \(width)x\(height), \(numFrames) frames, \(steps) steps")
   154	
   155	    // Step 1: Encode prompt
   156	    logger.info("Encoding prompt...")
   157	    let textOutput = textEncoder.encode(
   158	      inputIds: inputIds,
   159	      attentionMask: attentionMask,
   160	      returnAudioEmbeddings: false
   161	    )
   162	    eval(textOutput.videoEmbeddings)

   165	    var negativeEmbeddings: MLXArray? = nil
   166	    if cfgScale > 1.0 || resolvedConfig.samplerIsCfgPP,

   168	      logger.info("Encoding negative prompt (scale=\(cfgScale), cfgPP=\(resolvedConfig.samplerIsCfgPP))...")
   169	      let negOutput = textEncoder.encode(
   170	        inputIds: negIds,
   171	        attentionMask: negMask,
   172	        returnAudioEmbeddings: false
   173	      )

   178	    // NAG conditioning. The reference wires this as a separate model-patch
   179	    // input (`LTX2_NAG {nag_cond_video}`), NOT as the CFG negative — in that
   180	    // recipe CFG sits at 1.0 so the CFG negative is inert. With no dedicated

   185	    if nagConfig.isEnabled {
   186	      if let negIds = negativeInputIds, let negMask = negativeAttentionMask {
   187	        if let already = negativeEmbeddings {
   188	          nagEmbeddings = already
   189	        } else {
   190	          let out = textEncoder.encode(
   191	            inputIds: negIds, attentionMask: negMask, returnAudioEmbeddings: false)
   192	          eval(out.videoEmbeddings)
   193	          nagEmbeddings = out.videoEmbeddings
   194	        }
   195	        logger.info("NAG enabled (scale \(nagConfig.scale), alpha \(nagConfig.alpha), tau \(nagConfig.tau)).")
   196	      } else {
   197	        logger.warning("NAG configured but no negative prompt supplied — NAG requires a negative conditioning; skipping.")
   198	      }
   199	    }

   201	    // Step 2: Compute latent dimensions
   202	    let latH = height / spatialCompression
   203	    let latW = width / spatialCompression
   204	    let latF = (numFrames - 1) / temporalCompression + 1
   205	
   206	    logger.info("Latent dimensions: \(latF) frames x \(latH) x \(latW)")
   207

   211	    }

   214

   216	    let noise = MLXRandom.normal([1, 128, latF, latH, latW], dtype: .float32)
   217	    var latents = noise * MLXArray(sigmas[0])
   218	    eval(latents)

   224	
   225	    // Step 5: Precompute RoPE
   226	    let precomputedPE = ltx2PrecomputeFreqsCIS(
   227	      indicesGrid: positions,
   228	      dim: innerDim,
   229	      theta: transformer.positionalEmbeddingTheta,
   230	      maxPos: transformer.positionalEmbeddingMaxPos,
   231	      useMiddleIndicesGrid: transformer.useMiddleIndicesGrid,
   232	      numAttentionHeads: transformer.numHeads,
   233	      ropeMode: transformer.ropeMode,
   234	      doublePrecision: transformer.doublePrecisionRoPE
   235	    )
   236	    eval(precomputedPE.cos, precomputedPE.sin)
   237	
   238	    // Step 6: Denoising loop
   239	    logger.info("Denoising (\(config.sampler) sampler, \(sigmas.count - 1) steps)...")
   240	    latents = denoisingLoop(
   241	      latents: latents,
   242	      positions: positions,
   243	      precomputedPE: precomputedPE,
   244	      textEmbeddings: textOutput.videoEmbeddings,
   245	      negativeEmbeddings: negativeEmbeddings,
   246	      sigmas: sigmas,
   247	      cfgScale: cfgScale,
   248	      state: nil,
   249	      nagEmbeddings: nagEmbeddings, nag: nagConfig,
   250	      progressCallback: progressCallback
   251	    )
   252	
   253	    // Step 6b: Two-stage refine (env LTX2_TWO_STAGE) — identical machinery to the
   254	    // i2v refine, minus the frame-0 identity re-anchor (t2v has no source frame,
   255	    // so the refine runs free with state:nil). Upsample x2 -> flow re-noise ->
   256	    // short deterministic refine denoise.
   257	    if let ups = self.upsampler, resolvedConfig.twoStage {
   258	      MLX.GPU.clearCache()
   259	      logger.info("T2V two-stage refine: upsampling latents 2x...")
   260	      let stats = vae.decoder.perChannelStatistics
   261	      let upLatent = stats.normalize(ups(stats.unNormalize(latents.asType(.float32)))).asType(.float32)
   262	      eval(upLatent)
   263	      // Refine-volume OOM gate — same guard as the i2v path (Codex review
   264	      // 2026-07-26: t2v could still crash the process at large formats).
   265	      let t2vRefineVolume = upLatent.dim(2) * (latH * 2) * (latW * 2)
   266	      let t2vRefineMax = resolvedConfig.refineMaxVol
   267	      if t2vRefineVolume > t2vRefineMax {
   268	        logger.info("T2V two-stage refine: SKIPPED denoise (volume \(t2vRefineVolume) > \(t2vRefineMax)) — decoding upsampled latent directly (OOM guard).")
   269	        latents = upLatent
   270	      } else {
   271	      let rLatH = latH * 2, rLatW = latW * 2
   272	      let refineSigmas: [Float] = resolvedConfig.refineSigmasEffective
   273	      if let seed = seed { MLXRandom.seed(seed &+ 1000) }
   274	      let refNoise = MLXRandom.normal(upLatent.shape).asType(.float32)
   275	      let sigma0 = refineSigmas[0]
   276	      let refineInit = MLXArray(1 - sigma0) * upLatent + refNoise * MLXArray(sigma0)  // flow re-noise
   277	      let refinePos = createPositionGrid(batchSize: 1, latF: latF, latH: rLatH, latW: rLatW)
   278	      let refinePE = ltx2PrecomputeFreqsCIS(
   279	        indicesGrid: refinePos, dim: innerDim,
   280	        theta: transformer.positionalEmbeddingTheta,
   281	        maxPos: transformer.positionalEmbeddingMaxPos,
   282	        useMiddleIndicesGrid: transformer.useMiddleIndicesGrid,
   283	        numAttentionHeads: transformer.numHeads,
   284	        ropeMode: transformer.ropeMode,
   285	        doublePrecision: transformer.doublePrecisionRoPE)
   286	      eval(refinePE.cos, refinePE.sin)
   287	      logger.info("T2V two-stage refine: denoising at \(rLatW * spatialCompression)x\(rLatH * spatialCompression), \(refineSigmas.count - 1) steps...")
   288	      latents = denoisingLoop(
   289	        latents: refineInit, positions: refinePos, precomputedPE: refinePE,
   290	        textEmbeddings: textOutput.videoEmbeddings, negativeEmbeddings: negativeEmbeddings,
   291	        sigmas: refineSigmas, cfgScale: cfgScale, state: nil, nagEmbeddings: nagEmbeddings, nag: nagConfig,
   292	        forceDeterministic: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DETERMINISTIC"] != "0",
   293	        progressCallback: progressCallback)
   294	      eval(latents)
   295	      MLX.GPU.clearCache()
   296	      logger.info("T2V two-stage refine complete.")
   297	      }
   298	    }
   299	
   300	    // Step 7: Decode latents via VAE
   301	    logger.info("Decoding latents via VAE...")
   302	    let decoded = decodeAdaptive(latents)
   303	    eval(decoded)
   304	
   305	    // Convert from [-1, 1] to [0, 1] range (VAE outputs centered at 0)
   306	    let rescaled = (decoded.asType(.float32) + 1.0) / 2.0
   307	    let clamped = MLX.clip(rescaled, min: 0, max: 1)
   308	    eval(clamped)
   309	
   310	    let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
   311	    logger.info("Generation complete in \(String(format: "%.1f", elapsed))s")
   312	
   313	    return LTX2PipelineOutput(
   314	      decoded: clamped,
   315	      numFrames: numFrames,
   316	      width: width,
   317	      height: height,
   318	      elapsedSeconds: elapsed
   319	    )
   320	  }
   321	
   322	  // MARK: - Text-to-Video with Pre-computed Embeddings
   323	
   324	  /// Generate a video from pre-computed text embeddings, bypassing the text encoder.
   325	  ///
   326	  /// Use this when you want to supply your own embeddings (e.g. from a cached
   327	  /// encoder run, or dummy embeddings for pipeline testing) without loading
   328	  /// the Gemma 3 text encoder weights.
   329	  ///
   330	  /// - Parameters:
   845	
   846	    return LTX2PipelineOutput(
   847	      decoded: clamped,
   848	      numFrames: numFrames,
   849	      width: width,
   850	      height: height,
   851	      elapsedSeconds: elapsed
   852	    )
   853	  }
   854	
   855	  // MARK: - Internal: Denoising Loop
   856	
   857	  /// Core denoising loop shared by T2V and I2V.
   858	  private func denoisingLoop(
   859	    latents: MLXArray,
   860	    positions: MLXArray,
   861	    precomputedPE: (cos: MLXArray, sin: MLXArray),
   862	    textEmbeddings: MLXArray,
   863	    negativeEmbeddings: MLXArray?,
   864	    sigmas: [Float],
   865	    cfgScale: Float,
   866	    state: LTX2LatentState?,
   867	    nagEmbeddings: MLXArray? = nil,
   868	    nag: LTX2NAGConfig = .disabled,
   869	    forceDeterministic: Bool = false,
   870	    progressCallback: ((Int, Int) -> Void)?
   871	  ) -> MLXArray {
   872	    let dtype: DType = .bfloat16
   873	    let numSteps = sigmas.count - 1
   874	    // Per-step CFG schedule (community "CFG ramp": e.g. LTX2_CFG_SCHEDULE=3,2,1 —
   875	    // CFG only on the first steps, where broad motion forms, then back to 1;
   876	    // 10Eros per-step guider pattern). Missing entries extend the last value.
   877	    let cfgSchedule: [Float]? = resolvedConfig.cfgSchedule.isEmpty ? nil : resolvedConfig.cfgSchedule
   878	    func cfgAt(_ step: Int) -> Float {
   879	      guard let sch = cfgSchedule else { return cfgScale }
   880	      return sch[min(step, sch.count - 1)]
   881	    }
   882	    let useCFG = (cfgScale > 1.0 || (cfgSchedule?.contains { $0 > 1.0 } ?? false)) && negativeEmbeddings != nil
   883	
   884	    // --- Denoise-trajectory instrumentation (env-gated, off by default) ---
   885	    // Set LTX2_TRAJ_DUMP=<path-prefix> to append one JSON line per step to
   886	    // <path-prefix>.jsonl with latent/x0/velocity statistics. Used to diff
   887	    // sampler behavior numerically against reference implementations
   888	    // (e.g. ComfyUI). Zero overhead when the env var is unset.
   889	    let trajPrefix = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_TRAJ_DUMP"]
   890	    var trajHandle: FileHandle? = nil
   891	    // Mean over all elements.
   892	    func trajMean(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray { x.mean() }
   893	    // Std over all elements (population).
   894	    func trajStd(_ x: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
   895	      let m = x.mean()
   896	      return MLX.sqrt(((x - m) * (x - m)).mean())
   897	    }
   898	    // Weighted mean/std over token subset. x: (B, T, C) f32, w: (B, T) f32 0/1.
   899	    func trajMaskedStats(_ x: MLXArray, _ w: MLXArray) -> (mean: MLXArray, std: MLXArray) {
   900	      let w3 = w.expandedDimensions(axis: -1)
   901	      let channels = Float(x.dim(-1))
   902	      let count = w.sum() * channels + 1e-6
   903	      let m = (x * w3).sum() / count
   904	      let v = (((x - m) * (x - m)) * w3).sum() / count
   905	      return (m, MLX.sqrt(v))
   906	    }
   907	
   908	    // Keep latents in float32 throughout for precision
   909	    var currentLatents = latents.asType(.float32)
   910	    // Refine pass uses the deterministic member of the sampler family (validated
   911	    // PinkCherry recipe: base=euler_ancestral_cfg_pp, refine=euler_cfg_pp), so
   912	    // forceDeterministic drops the ancestral/SDE noise but keeps CFG++ mode.
   913	    let useSDE = resolvedConfig.samplerIsAncestral && !forceDeterministic
   914	    // CFG++ (euler[_ancestral]_cfg_pp): needs an unconditional (negative) pass
   915	    // every step regardless of cfgScale.
   916	    let useCfgPP = resolvedConfig.samplerIsCfgPP && negativeEmbeddings != nil
   917	
   918	    for i in 0..<numSteps {
   919	      let sigma = sigmas[i]
   920	      let sigmaNext = sigmas[i + 1]
   921	
   922	      // INPUT-side conditioning clamp (matches ComfyUI KSamplerX0Inpaint +
   923	      // LTXV.scale_latent_inpaint which returns the CLEAN latent, never
   924	      // re-noised): conditioned tokens (denoiseMask < 1) enter the model as
   925	      // clean latent every step, consistent with their per-token timestep of
   926	      // ~0. Without this the step update re-mixes noise into conditioned
   927	      // tokens, so the model reads a NOISY frame while told it's clean —
   928	      // misreading the reference each step (appearance divergence, i2v
   929	      // transition pop). Output-side x0 clamping alone is insufficient.
   930	      if let s = state {
   931	        let m = s.denoiseMask.asType(.float32)
   932	        currentLatents = currentLatents * m + s.cleanLatent.asType(currentLatents.dtype) * (MLXArray(Float(1)) - m)
   933	      }
   934	
   935	      // Snapshot pre-step latents for delta_norm (post input-clamp so the
   936	      // delta measures the denoise update; no compute or eval unless
   937	      // trajectory dumping is enabled).
   938	      let trajLatentsBefore: MLXArray? = trajPrefix != nil ? currentLatents : nil
   939	
   940	      let b = currentLatents.dim(0)
   941	      let c = currentLatents.dim(1)
   942	      let f = currentLatents.dim(2)
   943	      let h = currentLatents.dim(3)
   944	      let w = currentLatents.dim(4)
   945	      let numTokens = f * h * w
   946	
   947	      // Flatten latents to token space: (B, C, F, H, W) -> (B, T, C)
   948	      let latentsFlat = currentLatents
   949	        .reshaped(b, c, -1)
   950	        .transposed(0, 2, 1)
   951	        .asType(dtype)
   952	
   953	      // Compute per-token timesteps
   954	      let timesteps: MLXArray
   955	      if let s = state {
   956	        // I2V: per-token timesteps based on denoise mask
   957	        let maskBroadcast = MLX.broadcast(
   958	          s.denoiseMask.reshaped(b, 1, f, 1, 1),
   959	          to: [b, 1, f, h, w]
   960	        )
   961	        let maskFlat = maskBroadcast.reshaped(b, numTokens)
   962	        timesteps = MLXArray(sigma).asType(dtype) * maskFlat.asType(dtype)
   963	      } else {
   964	        timesteps = MLXArray(sigma).reshaped(1, 1).asType(dtype)
   965	      }
   966	
   967	      let sigmaArray = MLXArray([sigma]).asType(dtype)
   968	
   969	      // Positive pass through transformer.
   970	      // Pass PER-TOKEN timesteps so the model sees conditioned frames (mask=0)
   971	      // at timestep 0 (clean) and generated frames at `sigma`. Without this the
   972	      // transformer treats every token as equally noisy and cannot tell which
   973	      // frame is the I2V conditioning frame — it discounts the image and
   974	      // produces T2V-like output. Matches reference guided_denoise_loop which
   975	      // passes `video_timesteps = denoise_mask * sigma` when the mask is
   976	      // non-uniform. For T2V, `timesteps` is a scalar (1,1) → broadcast, so this
   977	      // is a no-op there.
   978	      // NAG rides ONLY the positive pass: it steers the conditional prediction
   979	      // away from the negative concept inside cross-attention. Applying it to
   980	      // the unconditional pass too would guide the baseline that CFG++ steps
   981	      // along, double-counting the guidance.
   982	      let velocityPos = transformer(
   983	        latent: latentsFlat,
   984	        timestep: timesteps,
   985	        context: textEmbeddings.asType(dtype),
   986	        positions: positions,
   987	        sigma: sigmaArray,
   988	        precomputedPE: precomputedPE,
   989	        nagContext: nagEmbeddings?.asType(dtype),
   990	        nag: nag
   991	      )
   992	
   993	      // Compute x0 (denoised) from velocity using per-token timesteps
   994	      let latentsFlatF32 = currentLatents
   995	        .reshaped(b, c, -1)
   996	        .transposed(0, 2, 1)
   997	      let timestepsF32 = timesteps.asType(.float32).expandedDimensions(axis: -1)
   998	      var x0GuidedF32 = latentsFlatF32 - timestepsF32 * velocityPos.asType(.float32)
   999	      let x0CondF32 = x0GuidedF32  // pure conditional x0, saved for the STG delta
  1000	
  1001	      // Negative pass: needed for classic CFG (scale>1) and for CFG++ (every
  1002	      // step, even at cfg=1 — the CFG++ update steps along the UNCONDITIONAL
  1003	      // noise direction; see ComfyUI sample_euler_ancestral_cfg_pp which sets
  1004	      // disable_cfg1_optimization=True for exactly this reason).
  1005	      var x0UncondF32: MLXArray? = nil
  1006	      if useCFG || useCfgPP, let negEmb = negativeEmbeddings {
  1007	        let velocityNeg = transformer(
  1008	          latent: latentsFlat,
  1009	          timestep: timesteps,
  1010	          context: negEmb.asType(dtype),
  1011	          positions: positions,
  1012	          sigma: sigmaArray,
  1013	          precomputedPE: precomputedPE
  1014	        )
  1015	        eval(velocityNeg)
  1016	
  1017	        let x0NegF32 = latentsFlatF32 - timestepsF32 * velocityNeg.asType(.float32)
  1018	        x0UncondF32 = x0NegF32
  1019	        if useCFG && cfgAt(i) > 1.0 {
  1020	          x0GuidedF32 = LTX2Guidance.applyCFG(
  1021	            conditioned: x0GuidedF32,
  1022	            unconditioned: x0NegF32,
  1023	            scale: cfgAt(i)
  1024	          )
  1025	          // Guidance rescale (Lin et al.; counters CFG over-saturation /
  1026	          // shadow-crush). High CFG inflates the prediction's std -> boosted
  1027	          // color/contrast (measured: cfg2 saturation +19% vs seed). Rescale
  1028	          // the guided x0 back toward the CONDITIONAL prediction's std, then
  1029	          // blend by phi — keeps the action-motion boost, restores seed color.
  1030	          // resolvedConfig.guidanceRescale (0 = off) — request/preset capable.
  1031	          let phi = resolvedConfig.guidanceRescale
  1032	          if phi > 0 {
  1033	            let stdCond = MLX.sqrt(((x0CondF32 - x0CondF32.mean()) * (x0CondF32 - x0CondF32.mean())).mean())
  1034	            let stdGuided = MLX.sqrt(((x0GuidedF32 - x0GuidedF32.mean()) * (x0GuidedF32 - x0GuidedF32.mean())).mean())
  1035	            let rescaled = x0GuidedF32 * (stdCond / (stdGuided + 1e-6))
  1036	            x0GuidedF32 = MLXArray(phi) * rescaled + MLXArray(1 - phi) * x0GuidedF32
  1037	          }
  1038	        }
  1039	      }
  1040	
  1041	      // STG: spatiotemporal guidance. A perturbed pass skips self-attention in a
  1042	      // block subset; steer away from it to restore high-frequency motion detail.
  1043	      // For distilled cfg=1 this is the primary guidance lever (anti-haze).
  1044	      let stgBase = resolvedConfig.stgScale
  1045	      if stgBase > 0 {
  1046	        let stgScale = LTX2PipelineConfig.stgScaleForStep(i, base: stgBase)
  1047	        let velocitySTG = transformer(
  1048	          latent: latentsFlat,
  1049	          timestep: timesteps,
  1050	          context: textEmbeddings.asType(dtype),
  1051	          positions: positions,
  1052	          sigma: sigmaArray,
  1053	          precomputedPE: precomputedPE,
  1054	          stgBlocks: resolvedConfig.stgBlockSet
  1055	        )
  1056	        eval(velocitySTG)
  1057	        let x0STGF32 = latentsFlatF32 - timestepsF32 * velocitySTG.asType(.float32)
  1058	        x0GuidedF32 = x0GuidedF32 + MLXArray(stgScale) * (x0CondF32 - x0STGF32)
  1059	      }
  1060	
  1061	      // Reshape x0 from token space to spatial
  1062	      var denoised = x0GuidedF32
  1063	        .transposed(0, 2, 1)
  1064	        .reshaped(b, c, f, h, w)
  1065	
  1066	      // Apply I2V denoise mask
  1067	      if let s = state {
  1068	        denoised = LTX2Conditioning.applyDenoiseMask(
  1069	          denoised: denoised,
  1070	          clean: s.cleanLatent.asType(.float32),
  1071	          denoiseMask: s.denoiseMask
  1072	        )
  1073	      }
  1074	      // Face-region identity hold: pull ONLY the masked face latents (all frames)
  1075	      // toward the source face, softly + every step. No full-frame splicing, so
  1076	      // nothing to collapse between anchors — holds a stationary partner's face.
  1077	      if let s = state, let fm = s.faceMask, let ref = s.faceRef, s.faceAnchorStrength > 0 {
  1078	        let m = fm.asType(.float32)
  1079	        let wm = m * s.faceAnchorStrength
  1080	        denoised = denoised * (MLXArray(Float(1)) - wm) + ref.asType(.float32) * wm
  1225	    }
  1226	
  1227	    if let handle = trajHandle {
  1228	      try? handle.close()
  1229	    }
  1230	
  1231	    return currentLatents
  1232	  }
  1233	
  1234	  // MARK: - Internal: Sigma Schedule
  1235	
  1236	  /// Get sigma schedule based on pipeline type.
  1237	  private func getSigmaSchedule(
  1238	    steps: Int, latF: Int, latH: Int, latW: Int
  1239	  ) -> [Float] {
  1240	    switch config.pipelineType {
  1241	    case .distilled:
  1242	      return resolvedConfig.stage1SigmasOrNil ?? LTX2PipelineConfig.stage1Sigmas
  1243	    case .dev, .devTwoStage:
  1244	      let numTokens = latF * latH * latW
  1245	      return LTX2PipelineConfig.devSigmaSchedule(
  1246	        steps: steps,
  1247	        numTokens: numTokens
  1248	      )
  1249	    }
  1250	  }
  1251	
  1252	  // MARK: - Internal: Position Grid
  1253	
  1254	  /// Create a 3D position grid for RoPE in pixel space.
  1255	  ///
  1256	  /// Matches the Python `create_position_grid` function with causal fix
  1257	  /// and bfloat16 precision quantization.
  1258	  /// Adaptive VAE decode. Plain single-pass decode is clean (no spatial-tile
  1259	  /// mosaic, no temporal-window jitter) but memory-heavy; tiled decode is
  1260	  /// OOM-safe for long/large clips. Decide by latent frame count: plain for
  1261	  /// normal clips, exact streamed decode above the safety gate. Mode switch:
  1262	  /// LTX2_DECODE_MODE=auto|stream|tile|plain. Threshold tunable
  1263	  /// via LTX2_PLAIN_DECODE_MAX_LATF (latent frames; ~8x fewer than output frames).
  1264	  private func decodeAdaptive(_ latents: MLXArray) -> MLXArray {
  1265	    let latF = latents.dim(2)
  1266	    let latH = latents.dim(3)
  1267	    let latW = latents.dim(4)
  1268	    // Gate on TOTAL latent volume, not frame count alone: a 768x1280 clip at
  1269	    // latF 13 (24x40 spatial) is 3x the volume of 448x704 and plain decode at
  1270	    // that size drove 40GB+ of swap with critical memory pressure mid-decode,
  1271	    // corrupting the output (blank/gray frames). Budget = the proven-safe
  1272	    // 448x704x97f working point (13*14*22 = 4004) with ~2x headroom.
  1273	    let volume = latF * latH * latW
  1274	    // Default budget derived from the Metal max-buffer ceiling, measured
  1275	    // empirically (2026-07-24): plain-decoding 49f @ 768x1280 (volume 6720,
  1276	    // ~25GB peak intermediate) SILENTLY CORRUPTS the last ~60% of frames —
  1277	    // no error, just garbage — while tiled decode of the same tensor is clean.
  1278	    // 4004 (97f @ 448x704) is proven-safe; 4500 keeps margin below the cliff.
  1279	    let plainMaxVolume = resolvedConfig.plainDecodeMaxVol
  1280	    // LTX2_DUMP_LATENT=<path>: save the pre-decode latent for offline decode
  1281	    // debugging (real-values reproduction harness, #36).
  1282	    if let dumpPath = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_DUMP_LATENT"] {
  1283	      try? MLX.save(arrays: ["latent": latents.asType(.float32)], url: URL(fileURLWithPath: dumpPath))
  1284	      logger.info("VAE decode: dumped pre-decode latent to \(dumpPath)")
  1285	    }
  1286	    // LTX2_DECODE_F32=1: decode in float32 instead of bf16 (debug probe).
  1287	    let decodeF32 = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_DECODE_F32"] == "1"
  1288	    let bf = latents.asType(decodeF32 ? .float32 : .bfloat16)
  1289	
  1290	    // Decode mode — ONE switch (LTX2_DECODE_MODE): auto | stream | tile | plain.
  1291	    //   auto (default): plain under the corruption-safe volume gate, exact
  1292	    //     streamed chunked-io above it (bit-identical to plain, zero seams).
  1293	    //   stream: streamed always. tile: legacy spatial tiling (LTX2_DECODE_TILE).
  1294	    //   plain: force single-pass — EXPERT/DEBUG ONLY: above the gate, MLX Metal
  1295	    //     silently corrupts boundary frames (int32 offset overflow, mlx #3836;
  1296	    //     unfixed in any mlx-swift release as of 0.31.6).
  1297	    // Legacy alias honored: LTX2_DECODE_STREAM=0 -> tile. config.tiledDecode
  1298	    // no longer disables the safety path (Codex review 2026-07-26: a default-
  1299	    // constructed config could force a corrupting plain decode).
  1300	    let env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
  1301	    let mode = (env["LTX2_DECODE_MODE"] ?? (env["LTX2_DECODE_STREAM"] == "0" ? "tile" : "auto")).lowercased()
  1302	    switch mode {
  1303	    case "plain":
  1304	      if volume > plainMaxVolume {
  1305	        logger.warning("VAE decode: FORCED plain above the safety gate (volume \(volume) > \(plainMaxVolume)) — output may be silently corrupt (mlx #3836).")
  1306	      }
  1307	      logger.info("VAE decode: plain single-pass (forced; volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]).")
  1308	      return vae.decode(bf)
  1309	    case "tile":
  1310	      let tile = Int(env["LTX2_DECODE_TILE"] ?? "") ?? 16
  1311	      logger.info("VAE decode: tiled (mode=tile; volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]) — tile \(tile).")
  1312	      return vae.decodeTiled(bf, tileSize: tile, tileStride: tile - 2)
  1313	    case "stream":
  1314	      logger.info("VAE decode: streamed exact chunked-io (mode=stream; volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]) — zero seams.")
  1315	      return vae.decodeStreamed(bf)
  1316	    default:  // auto
  1317	      if volume > plainMaxVolume {
  1318	        logger.info("VAE decode: streamed exact chunked-io (volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)] > \(plainMaxVolume)) — zero seams.")
  1319	        return vae.decodeStreamed(bf)
  1320	      }
  1321	      logger.info("VAE decode: plain single-pass (volume \(volume) [\(latF)x\(latH)x\(latW)]) — under the safety gate.")
  1322	      return vae.decode(bf)
  1323	    }
  1324	  }
  1325	
  1326	  /// Shared two-stage refine (Phase 3): latent upsample x2 -> re-noise ->
  1327	  /// short refine denoise at high res, with the refine-volume OOM gate and
  1328	  /// optional native-res frame-0 re-anchor. Used by generateI2V AND
  1329	  /// generateMultiKeyframe (continuation chunks) so every chunk of a
  1330	  /// multi-chunk render gets identical refine treatment — previously chunks
  1331	  /// 2+ skipped refine entirely, dropping to base resolution mid-video.
  1332	  /// Returns the refined (or gated/upsampled) latents; caller decodes.
  1333	  private func applyTwoStageRefine(
  1334	    _ latents: MLXArray,
  1335	    latF: Int, latH: Int, latW: Int,
  1336	    textEmbeddings: MLXArray,
  1337	    negativeEmbeddings: MLXArray?,
  1338	    cfgScale: Float,
  1339	    seed: UInt64?,
  1340	    refineAnchorImage: MLXArray?,
  1341	    progressCallback: ((Int, Int) -> Void)?
  1342	  ) -> MLXArray {
  1343	    guard let ups = self.upsampler,
  1344	          resolvedConfig.twoStage else {
  1345	      return latents
  1346	    }
  1347	    logger.info("Two-stage refine: upsampling latents 2x...")
  1348	    // The latent upsampler is trained on UN-normalized (VAE-scale) latents.
  1349	    let stats = vae.decoder.perChannelStatistics
  1350	    let denorm = stats.unNormalize(latents.asType(.float32))
  1351	    let upDenorm = ups(denorm)
  1352	    let upLatent = stats.normalize(upDenorm).asType(.float32)
  1353	    eval(upLatent)
  1354	    // --- Refine bisection instrumentation (env-gated, 2026-08-01 band bug) ---
  1355	    // LTX2_REFINE_ROWSTATS=1 logs per-latent-row energy at each refine boundary
  1356	    // so the vertical-truncation fault can be localized (upsample vs re-noise
  1357	    // vs denoise vs decode) from a single short render.
  1358	    // LTX2_REFINE_DUMP_DIR=<dir> additionally saves the boundary latents as
  1359	    // .npy for offline decode/parity tests.
  1360	    let rowStatsOn = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_ROWSTATS"] == "1"
  1361	    let dumpDir = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DUMP_DIR"]
  1362	    func rowStats(_ name: String, _ x: MLXArray) {
  1363	      guard rowStatsOn else { return }
  1364	      let f32 = x.asType(.float32)
  1365	      let energy = MLX.mean(f32 * f32, axes: [0, 1, 2, 4])  // (H,)
  1366	      eval(energy)
  1367	      let rows = energy.asArray(Float.self).map { String(format: "%.4f", $0) }
  1368	      logger.info("REFINE ROWSTATS \(name) [\(x.dim(3)) rows]: \(rows.joined(separator: " "))")
  1369	      if let dir = dumpDir {
  1370	        try? MLX.save(array: f32, url: URL(fileURLWithPath: dir).appendingPathComponent("\(name).npy"))
  1371	      }
  1372	    }
  1373	    rowStats("base", latents)
  1374	    rowStats("upsampled", upLatent)
  1375	    // Refine-volume OOM gate (2026-07-25 23:24 crash): above it, decode the
  1376	    // upsampled latent directly — upscaled-but-unrefined beats a dead server.
  1377	    let refineVolume = upLatent.dim(2) * (latH * 2) * (latW * 2)
  1378	    let refineMaxVolume = resolvedConfig.refineMaxVol
  1379	    if ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DECODE_ONLY"] == "1" {
  1380	      logger.info("Two-stage refine: DECODE_ONLY (skipped denoise) — decoding upsampled latent directly.")
  1381	      return upLatent
  1382	    }
  1383	    if refineVolume > refineMaxVolume {
  1384	      logger.info("Two-stage refine: SKIPPED denoise (refine latent volume \(refineVolume) > \(refineMaxVolume)) — decoding upsampled latent directly (OOM guard).")
  1385	      return upLatent
  1386	    }
  1387	    MLX.GPU.clearCache()
  1388	    let rLatH = latH * 2, rLatW = latW * 2
  1389	    let refineSigmas: [Float] = resolvedConfig.refineSigmasEffective
  1390	    if let seed = seed { MLXRandom.seed(seed &+ 1000) }
  1391	    // Flow-matching re-noise: x_σ = (1-σ)·x0 + σ·ε (ComfyUI CONST noise_scaling).
  1392	    let refNoise = MLXRandom.normal(upLatent.shape).asType(.float32)
  1393	    let sigma0 = refineSigmas[0]
  1394	    let mixed = MLXArray(1 - sigma0) * upLatent + refNoise * MLXArray(sigma0)
  1395	    // Frame-0 re-anchor: raw source re-encoded at refine res when available
  1396	    // (workflow nodes 19/20); else the upsampled latent's own frame 0.
  1397	    let rF = upLatent.dim(2)
  1398	    var anchorFrame = upLatent[0..., 0..., 0..<1, 0..., 0...]
  1399	    if var refImg = refineAnchorImage {
  1400	      if refImg.ndim == 4 { refImg = refImg.expandedDimensions(axis: 2) }
  1401	      anchorFrame = vae.encode(refImg).asType(.float32)
  1402	      eval(anchorFrame)
  1403	      logger.info("Two-stage refine: frame 0 re-anchored to source re-encoded at \(rLatW * spatialCompression)x\(rLatH * spatialCompression).")
  1404	    }
  1405	    rowStats("mixed", mixed)
  1406	    let refineInit = MLX.concatenated(
  1407	      [anchorFrame, mixed[0..., 0..., 1..<rF, 0..., 0...]], axis: 2)
  1408	    let refClean = MLX.concatenated(
  1409	      [anchorFrame, upLatent[0..., 0..., 1..<rF, 0..., 0...]], axis: 2)
  1410	    let refMask = MLX.concatenated(
  1411	      [MLXArray.zeros([1, 1, 1, 1, 1]), MLXArray.ones([1, 1, rF - 1, 1, 1])],
  1412	      axis: 2).asType(.float32)
  1413	    let refState = LTX2LatentState(
  1414	      latent: refineInit, cleanLatent: refClean, denoiseMask: refMask)
  1415	    let refinePos = createPositionGrid(batchSize: 1, latF: latF, latH: rLatH, latW: rLatW)
  1416	    let refinePE = ltx2PrecomputeFreqsCIS(
  1417	      indicesGrid: refinePos, dim: innerDim,
  1418	      theta: transformer.positionalEmbeddingTheta,
  1419	      maxPos: transformer.positionalEmbeddingMaxPos,
  1420	      useMiddleIndicesGrid: transformer.useMiddleIndicesGrid,
  1421	      numAttentionHeads: transformer.numHeads,
  1422	      ropeMode: transformer.ropeMode,
  1423	      doublePrecision: transformer.doublePrecisionRoPE)
  1424	    eval(refinePE.cos, refinePE.sin)
  1425	    logger.info("Two-stage refine: denoising at \(rLatW * spatialCompression)x\(rLatH * spatialCompression), \(refineSigmas.count - 1) steps...")
  1426	    // base=euler_ancestral_cfg_pp -> refine=euler_cfg_pp (the author's pairing).
  1427	    var refined = denoisingLoop(
  1428	      latents: refineInit, positions: refinePos, precomputedPE: refinePE,
  1429	      textEmbeddings: textEmbeddings, negativeEmbeddings: negativeEmbeddings,
  1430	      sigmas: refineSigmas, cfgScale: cfgScale, state: refState,
  1431	      forceDeterministic: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["LTX2_REFINE_DETERMINISTIC"] != "0",
  1432	      progressCallback: progressCallback)
  1433	    eval(refined)
  1434	    rowStats("refined", refined)
  1435	    MLX.GPU.clearCache()
  1436	    logger.info("Two-stage refine complete.")
  1437	    return refined
  1438	  }
  1439	
  1440	  private func createPositionGrid(
  1441	    batchSize: Int,
  1442	    latF: Int,
  1443	    latH: Int,
  1444	    latW: Int,
  1445	    refFrames: Int = 0,   // IC-control: appended reference frames positioned at temporal frame_idx 0
  1446	    spatialScaleMul: Float = 1.0   // refine: scale spatial positions to keep RoPE in-distribution at 2x
  1447	  ) -> MLXArray {
  1448	    let temporalScale = Float(temporalCompression)
  1449	    let spatialScale = Float(spatialCompression) * spatialScaleMul
  1450	    // Conditioning frame_rate drives the temporal RoPE spacing, which is the
  1451	    // motion-vs-coherence dial: LOWER fps → coords spread further apart → the
  1452	    // model assumes bigger inter-frame time gaps → MORE motion per frame (until
  1453	    // coords exceed the trained temporal max_pos ~20 → shimmer). LTX2_COND_FPS
  1454	    // decouples this from the OUTPUT/playback fps (config.fps) so we can drive
  1455	    // motion from a sharp seed without making the mp4 choppy. Default: match

     5	/// Offline MLX affine quantization for LTX-2 checkpoints (comfybox#230 Phase B).
     6	///
     7	/// Quantizes ONLY the video-DiT transformer-block projection weights
     8	/// (attention to_q/to_k/to_v/to_out, FF proj_in/proj_out) to packed uint32 +
     9	/// `.scales`/`.biases` siblings — the same MLX affine format the image
    10	/// pipeline and the quantized Gemma loader already consume. Everything
    11	/// quality-sensitive or small stays bf16: norms, patchify/time/caption
    12	/// embeds, the final `proj_out`, scale-shift tables, the audio DiT branch,
    13	/// the VAE, vocoder, and connectors. The output keeps the source's key
    14	/// layout (monolith or per-component), so the existing load path works with
    15	/// only a scales-aware branch added at load time.
    16	public enum LTX2Quantizer {
    17	
    18	  public struct Spec: Sendable {
    19	    public var bits: Int
    20	    public var groupSize: Int
    21	    public init(bits: Int = 8, groupSize: Int = 64) {
    22	      self.bits = bits
    23	      self.groupSize = groupSize
    24	    }
    25	  }
    26	
    27	  public struct Summary {
    28	    public var quantizedCount = 0
    29	    public var passthroughCount = 0
    30	    public var quantizedInputBytes = 0
    31	    public var quantizedOutputBytes = 0
    32	  }
    33	
    34	  public enum LTX2QuantizerError: Error, LocalizedError {
    35	    case invalidBits(Int)
    36	    case invalidGroupSize(Int)
    37	    case sourceNotFound(String)
    38	    case nothingQuantized(String)
    39	
    40	    public var errorDescription: String? {
    41	      switch self {
    42	      case .invalidBits(let b): return "Invalid bits: \(b). Supported: 4, 8"
    43	      case .invalidGroupSize(let g): return "Invalid group size: \(g). Supported: 32, 64, 128"
    44	      case .sourceNotFound(let p): return "LTX-2 checkpoint not found: \(p)"
    45	      case .nothingQuantized(let p):
    46	        return "No quantizable transformer_blocks weights found in \(p) — wrong file or already quantized?"
    47	      }
    48	    }
    49	  }
    50	
    51	  /// Whether `key`/`tensor` is a video-DiT block projection we quantize.
    52	  /// Works in both monolith (`model.diffusion_model.transformer_blocks.…`)
    53	  /// and per-component (`transformer_blocks.…` / `transformer.…`) key spaces.
    54	  public static func shouldQuantize(key: String, ndim: Int, inDim: Int, groupSize: Int) -> Bool {
    55	    guard key.hasSuffix(".weight"), ndim == 2 else { return false }
    56	    guard key.contains("transformer_blocks.") else { return false }
    57	    // Audio / cross-modal branch stays bf16 — the video-only loader skips it,
    58	    // and quantizing it would just complicate the future audio phase.
    59	    if key.contains("audio_") || key.contains("av_ca_")
    60	        || key.contains("audio_to_video_attn") || key.contains("video_to_audio_attn") {
    61	      return false
    62	    }
    63	    if key.contains("norm") { return false }
    64	    return inDim % groupSize == 0
    65	  }
    66	
    67	  /// Pure dict-level quantization — separated from file I/O for testability.
    68	  /// Returns the transformed tensor dict (quantized keys replaced by packed
    69	  /// uint32 + `.scales`/`.biases` siblings; everything else passed through)
    70	  /// plus a summary. `evalEvery` bounds memory: quantized outputs are
    71	  /// force-evaluated in batches so lazy graphs never accumulate.
    72	  public static func quantizeTensors(
    73	    _ weights: [String: MLXArray],
    74	    spec: Spec,
    75	    evalEvery: Int = 64,
    76	    verbose: Bool = false
    77	  ) -> (tensors: [String: MLXArray], summary: Summary) {
    78	    var out: [String: MLXArray] = [:]
    79	    var summary = Summary()
    80	    var pendingEval: [MLXArray] = []
    81	
    82	    for key in weights.keys.sorted() {
    83	      let tensor = weights[key]!
    84	      let inDim = tensor.ndim == 2 ? tensor.dim(1) : 0
    85	      guard shouldQuantize(key: key, ndim: tensor.ndim, inDim: inDim, groupSize: spec.groupSize) else {
    86	        out[key] = tensor
    87	        summary.passthroughCount += 1
    88	        continue
    89	      }
